name: cosine_deficit_radius435

      ∃ z : ℤ, |x - z| ≤ ρ
doc:
/-- P0093 page 163 equation 7.10. For every positive radius there
is a positive cosine deficit threshold that forces distance to an

name: rotation_cosine435
header:

      Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (x - u.arg / (2 * Real.pi)))
doc:
/-- P0093 page 162 equation 7.8. A unit complex rotation is an
exponential of its argument. Multiplying a negative Fourier phase by
that rotation subtracts one common real phase inside the cosine. -/

name: weighted_deficit435
header:
theorem weighted_deficit435 (M : ℕ) (w θ : ℕ → ℝ) (η : ℝ)

      ‖∑ m ∈ range M, (w m : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * θ m) : ℝ) * Complex.I)‖) :
    ∃ φ : ℝ, ∑ m ∈ range M, w m *
      (1 - Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (θ m - φ))) < η * M
doc:
/-- P0093 page 162 equations 7.8 and 7.9. The weighted cosine
deficit is small when the norm of the weighted phase sum is almost
its total weight. This is the finite scalar identity before counting
exceptional indices. -/

name: weighted_bad_count435

    (hD : ∀ m ∈ Finset.range M, 0 ≤ D m)

      ε * d * Real.exp (-1) * M) :
    ((Finset.range M).filter (fun m => d ≤ D m)).card ≤ ε * (M : ℝ)
doc:
/-- P0093 page 162 the exceptional index count between equations
7.8 and 7.9. Positive lower damping weights turn a small total
weighted deficit into a small number of indices above a fixed deficit.
Only finite sums and real inequalities occur here. -/

name: fourier_coefficient_proved357_up111
header:

name: lemma_three_proved357_up111
header: theorem lemma_three_proved357_up111 : LemmaThree111_up111

name: arc_abs_le_mixed_mass357_up111
header:
theorem arc_abs_le_mixed_mass357_up111 (k N : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hN : 1 ≤ N)

doc:
/-- P0093 page 167 equation 10.1. Factor k minus two powers of T from
the arc norm and compare its remaining square integral with the full circle. -/

name: additive_power_le_twice357_up111
header:
theorem additive_power_le_twice357_up111 (r : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t)

doc:
/-- P0093 page 167 equation 10.1. A fixed power of a bounded additive

name: minor_error_proved357_up111
header:
theorem minor_error_proved357_up111 (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (hη1 : η < 1)

    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, 3 ≤ k → ∃ N0 : ℕ,

doc:
/-- P0093 page 167 equation 10.1. Exact minor_error280 statement.
The pointwise complementary bound, clean Lemma 3 and dyadic growth suffice. -/

name: integral_exp_two_pi_mul_int357_up111
header:
theorem integral_exp_two_pi_mul_int357_up111 (m : ℤ) :
    (∫ α in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * (m : ℝ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I)) =
      if m = 0 then 1 else 0
doc:
/-- LEAF. Step 1 of the proof, the orthogonal integral: the integral over the
unit interval of a complex exponential of an integral frequency is one at
frequency zero and zero at every other integral frequency. -/

name: tsum_fintype_pi_pow357_up111
header:
private theorem tsum_fintype_pi_pow357_up111 (f : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hf : Summable (fun n => ‖f n‖)) (k : ℕ) :
    Summable (fun ν : Fin k → ℕ => ∏ i, f (ν i)) ∧
      (∑' n, f n) ^ k = ∑' ν : Fin k → ℕ, ∏ i, f (ν i)
doc:
/-- LEAF. Step 1 of the proof, the orthogonal integral: the integral over the
unit interval of a complex exponential of an integral frequency is one at
frequency zero and zero at every other integral frequency. -/
theorem integral_exp_two_pi_mul_int357_up111 (m : ℤ) :
    (∫ α in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * (m : ℝ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I)) =
      if m = 0 then 1 else 0 := by
  rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)]
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · subst m
    simp
  · simp only [hm, ↓reduceIte]
    let c : ℂ := 2 * Real.pi * (m : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
      dsimp [c]
      exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num)
        (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero))
        (Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hm)) Complex.I_ne_zero
    have heq : (fun α : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * (m : ℝ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I)) =
        fun α : ℝ => Complex.exp (c * (α : ℂ)) := by
      funext α
      congr 1
      dsimp [c]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [heq, integral_exp_mul_complex hc]
    have he : Complex.exp c = 1 := by
      have he' : Complex.exp (c * ((1 : ℝ) : ℂ)) = 1 := by
        dsimp [c]
        convert Complex.exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I m using 1 <;> ring
      simpa using he'
    simp [he, hc]

name: integrand_eq_tsum357_up111
header:
theorem integrand_eq_tsum357_up111 (k N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (α : ℝ) :
    primeFourier111_up111 N α ^ 2 * powerFourier111_up111 N α ^ k *
        Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * N) : ℝ) * Complex.I) =
      ∑' t : Nat.Primes × Nat.Primes × (Fin k → ℕ),
        (Real.exp (-((((t.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ((t.2.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ∑ i, ((2 ^ (t.2.2 i + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)) / N)) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * ((N : ℝ) - (((t.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ((t.2.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ∑ i, ((2 ^ (t.2.2 i + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)))) : ℝ) * Complex.I)
doc:
/-- LEAF. Step 2 of the proof, the pointwise product: at a fixed point of the
unit interval, one copy of the damped prime series squared times k copies of
the damped power-of-two series times the exponential of frequency N is the
absolutely convergent series over prime pairs and exponent tuples whose
frequencies add up. -/

name: expanded_fourier_summable357_up111
header:
private theorem expanded_fourier_summable357_up111 (k N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (α : ℝ) :
    Summable (fun t : Nat.Primes × Nat.Primes × (Fin k → ℕ) =>
      (Real.exp (-((((t.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ((t.2.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) +
        ∑ i, ((2 ^ (t.2.2 i + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)) / N)) : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * ((N : ℝ) - (((t.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) +
        ((t.2.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ∑ i, ((2 ^ (t.2.2 i + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)))) : ℝ) * Complex.I))
doc:
/-- LEAF. Step 2 of the proof, the pointwise product: at a fixed point of the
unit interval, one copy of the damped prime series squared times k copies of
the damped power-of-two series times the exponential of frequency N is the
absolutely convergent series over prime pairs and exponent tuples whose
frequencies add up. -/
theorem integrand_eq_tsum357_up111 (k N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (α : ℝ) :
    primeFourier111_up111 N α ^ 2 * powerFourier111_up111 N α ^ k *
        Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * N) : ℝ) * Complex.I) =
      ∑' t : Nat.Primes × Nat.Primes × (Fin k → ℕ),
        (Real.exp (-((((t.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ((t.2.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ∑ i, ((2 ^ (t.2.2 i + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)) / N)) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * ((N : ℝ) - (((t.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ((t.2.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ∑ i, ((2 ^ (t.2.2 i + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)))) : ℝ) * Complex.I) := by
  let P : Nat.Primes → ℂ := fun p =>
    (Real.exp (-((p : ℕ) : ℝ) / N) : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * α * (p : ℕ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I)
  let Q : ℕ → ℂ := fun m =>
    (Real.exp (-((2 ^ (m + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) / N) : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * α * (2 ^ (m + 1) : ℕ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I)
  have hP : Summable (fun p => ‖P p‖) := by
    simpa only [P] using (prime_fourier_summable111_up111 N hN α).norm
  have hQ : Summable (fun m => ‖Q m‖) := by
    simpa only [Q] using (power_fourier_summable111_up111 N hN α).norm
  have hpow := tsum_fintype_pi_pow357_up111 Q hQ k

doc:

theorem atMost_of_exact0 {K N : ℕ} (hev : Even N) (h : LinnikExact0 K N) :
    LinnikAtMost K N := by
  obtain ⟨p, q, hp, hq, ν, hN⟩ := h
  set s : Multiset ℕ := Finset.univ.val.map ν with hs
  have hsum : ∑ i, 2 ^ ν i = (s.map (2 ^ ·)).sum := by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_multiset_sum, hs, Multiset.map_map]; rfl
  have hcard : Multiset.card s = K := by simp [hs]
  set t := s.filter (fun x => ¬ x = 0) with ht
  set z := s.count 0 with hz
  have hsplit : s = Multiset.replicate z 0 + t := by
    rw [ht, hz, ← Multiset.filter_eq' s 0]; exact (Multiset.filter_add_not _ s).symm
  have hsum2 : (s.map (2 ^ ·)).sum = z + (t.map (2 ^ ·)).sum := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hsplit]
    simp [Multiset.map_replicate, Multiset.sum_replicate]
  have hcard2 : Multiset.card s = z + Multiset.card t := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hsplit]
    simp
  have ht1 : ∀ x ∈ t, 1 ≤ x := by
    intro x hx; rw [ht, Multiset.mem_filter] at hx; omega
  have hE : 2 ∣ (t.map (2 ^ ·)).sum := by
    apply Multiset.dvd_sum
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hy
    exact dvd_pow_self 2 (by have := ht1 a ha; omega)
  set u := t + Multiset.replicate (z / 2) 1 with hu
  have hu1 : ∀ x ∈ u, 1 ≤ x := by
    intro x hx
    rcases Multiset.mem_add.mp hx with h | h
    · exact ht1 x h
    · rw [Multiset.eq_of_mem_replicate h]
  have husum : (u.map (2 ^ ·)).sum = (t.map (2 ^ ·)).sum + 2 * (z / 2) := by
    simp [hu, Multiset.map_replicate, Multiset.sum_replicate, mul_comm]
  have hucard : Multiset.card u = Multiset.card t + z / 2 := by simp [hu]
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hE
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hev
  rw [hsum, hsum2] at hN
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd z with ⟨m, hm⟩ | ⟨m, hm⟩
  · refine ⟨Multiset.card u, by omega, exact_of_multiset hp hq u hu1 ?_⟩
    omega
  · have p2 := hp.eq_two_or_odd
    have q2 := hq.eq_two_or_odd
    have hpq : p = 2 ∨ q = 2 := by omega
    rcases hpq with rfl | rfl
    · refine ⟨Multiset.card u, by omega, exact_of_multiset Nat.prime_three hq u hu1 ?_⟩
      omega
    · refine ⟨Multiset.card u, by omega, exact_of_multiset hp Nat.prime_three u hu1 ?_⟩
      omega

theorem linnik1951_iff_conv0 :

doc: /-- The lab's `Linnik.linnik1951` statement does not depend on the exponent convention. -/

name: log_convolution_estimate1622
header:
theorem log_convolution_estimate1622 :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n →
      |logConvolution1622 n - (n : ℝ) / Real.log n ^ 2| ≤
        B * ((n : ℝ) / Real.log n ^ 2) * (1 / Real.sqrt (Real.log n))
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 161 sentence after equation 6.3, in the printed relative form.
The elementary estimate of the convolution. No primes, no GRH. For n at most 3 the
sum is empty and the estimate is the choice of B. -/

name: major_expansion_recut1622
header:
theorem major_expansion_recut1622 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) (hM : MellinBound280)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N0 < N →
      |arcContribution280 k N (majorArcs280 N) - truncatedMain357 k N| ≤
        A * majorRelative376 k N +
          A * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 - (1 / 1000 : ℝ)) * Real.log N ^ (k + 13)
doc:
/-- P0093 page 165 equation 8.1 and page 166 equation 8.2. Exact
major_expansion_remainder376 statement. CONDITIONAL on GRH, MellinBound280
and the four analytic leaves in Decomp491b. -/

name: exceptional_system_cover412
header:
theorem exceptional_system_cover412 :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 ∧ ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ,
      ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N → ∃ S : Finset ℕ,
        (S.card : ℝ) ≤ A * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) ∧
        (∀ q ∈ S, (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) ∧
          (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) ∧
        exceptionalArcs280 N η ⊆
          ⋃ q ∈ S, arcSystem111 q ((N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) ∩ Set.Icc 0 1
doc:
/-- P0093 page 166 Lemma 6 applied to the interval cover from Lemma 5.
Exact exceptional_system_cover376 statement, CONDITIONAL only on the two new phase and
binary entropy leaves. The finite image cannot increase the cover count. -/

name: exceptional_prime_mass412
header:
theorem exceptional_prime_mass412 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ,
      ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
        (∫ α in exceptionalArcs280 N η, ‖primeFourier111 N α‖ ^ 2) ≤
          C * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 - (1 / 100 : ℝ))
doc:
/-- P0093 page 166 equation 9.3 before the T bound. Exact
exceptional_prime_mass357 statement. CONDITIONAL on the geometric cover
and the local doubled system prime mass estimate. -/

name: exceptional_system_cover435
header:
theorem exceptional_system_cover435 :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 ∧ ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ,
      ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N → ∃ S : Finset ℕ,
        (S.card : ℝ) ≤ A * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) ∧
        (∀ q ∈ S, (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) ∧
          (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) ∧
        exceptionalArcs280 N η ⊆
          ⋃ q ∈ S, arcSystem111 q ((N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) ∩ Set.Icc 0 1
doc:
/-- P0093 page 166 Lemma 6 applied to the interval cover from Lemma 5.
Exact exceptional_system_cover376 statement from the proved interval cover.
The finite image cannot increase the cover count. -/

name: exceptional_prime_mass435
header:
theorem exceptional_prime_mass435 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ,
      ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
        (∫ α in exceptionalArcs280 N η, ‖primeFourier111 N α‖ ^ 2) ≤
          C * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 - (1 / 100 : ℝ))
doc:
/-- P0093 page 166 equation 9.3 before the T bound. Exact
exceptional_prime_mass357 statement. CONDITIONAL on the refined geometric cover
and the explicit local doubled system expansion. -/

name: prime_fourier_zero439
header: theorem prime_fourier_zero439 (α : ℝ) : primeFourier111 0 α = 0
doc:
/-- P0093 page 154 damped series definition, totalized endpoint N equal
to zero. The prime series has nonsummable unit norm terms and Lean assigns
its infinite sum value zero. This is separate from the positive N estimates. -/

name: cover_mass_summation_proved439
header:
theorem cover_mass_summation_proved439 (N : ℕ) (η : ℝ) (F : Finset (ℕ × ℤ)) (B : ℝ)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hq : ∀ p ∈ F, 1 ≤ p.1)
    (hcover : exceptionalArcs280 N η ⊆
      ⋃ p ∈ F, Set.Icc ((p.2 : ℝ) / (p.1 : ℝ) - 1 / ((p.1 : ℝ) * ((N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ))))
        ((p.2 : ℝ) / (p.1 : ℝ) + 1 / ((p.1 : ℝ) * ((N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)))))
    (harc : ∀ p ∈ F,
      (∫ α in Set.Icc ((p.2 : ℝ) / (p.1 : ℝ) - 1 / ((p.1 : ℝ) * ((N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ))))
          ((p.2 : ℝ) / (p.1 : ℝ) + 1 / ((p.1 : ℝ) * ((N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)))),
        ‖primeFourier111 N α‖ ^ 2) ≤
      B * (N : ℝ) / ((p.1 : ℝ) * ((N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ))) * Real.log (N : ℝ) ^ 13) :
    (∫ α in exceptionalArcs280 N η, ‖primeFourier111 N α‖ ^ 2) ≤
      B * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 - (1 / 7 : ℝ)) * Real.log (N : ℝ) ^ 13 *
        (∑ p ∈ F, 1 / (p.1 : ℝ))
doc:
/-- P0093 page 166 equation 9.3. Exact cover_mass_summation357 type.
Subadditivity over the finite cover transfers the given per arc bounds
and factors out the common scale. No disjointness is required. -/

name: truncatedSingular357
header: noncomputable def truncatedSingular357 (N n : ℕ) : ℝ
doc:
/-- P0093 page 168 equation 10.6. The finite singular series with Q equal
to N to the one tenth. The existing lab Ramanujan sum uses reduced residues. -/

name: truncatedMain357
header: noncomputable def truncatedMain357 (k N : ℕ) : ℝ
doc:
/-- P0093 page 165 equation 8.1. The leading finite singular series sum
before the tail is replaced by the Euler product. -/

name: localArc1622
header: noncomputable def localArc1622 (N q : ℕ) (n : ℤ) : ℂ
doc:
/-- P0093 page 155 equation 3.1. I_q at an integer residual n, with
tau equal to N to the one seventh. -/

name: logConvolution1622
header: noncomputable def logConvolution1622 (n : ℕ) : ℝ
doc:
/-- P0093 page 161 after equation 6.3. The sum of 1 over ln m ln m' over m + m' = n
with both at least 2. It is empty for n below 4. -/

name: logConvolution_four1622
header:
theorem logConvolution_four1622 :
    logConvolution1622 4 = 1 / (Real.log 2 * Real.log 2)
doc: /-- Vacuity instance: at n equal to 4 the convolution is the single term at m equal to 2. -/

name: LocalExpansion1622
header: def LocalExpansion1622 (B : ℝ) (N0 : ℕ) : Prop
doc: /-- The bound of arc_local_expansion1622 as a Prop with its constants. -/

name: representation_of_count_pos111
header:
theorem representation_of_count_pos111 {k N : ℕ} (h : 0 < representationCount111 k N) :
    LinnikExact k N
doc: /-- LEAF. P0093 page 154, equation 2.1. A positive count gives a representation. -/

name: count_pos_of_representation111
header: theorem count_pos_of_representation111 {k N : ℕ} (h : LinnikExact k N) : 0 < representationCount111 k N
doc: /-- P0093 page 154, equation 2.1. No representation is lost by the finite bounds. -/

name: circle_partition_split111
header:
theorem circle_partition_split111 (k N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (η : ℝ) :
    (representationCount111 k N : ℝ) =
      arcContributionSplit111 k N (majorArcsSplit111 N) +
      arcContributionSplit111 k N (exceptionalArcsSplit111 N η) +
      arcContributionSplit111 k N (goodMinorArcsSplit111 N η)
doc:
/-- SPLIT piece 1 of error_bound111. P0093 page 154 equation 2.2 and page 167
equation 10.2. Fourier orthogonality on the unit interval counts the ordered
representations, and the disjoint partition into major, exceptional and good
minor arcs splits the integral into three parts. -/

name: polylog_small_split111
header:
theorem polylog_small_split111 (j : ℕ) {c A ε : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N → A * Real.log N ^ j ≤ ε * (N : ℝ) ^ c
doc:
/-- SPLIT 9 helper, P0093 pages 166 and 168, the step by which (9.2) and (10.6)
are absorbed into the scale. A fixed power of log N times a constant is
eventually below epsilon times a fixed positive power of N. Proved. -/

name: arc_abs_le_split111
header:
theorem arc_abs_le_split111 (k N : ℕ) (s : Set ℝ) :
    |arcContributionSplit111 k N s| ≤ Real.exp 1 *
      ∫ α in s, ‖primeSeriesSplit111 N α‖ ^ 2 * ‖powerSeriesSplit111 N α‖ ^ k
doc:
/-- SPLIT 9, P0093 page 166 equation 9.2 and page 167 equation 10.1, where the
integrals of S squared times T to the k are bounded through absolute values.
The arc contribution is at most e times the integral of the norms. Proved. -/

name: prime_square_integrableOn_split111
header:
theorem prime_square_integrableOn_split111 (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (s : Set ℝ)
    (hs : s ⊆ Set.Icc 0 1) :
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun α => ‖primeSeriesSplit111 N α‖ ^ 2) s
doc:
/-- SPLIT 9, P0093 page 166. The squared prime series is integrable on every
subset of the unit interval, by continuity, used to compare integrals in 9.3.
Proved. -/

name: coverSet111
header: noncomputable def coverSet111 (N : ℕ) (s : Finset ℝ) : Set ℝ
doc:
/-- P0093 page 165, Lemma 5 equation 7.19: the union of the closed segments of
length N to the minus 0.99 centred at the points of a finite set s. -/

name: largeSet111
header: noncomputable def largeSet111 (N : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) : Set ℝ
doc:
/-- P0093 page 162, the set O_theta of 7.5 where T is large, taken on the
interval from minus 1 to 2 so that segments around points of the unit interval
stay inside; T has period one, so this is three copies of the paper's set. -/

name: lemma4_measure_split111
header:
theorem lemma4_measure_split111 (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 < κ) :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 / 2 ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      volume (largeSet111 N (2 * η)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * (N : ℝ) ^ (κ - 1))
doc:
/-- SPLIT 9 LEAF, unconditional. P0093 page 162, Lemma 4 equation 7.6, used for
2 eta as in the proof of Lemma 5 on page 165: since epsilon of eta tends to 0
with eta, for every kappa there is a small eta with the measure of O_{2 eta}
at most C N to the kappa minus 1. Proof in the paper by the binary digit count
7.9 to 7.18. -/

name: power_zero_lower_split111
header:
theorem power_zero_lower_split111 (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N) :
    1 / 3 ≤ ‖powerSeriesSplit111 N 0‖
doc:
/-- SPLIT 9, P0093 page 161 equation 7.1 in its weakest form: T at zero is at
least one third once N is at least 2, from its first term. Proved. -/

name: dyadic_weight_split111
header:
theorem dyadic_weight_split111 (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    Summable (fun m : ℕ => (2 : ℝ) ^ (m + 1) * Real.exp (-((2 ^ (m + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) / N)) ∧
      ∑' m : ℕ, (2 : ℝ) ^ (m + 1) * Real.exp (-((2 ^ (m + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) / N) ≤ 6 * N
doc:
/-- SPLIT 9, P0093 page 165 proof of Lemma 5: the derivative weight of T, the sum
of 2 to the m times e to the minus 2 to the m over N, converges and is at most
6 N. Head bounded by a geometric sum, tail by the quadratic lower bound of exp.
Proved. -/

name: exp_phase_diff_split111
header:
theorem exp_phase_diff_split111 (θ1 θ2 : ℝ) :
    ‖Complex.exp ((θ1 : ℂ) * Complex.I) - Complex.exp ((θ2 : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ |θ1 - θ2|
doc: /-- Two unit phases differ by at most the difference of their angles. Proved. -/

name: power_shift_diff_split111
header:
theorem power_shift_diff_split111 (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (α ξ : ℝ) :
    ‖powerSeriesSplit111 N (α + ξ) - powerSeriesSplit111 N α‖ ≤
      2 * Real.pi * |ξ| * (6 * N)
doc:
/-- SPLIT 9, P0093 page 165 proof of Lemma 5: T moves by at most 2 pi times xi
times 6 N when its argument moves by xi. Proved. -/

name: lemma5_shift_split111
header:
theorem lemma5_shift_split111 (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (hη1 : η < 1 / 2) :
    ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N → ∀ α ξ : ℝ, |ξ| ≤ 1 / (N * Real.log N) →
      (1 - η) * ‖powerSeriesSplit111 N 0‖ < ‖powerSeriesSplit111 N α‖ →
        (1 - 2 * η) * ‖powerSeriesSplit111 N 0‖ < ‖powerSeriesSplit111 N (α + ξ)‖
doc:
/-- SPLIT 9, unconditional, PROVED. P0093 page 165, proof of Lemma 5: if N is large
and xi is at most Delta equal to 1 over N ln N, a point of O_eta moved by xi
lies in O_{2 eta}. The paper calls this obvious. -/

name: grid_cover_split111
header:
theorem grid_cover_split111 (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (E O : Set ℝ) (hE : E ⊆ Set.Icc 0 1)
    (hcell : ∀ α ∈ E, ∀ β, |β - α| < L → β ∈ O) (V : ℝ) (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (hO : volume O ≤ ENNReal.ofReal V) :
    ∃ s : Finset ℝ, (s.card : ℝ) * L ≤ V ∧
      ∀ α ∈ E, ∃ c ∈ s, |α - c| ≤ L / 2
doc:
/-- SPLIT 9, P0093 page 165, the counting step of Lemma 5 done with a grid of
cells of length L: cells meeting E lie inside O, are disjoint, so their number
times L is at most the measure of O, and their centres cover E within L over 2.
Proved. -/

name: lemma5_cover_split111
header:
theorem lemma5_cover_split111 :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∃ s : Finset ℝ, (s.card : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) ∧
        exceptionalArcsSplit111 N η ⊆ coverSet111 N s
doc:
/-- SPLIT 9, unconditional, proved from the Lemma 4 and shift leaves. P0093 pages 162 to 165, Lemma 4 equation 7.6 and
Lemma 5 equation 7.19, with eta fixed as at the start of Section 8 so that
2 epsilon of 2 eta and epsilon of eta are below 0.01: for large N the points
where T is large are covered by at most N to the 0.01 segments of length N to
the minus 0.99. Stated for the lab exceptional set, a subset of the paper's
set O_eta. No GRH is used here. -/

name: covered_square_split111
header:
theorem covered_square_split111 (hG : GRH) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N0 < N →
      ∀ s : Finset ℝ, (s.card : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) →
        ∫ α in coverSet111 N s ∩ (Set.Icc 0 1 \ majorArcsSplit111 N),
            ‖primeSeriesSplit111 N α‖ ^ 2 ≤ B * N / (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 20 : ℝ)
doc:
/-- SPLIT 9 LEAF under GRH. P0093 page 166, Lemma 6, the GRH estimate 9.1 on the
systems F_q with q above Q, and the count in the proof of Lemma 7, equation
9.3, without the factor T to the k: for any at most N to the 0.01 segments of
length N to the minus 0.99, the integral of the squared prime series over their
minor arc part is at most B N times N to the minus one twentieth. -/

name: exceptional_square_split111
header:
theorem exceptional_square_split111 (hG : GRH) :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 ∧ ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ,
      ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N0 < N →
        ∫ α in exceptionalArcsSplit111 N η, ‖primeSeriesSplit111 N α‖ ^ 2 ≤
          B * N / (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 20 : ℝ)
doc:
/-- SPLIT 9 under GRH, proved from the two leaves above. P0093 pages 162 to 166: Lemma 4 equation 7.6,
Lemma 5 equation 7.19, Lemma 6 and the GRH estimate 9.1, assembled as in the
proof of Lemma 7, equation 9.3, before the factor T to the k is inserted. For
one fixed eta, the integral of the squared prime series over the minor points
where T is large is at most B N times N to the minus one twentieth. The lab arcs
use tau equal to N to the one seventh instead of the paper's N to the one half;
the bound N to the minus 0.05 in 9.3 still holds for that tau, see the note. -/

name: power_norm_le_split111
header:
theorem power_norm_le_split111 (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (α : ℝ) :
    ‖powerSeriesSplit111 N α‖ ≤ Real.log N / Real.log 2 + 2
doc:
/-- SPLIT 9, P0093 page 161 equation 7.1. Pointwise bound of T by its value at
zero, through the proved port power_abs_le_log357_up111. Proved. -/

name: lemma7_split111
header:
theorem lemma7_split111 (hG : GRH) :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 ∧ ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, 3 ≤ k → ∃ N0 : ℕ,
      ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N0 < N →
        ∫ α in exceptionalArcsSplit111 N η,
            ‖primeSeriesSplit111 N α‖ ^ 2 * ‖powerSeriesSplit111 N α‖ ^ k ≤
          B ^ k * N * Real.log N ^ k / (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 20 : ℝ)
doc:
/-- SPLIT 9, P0093 page 166, Lemma 7 equation 9.2. Derived from the leaf
exceptional_square_split111 and the bound T of alpha at most T of zero, which
is how 9.3 inserts the factor ln to the k of N. Proved from the leaf. -/

name: exceptional_absorb_split111
header:
theorem exceptional_absorb_split111 (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (B ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      Real.exp 1 * (B ^ k * N * Real.log N ^ k / (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 20 : ℝ)) ≤
        ε * scale111 k N
doc:
/-- SPLIT 9, P0093 page 168 after equation 10.7. The Lemma 7 bound with the
factor e of equation 2.2 is eventually below epsilon times the scale, since
B to the k times ln squared N is small against N to the one twentieth. Proved. -/

name: truncSingular111
header: noncomputable def truncSingular111 (Q n : ℕ) : ℝ
doc:
/-- P0093 page 168 equation 10.6 left side: the truncated singular series
sum over q at most Q of mu squared of q over phi squared of q times the
Ramanujan sum, written as the real cosine sum it equals. -/

name: mainTermTrunc111
header: noncomputable def mainTermTrunc111 (k N Q : ℕ) : ℝ
doc:
/-- P0093 page 165 equation 8.1 main term, with the truncated singular series at
level Q in place of the full series. Same index set as mainTerm111; every
residual N1 is even because N is even. -/

name: major_tuple_expand_split111
header:
theorem major_tuple_expand_split111 (k N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    arcContributionSplit111 k N (majorArcsSplit111 N) = Real.exp 1 *
      (∑' ν : Fin k → ℕ,
        (((∏ i, Real.exp (-((2 ^ (ν i + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) / N)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          ∫ α in majorArcsSplit111 N, primeSeriesSplit111 N α ^ 2 *
            Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * ((N : ℝ) - ∑ i, ((2 ^ (ν i + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ))) : ℝ) *
              Complex.I)).re
doc:
/-- P0093 page 165 equation 8.1 applied to the major arcs, burst 8 p3: the major arc
contribution is e times the real part of the sum over tuples of the tuple weight times the
major arc integral of S squared times e of N_1 alpha. Proved from arc_tuple_expand_split111
of Major81Split111. -/

name: major_truncated_split111
header:
theorem major_truncated_split111 (hG : GRH) (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N0 < N →
      |arcContributionSplit111 k N (majorArcsSplit111 N) -
          mainTermTrunc111 k N ⌊(N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ)⌋₊| ≤ ε * scale111 k N
doc:
/-- SPLIT 9 LEAF under GRH. P0093 Sections 3 to 6 with equation 6.4 on page 161,
Section 8 equations 8.1 and 8.2 on page 165, and equation 10.7 on page 168.
The major arc integral equals the main term built from the truncated singular
series at Q equal to N to the one tenth, up to an error that is eventually
below any epsilon times the scale. -/

name: divisor_count_le_rpow_split111
header:
theorem divisor_count_le_rpow_split111 {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, (n.divisors.card : ℝ) ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ ε
doc:
/-- SPLIT 9, divisor bound used in P0093 page 168 equation 10.5, where tau of N1
is absorbed into a small power of N. Port of the proved
LeanLab.Akeno2026.Decomp86.card_divisors_le_rpow, copied because that module is
not upstream of this one. Proved. -/

name: kernel_e_re_split111
header:
theorem kernel_e_re_split111 (x : ℝ) :
    (LeanLab.Perelli1996.Kernel.e x).re = Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x)
doc:
/-- The real part of the lab additive character e of LeanLab.Perelli1996.Kernel
is the cosine used in truncSingular111. Proved. -/

name: truncSingular_eq_re_split111
header:
theorem truncSingular_eq_re_split111 (Q n : ℕ) :
    truncSingular111 Q n =
      (∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 Q, LeanLab.Perelli1996.Series320.coefficient n q).re
doc:
/-- SPLIT 9, P0093 page 168 equation 10.6: the truncated singular series is the
real part of the partial sum of the proved Ramanujan coefficient expansion
LeanLab.Perelli1996.Series320.coefficient, which has the same terms mu squared
over phi squared times the Ramanujan sum. Proved. -/

name: singular_truncation_split111
header:
theorem singular_truncation_split111 :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N → ∀ n : ℕ, Even n → 2 ≤ n → n ≤ N →
      |truncSingular111 ⌊(N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ)⌋₊ n - singularSeries111 n| ≤
        B / (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ)
doc:
/-- SPLIT 9, unconditional, PROVED. P0093 page 168 equations 10.4 to 10.6: the tail
rho of the singular series beyond Q is at most a constant times tau of N1
times Q to the minus one half, which is at most N to the minus 0.02. Stated for
even residuals N1 between 2 and N, the only ones in the main term. The proof uses
the lab's sharper tail N1 tau of N1 over phi of N1 over Q from Perelli1996, which
gives the same N to the minus 0.02. -/

name: exponent_count_split111
header:
theorem exponent_count_split111 (k N : ℕ) [DecidablePred fun ν : Fin k → Fin (N + 1) =>
    (∀ i, 1 ≤ (ν i).val) ∧ 2 ≤ N - ∑ i, 2 ^ (ν i).val ∧ Even (N - ∑ i, 2 ^ (ν i).val)] :
    ((Finset.univ.filter fun ν : Fin k → Fin (N + 1) =>
      (∀ i, 1 ≤ (ν i).val) ∧ 2 ≤ N - ∑ i, 2 ^ (ν i).val ∧
        Even (N - ∑ i, 2 ^ (ν i).val)).card : ℕ) ≤ (Nat.log 2 N + 1) ^ k
doc:
/-- SPLIT 9, P0093 page 165 after equation 8.1: the number of residuals N1, that
is of exponent tuples, is at most a power of log N. Each exponent is at most
the base two logarithm of N. Proved. -/

name: trunc_difference_split111
header:
theorem trunc_difference_split111 (k N Q : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hS : ∀ n : ℕ, Even n → 2 ≤ n → n ≤ N →
      |truncSingular111 Q n - singularSeries111 n| ≤ δ) :
    |mainTermTrunc111 k N Q - mainTerm111 k N| ≤
      ((Nat.log 2 N + 1) ^ k : ℕ) * (δ * ((N : ℝ) / Real.log 2 ^ 2))
doc:
/-- SPLIT 9, P0093 page 168, applying 10.6 inside 8.1. Replacing the truncated
singular series by the full one changes the main term by at most the number
of tuples times the uniform truncation error times N over ln squared 2.
Proved. -/

name: trunc_absorb_split111
header:
theorem trunc_absorb_split111 (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (B ε : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ((Nat.log 2 N + 1) ^ k : ℕ) * (B / (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) * ((N : ℝ) / Real.log 2 ^ 2)) ≤
        ε * scale111 k N
doc:
/-- SPLIT 9, P0093 page 168 after equation 10.7. The truncation change of
trunc_difference_split111 with error B times N to the minus 0.02 is
eventually below epsilon times the scale. Proved. -/

name: major_error_split111
header:
theorem major_error_split111 (hG : GRH) (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N0 < N →
      |arcContributionSplit111 k N (majorArcsSplit111 N) - mainTerm111 k N| ≤
        ε * scale111 k N
doc:
/-- SPLIT piece 2 of error_bound111. P0093 Sections 3 to 6, pages 155 to 161,
the GRH Mellin estimate 5.2 on page 159, and Section 8 equations 8.1 and 8.2
on page 165 with equations 10.5 to 10.7 on page 168. For fixed k the major arc
integral equals the singular series main term up to an error that is
arbitrarily small relative to the scale. -/

name: exceptional_error_split111
header:
theorem exceptional_error_split111 (hG : GRH) :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, 3 ≤ k →
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N0 < N →
        |arcContributionSplit111 k N (exceptionalArcsSplit111 N η)| ≤
          ε * scale111 k N
doc:
/-- SPLIT piece 3 of error_bound111. P0093 pages 162 to 166, Lemmas 4 to 7,
equations 7.6, 9.1 and 9.2. Under GRH one absolute eta makes the set where T
is large so small that its minor arc contribution is arbitrarily small relative
to the scale for each fixed k. -/

name: good_minor_power_bound_split111
header:
theorem good_minor_power_bound_split111 (N : ℕ) (η α : ℝ)
    (hα : α ∈ goodMinorArcsSplit111 N η) :
    ‖powerSeriesSplit111 N α‖ ≤ (1 - η) * ‖powerSeriesSplit111 N 0‖
doc:
/-- P0093 page 167 immediately before equation 10.1. Outside the exceptional
set, T is at most the threshold one minus eta times T at zero. Proved. -/

name: minor_error_split111
header:
theorem minor_error_split111 (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (hη1 : η < 1)
    (hT : ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ α : ℝ, α ∈ goodMinorArcsSplit111 N η →
      ‖powerSeriesSplit111 N α‖ ≤ (1 - η) * ‖powerSeriesSplit111 N 0‖) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, 3 ≤ k → ∃ N0 : ℕ,
      ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N0 < N →
        |arcContributionSplit111 k N (goodMinorArcsSplit111 N η)| ≤
          C * scale111 k N * (1 - η) ^ (k - 2)
doc:
/-- SPLIT piece 4 of error_bound111. P0093 page 167 equation 10.1, with Lemma 3
of page 162, equation 7.3, from Romanov 1940. Bounding k minus 2 factors of T
by the threshold and the remaining square by Lemma 3 gives geometric decay in
k minus 2, the factor e of equation 2.2 absorbed in C. -/

name: error_bound111
header:
theorem error_bound111 (hG : GRH) :
    ∃ C η : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < η ∧ η < 1 ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, 3 ≤ k → ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N0 < N →
        |(representationCount111 k N : ℝ) - mainTerm111 k N| ≤
          5 * C * scale111 k N * (1 - η) ^ (k - 2)
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 Section 10, page 168 after equation 10.7.
This leaf includes the analytic work of Sections 3 to 10 and Romanov 1940,
reference 4, used by Lemma 3 on page 162. The geometric exponent is weakened
from k minus 1 to k minus 2 using zero less than eta less than one. -/

name: one_le_singularSeries111
header:
theorem one_le_singularSeries111 {n : ℕ} (hn : Even n) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n) :
    1 ≤ singularSeries111 n
doc:
/-- P0093 page 168 following equation 10.6. The singular series is at least one
at every positive even residual, by the existing lab Euler product proof. -/

name: cutoff_residual111
header:
theorem cutoff_residual111 {N k L : ℕ} (ν : Fin k → ℕ) (hcut : k * 2 ^ L + 2 ≤ N)
    (hν : ∀ i, 1 ≤ ν i) (hL : ∀ i, ν i ≤ L) (hN : Even N) :
    2 ≤ N - ∑ i, 2 ^ ν i ∧ Even (N - ∑ i, 2 ^ ν i)
doc: /-- P0093 Section 11, page 168. Every tuple in a small exponent box has a positive even residual. -/

name: main_weight_lower111
header:
theorem main_weight_lower111 {n N : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hnN : n ≤ N) (hev : Even n) :
    (n : ℝ) / Real.log N ^ 2 ≤ singularSeries111 n * n / Real.log n ^ 2
doc: /-- P0093 Section 11, page 168. A common logarithmic denominator bounds each positive even summand. -/

name: main_box_lower111
header:
theorem main_box_lower111 (N k L : ℕ) (hN : Even N) (hLN : L ≤ N) (hcut : k * 2 ^ L + 2 ≤ N)
 :
    (L : ℝ) ^ k * ((N - k * 2 ^ L : ℕ) : ℝ) / Real.log N ^ 2 ≤ mainTerm111 k N
doc: /-- P0093 Section 11, pages 168 and 169. The full exponent box contributes a uniform lower sum. -/

name: power_lower_of_gap111
header:
theorem power_lower_of_gap111 (k : ℕ) (t L D : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hgap : t - L ≤ D) (hlarge : 2 * k * D ≤ t) : t ^ k / 2 ≤ L ^ k
doc: /-- P0093 Section 11, page 169. Bernoulli bounds the power loss from a bounded cutoff gap. -/

name: main_lower_at111
header:
theorem main_lower_at111 (k N : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hN : 4 ≤ N) (hev : Even N)
    (hlarge : 2 * (k : ℝ) * (Real.log (2 * (k : ℝ)) / Real.log 2 + 1) ≤
      Real.log N / Real.log 2) :
    (1 / (4 * Real.log 2 ^ 2)) * scale111 k N ≤ mainTerm111 k N
doc: /-- P0093 Section 11, pages 168 and 169. An explicit logarithmic threshold suffices for the main lower bound. -/

name: main_lower111
header:
theorem main_lower111 :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, 3 ≤ k → ∃ N0 : ℕ,
      ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N0 < N → c * scale111 k N ≤ mainTerm111 k N
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 Section 11, pages 168 and 169. The main term has a uniform
positive lower coefficient for each fixed k and all sufficiently large even N.
The singular series lower bound is the assertion following equation 10.6. -/

name: choose_exponent111
header:
theorem choose_exponent111 {C c η : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hη1 : η < 1) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, 3 ≤ k ∧ 5 * C * (1 - η) ^ (k - 2) < c
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 Section 11, page 169. Choose a fixed k so the geometric error
coefficient is smaller than the positive main coefficient. -/

name: scale_pos111
header: theorem scale_pos111 (k N : ℕ) (hN : 1 < N) : 0 < scale111 k N
doc: /-- LEAF. P0093 page 169. The scale is positive once N is larger than one. -/

name: positive_of_error111
header:
theorem positive_of_error111 {q m s a c : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hac : a < c)
    (hm : c * s ≤ m) (he : |q - m| ≤ a * s) : 0 < q
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 169. A main term larger than its absolute error gives
positive representation count. This is the real arithmetic step. -/

name: linnik1951_decomposed111
header: theorem linnik1951_decomposed111 : GRH → ∃ K, AllLargeEven (LinnikAtMost K)
doc:
/-- P0093 pages 154 and 168 to 169. Assembly of the exact lab statement.
CONDITIONAL only on error_bound111. The main lower bound is proved. -/

name: minorArcs111
header: def minorArcs111 (Q τ : ℝ) : Set ℝ
doc: /-- P0093 page 166. Complement of rational major arcs inside the unit interval. -/

name: arcSystem111
header: def arcSystem111 (q : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) : Set ℝ
doc: /-- P0093 page 166. The periodic system of doubled rational arcs of denominator q. -/

name: LemmaSix111
header: def LemmaSix111 : Prop
doc:
/-- CITED. P0093 page 166 Lemma 6, with the interval length condition made explicit.
Rationals encode reduced numerators and positive denominators.
The conclusion keeps the intersection in one system, as in the paper. -/

name: dirichlet_cover111
header:
theorem dirichlet_cover111 (x τ : ℝ) (hτ : 1 ≤ τ) :
    ∃ r : ℚ, (r.den : ℝ) ≤ τ ∧ |x - r| ≤ 1 / ((r.den : ℝ) * τ)
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 166 proof of Lemma 6, first display.
Dirichlet approximation with reduced rational denominators at most tau. -/

name: interval_double111
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 166 proof of Lemma 6, final sentence.
An interval of length at most a radius, meeting the central arc, fits in its double. -/

name: lemma_six_decomposed111
header: theorem lemma_six_decomposed111 : LemmaSix111
doc: /-- P0093 page 166 Lemma 6. Assembly of the stated parameter version has no sorry. -/

name: grouped_summable280
header:
theorem grouped_summable280 (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    Summable (fun u : ℕ =>
      ((primePowerCount111 u : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(u : ℝ) / N) : ℂ))
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 162 equation 7.4, absolute convergence of the grouped
series. The geometric damping dominates the finite prime and power fibers. -/

name: product_grouped280
header:
theorem product_grouped280 (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (α : ℝ) :
    primeFourier111 N α * powerFourier111 N α =
      ∑' u : ℕ, (((primePowerCount111 u : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(u : ℝ) / N) : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * α * u) : ℝ) * Complex.I))
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 162 equation 7.4, grouping the product by p plus 2 to x.
Absolute convergence of both factors is proved in SecondMoment111. -/

name: negative_series_coefficient280
header:
theorem negative_series_coefficient280 (a : ℕ → ℂ) (ha : Summable a) (i : ℤ) :
    fourierCoeffOn (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
      (fun α => ∑' u : ℕ, a u *
        Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * α * u) : ℝ) * Complex.I)) i =
      if i ≤ 0 then a i.natAbs else 0
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 162 equation 7.4, termwise integration and the phase
integral. This is independent of primes and of the representation count. -/

name: fourier_coefficient_decomposed280
header:
theorem fourier_coefficient_decomposed280 (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (i : ℤ) :
    fourierCoeffOn (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
      (fun α => primeFourier111 N α * powerFourier111 N α) i =
        if i ≤ 0 then
          ((primePowerCount111 i.natAbs : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(i.natAbs : ℝ) / N) : ℂ)
        else 0
doc:
/-- P0093 page 162 equation 7.4. The exact statement of fourier_coefficient111
follows from the three smaller leaves. CONDITIONAL on those leaves. -/

name: characterPrime280
header:
noncomputable def characterPrime280 {q : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q)
    (N : ℕ) (α : ℝ) : ℂ
doc: /-- P0093 page 159, the character prime sum preceding equation 5.1. -/

name: MellinBound280
header: def MellinBound280 : Prop
doc:
/-- CITED. P0093 page 159 equation 5.2 with equal nonprincipal characters
and tau equal to N to the one seventh. This is the Mellin estimate used below. -/

name: majorArcs280
header: noncomputable def majorArcs280 (N : ℕ) : Set ℝ
doc:
/-- P0093 page 165 Section 8. Major arcs with Q equal to N to the one tenth
and tau equal to N to the one seventh, clipped to the unit interval. -/

name: exceptionalArcs280
header: noncomputable def exceptionalArcs280 (N : ℕ) (η : ℝ) : Set ℝ
doc: /-- P0093 pages 162 and 167. Exceptional minor points where T is large. -/

name: goodMinorArcs280
header: noncomputable def goodMinorArcs280 (N : ℕ) (η : ℝ) : Set ℝ
doc: /-- P0093 page 167 before equation 10.1. The remaining minor points. -/

name: arcContribution280
header: noncomputable def arcContribution280 (k N : ℕ) (s : Set ℝ) : ℝ
doc:
/-- P0093 pages 154 and 167 equations 2.2 and 10.2. Real contribution of a
measurable arc set, including the factor e from exponential damping. -/

name: mellin_bound280
header: theorem mellin_bound280 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) : MellinBound280
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 159 equation 5.2, from the Mellin contour shift under
GRH and Lemma 2 on pages 156 to 158. Only the diagonal case is needed here. -/

name: major_error280
header:
theorem major_error280 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) (hM : MellinBound280)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N0 < N →
      |arcContribution280 k N (majorArcs280 N) - mainTerm111 k N| ≤
        ε * scale111 k N
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 165 equations 8.1 and 8.2, and page 168 equations 10.5
to 10.7. The major arc error is arbitrarily small relative to scale for fixed k.
The Mellin input feeds the local prime square estimate of Section 6. -/

name: exceptional_error280
header:
theorem exceptional_error280 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, 3 ≤ k →
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N0 < N →
        |arcContribution280 k N (exceptionalArcs280 N η)| ≤ ε * scale111 k N
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 pages 162 to 166 Lemmas 4 to 7, equations 7.6 and 9.2.
Choose one absolute eta so the exceptional minor contribution is arbitrarily
small relative to scale for each fixed k under GRH via equation 9.1.
Enlarging to a measurable cover
bounds the actual large T set used in this statement. -/

name: good_minor_power_bound280
header:
theorem good_minor_power_bound280 (N : ℕ) (η α : ℝ)
    (hα : α ∈ goodMinorArcs280 N η) :
    ‖powerFourier111 N α‖ ≤ (1 - η) * ‖powerFourier111 N 0‖
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 167 immediately before equation 10.1.
Outside the exceptional set the power series is at most its chosen threshold. -/

name: minor_error280
header:
theorem minor_error280 (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (hη1 : η < 1)
    (hT : ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ α : ℝ, α ∈ goodMinorArcs280 N η →
      ‖powerFourier111 N α‖ ≤ (1 - η) * ‖powerFourier111 N 0‖) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, 3 ≤ k → ∃ N0 : ℕ,
      ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N0 < N →
        |arcContribution280 k N (goodMinorArcs280 N η)| ≤
          C * scale111 k N * (1 - η) ^ (k - 2)
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 167 equation 10.1 with the factor e from equation 2.2
absorbed in an absolute constant. Lemma 3 and the bound on T outside its
exceptional set give geometric decay in k minus two. -/

name: circle_partition280
header:
theorem circle_partition280 (k N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (η : ℝ) :
    (representationCount111 k N : ℝ) =
      arcContribution280 k N (majorArcs280 N) +
      arcContribution280 k N (exceptionalArcs280 N η) +
      arcContribution280 k N (goodMinorArcs280 N η)
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 154 equation 2.2 and page 167 equation 10.2.
Fourier orthogonality counts the representations and the disjoint measurable
partition of the unit interval splits its integral into three pieces. -/

name: error_bound_decomposed280
header:
theorem error_bound_decomposed280 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ C η : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < η ∧ η < 1 ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, 3 ≤ k → ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N0 < N →
        |(representationCount111 k N : ℝ) - mainTerm111 k N| ≤
          5 * C * scale111 k N * (1 - η) ^ (k - 2)
doc:
/-- P0093 page 168 after equation 10.7. The exact error_bound111 statement
follows from the six smaller leaves. CONDITIONAL on those leaves. -/

name: continuous_character_prime357
header:
theorem continuous_character_prime357 {q : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) : Continuous (characterPrime280 χ N)
doc:
/-- P0093 page 159 before equation 5.1. Character weighting preserves the
uniform geometric majorant of the damped prime series. -/

name: mellin_near357
header:
theorem mellin_near357 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) →
        ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, χ ≠ 1 →
          (∫ α in -(4 / (N : ℝ))..(4 / (N : ℝ)),
            ‖characterPrime280 χ N α‖ ^ 2) ≤
              B * (N : ℝ) / ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) * Real.log N ^ 6
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 158 equation 4.8 on both sides of zero, applied to
A_chi using page 159 equation 5.1. The central interval has radius 4 over N.
This is the local square bound, not the whole arc estimate. -/

name: mellin_positive_far357
header:
theorem mellin_positive_far357 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) →
        ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, χ ≠ 1 →
          (∫ α in (4 / (N : ℝ))..(1 / ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ))),
            ‖characterPrime280 χ N α‖ ^ 2) ≤
              B * (N : ℝ) / ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) * Real.log N ^ 10
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 158 equation 4.7 and N0 equal to N over q tau times
log cubed N, applied through page 159 equation 5.1. This is the positive
outer interval estimate with logarithmic exponent 10. -/

name: mellin_negative_far357
header:
theorem mellin_negative_far357 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) →
        ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, χ ≠ 1 →
          (∫ α in -(1 / ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)))..-(4 / (N : ℝ)),
            ‖characterPrime280 χ N α‖ ^ 2) ≤
              B * (N : ℝ) / ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) * Real.log N ^ 10
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 158 last sentence after equation 4.8. The negative
outer interval is treated analogously to equation 4.7. This estimate is
restricted to that interval and retains logarithmic exponent 10. -/

name: mellin_bound_decomposed357
header: theorem mellin_bound_decomposed357 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) : MellinBound280
doc:
/-- P0093 page 159 equation 5.2. The exact mellin_bound280 conclusion
follows by interval additivity and enlargement of logarithmic powers.
CONDITIONAL on the three local Mellin leaves. -/

name: major_to_truncated357
header:
theorem major_to_truncated357 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) (hM : MellinBound280)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N0 < N →
      |arcContribution280 k N (majorArcs280 N) - truncatedMain357 k N| ≤
        ε * scale111 k N
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 165 equation 8.1, page 166 equation 8.2 and page 168
equation 10.7. Local arc expansion and its logarithmic relative error give
the finite singular series main term. This leaf does not replace its tail
by the infinite Euler product. -/

name: truncated_to_main357
header:
theorem truncated_to_main357 (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N0 < N →
      |truncatedMain357 k N - mainTerm111 k N| ≤ ε * scale111 k N
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 168 equations 10.5 and 10.6. Summing the singular
series tail over the exponent tuples gives a negligible error. This is
arithmetic and has no GRH or Mellin hypothesis. -/

name: major_error_decomposed357
header:
theorem major_error_decomposed357 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) (hM : MellinBound280)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N0 < N →
      |arcContribution280 k N (majorArcs280 N) - mainTerm111 k N| ≤
        ε * scale111 k N
doc:
/-- P0093 page 168 equations 10.6 and 10.7. Exact major_error280 statement.
CONDITIONAL on the local major arc and arithmetic tail leaves. -/

name: measurable_major357
header: theorem measurable_major357 (N : ℕ) : MeasurableSet (majorArcs280 N)
doc: /-- P0093 pages 165 and 166. The rational major arcs form a measurable set. -/

name: measurable_exceptional357
header:
theorem measurable_exceptional357 (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (η : ℝ) :
    MeasurableSet (exceptionalArcs280 N η)
doc: /-- P0093 page 167 before equation 10.1. The actual large T minor set is measurable. -/

name: exceptional_prime_mass357
header:
theorem exceptional_prime_mass357 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ,
      ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
        (∫ α in exceptionalArcs280 N η, ‖primeFourier111 N α‖ ^ 2) ≤
          C * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 - (1 / 100 : ℝ))
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 166 proof of Lemma 7, equations 9.1 and 9.3 before
multiplication by the bound on T. Lemma 5 and the rational arc cover from
Lemma 6 give a power saving for prime square mass on the exceptional set.
The saving one hundredth is weaker than the displayed saving five hundredths. -/

name: power_uniform_log357
header:
theorem power_uniform_log357 :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ α : ℝ, ‖powerFourier111 N α‖ ≤ A * Real.log N
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 161 equation 7.1 and the triangle inequality.
The damped powers of two series is uniformly bounded by a constant times
log N. This leaf has no GRH or exceptional set hypothesis. -/

name: arc_abs_le_prime_mass357
header:
theorem arc_abs_le_prime_mass357 (k N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (s : Set ℝ)
    (hs : s ⊆ Set.Icc 0 1) (hms : MeasurableSet s) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hT : ∀ α ∈ s, ‖powerFourier111 N α‖ ≤ B) :
    |arcContribution280 k N s| ≤
      Real.exp 1 * B ^ k * (∫ α in s, ‖primeFourier111 N α‖ ^ 2)
doc:
/-- P0093 page 166 proof of Lemma 7. A uniform power series bound factors
out of the absolute arc integral, leaving only the prime square mass. -/

name: exceptional_error_decomposed357
header:
theorem exceptional_error_decomposed357 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, 3 ≤ k →
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N0 < N →
        |arcContribution280 k N (exceptionalArcs280 N η)| ≤ ε * scale111 k N
doc:
/-- P0093 page 166 equation 9.2. Exact exceptional_error280 statement.
CONDITIONAL on the exceptional prime mass and uniform T growth leaves. -/

name: count_circle_coefficient357
header:
theorem count_circle_coefficient357 (k N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    (∫ α in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      primeFourier111 N α ^ 2 * powerFourier111 N α ^ k *
        Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * N) : ℝ) * Complex.I)) =
      (Real.exp (-1) : ℂ) * (representationCount111 k N : ℂ)
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 154 equation 2.2. Termwise integration of the
absolutely convergent product counts its finite ordered representation fiber.
This is the full circle coefficient identity before any arc partition. -/

name: integral_circle_partition357
header:
theorem integral_circle_partition357 (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (η : ℝ)
    (f : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Continuous f) :
    (∫ α in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, f α) =
      (∫ α in majorArcs280 N, f α) +
      (∫ α in exceptionalArcs280 N η, f α) +
      (∫ α in goodMinorArcs280 N η, f α)
doc:
/-- P0093 page 167 partition before equation 10.1. Integrating a continuous
function over the unit interval gives the sum of its three arc integrals. -/

name: circle_partition_decomposed357
header:
theorem circle_partition_decomposed357 (k N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (η : ℝ) :
    (representationCount111 k N : ℝ) =
      arcContribution280 k N (majorArcs280 N) +
      arcContribution280 k N (exceptionalArcs280 N η) +
      arcContribution280 k N (goodMinorArcs280 N η)
doc:
/-- P0093 page 154 equation 2.2 and page 167 equation 10.2. Exact
circle_partition280 statement. CONDITIONAL on the full circle coefficient leaf. -/

name: prime_power_count_le_square357
header: theorem prime_power_count_le_square357 (u : ℕ) : primePowerCount111 u ≤ (u + 1) ^ 2
doc:
/-- P0093 page 162 definition of Psi before equation 7.4. Its finite fiber
is contained in the full square of the bounded prime and exponent indices. -/

name: square_damping_summable357
header:
theorem square_damping_summable357 (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    Summable (fun u : ℕ => ((u : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(u : ℝ) / N))
doc:
/-- P0093 page 154 damping and page 162 equation 7.4. A quadratic number
of possible pairs is summable after geometric damping. -/

name: grouped_summable_proved357
header:
theorem grouped_summable_proved357 (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    Summable (fun u : ℕ =>
      ((primePowerCount111 u : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(u : ℝ) / N) : ℂ))
doc:
/-- P0093 page 162 equation 7.4. Exact grouped_summable280 statement.
The crude finite square bound suffices. Romanov is not needed for convergence. -/

name: prime_power_fiber_equiv357
header:
noncomputable def prime_power_fiber_equiv357 (u : ℕ) :
    {t : Nat.Primes × ℕ // (t.1 : ℕ) + 2 ^ (t.2 + 1) = u} ≃
      {t : Fin (u + 1) × Fin (u + 1) //
        t.1.val.Prime ∧ 1 ≤ t.2.val ∧ u = t.1.val + 2 ^ t.2.val} where
  toFun t
doc:
/-- P0093 page 162 definition of Psi. The unbounded prime and shifted
exponent fiber is equivalent to the bounded pair set used by the finite count. -/

name: prime_power_fiber_sum357
header:
theorem prime_power_fiber_sum357 (u : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    (∑' t : {t : Nat.Primes × ℕ // (t.1 : ℕ) + 2 ^ (t.2 + 1) = u}, z) =
      (primePowerCount111 u : ℂ) * z
doc:
/-- P0093 page 162 equation 7.4. Summing a constant over a prime and power
fiber multiplies it by the exact finite representation count. -/

name: prime_power_term357
header:
theorem prime_power_term357 (N : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (p : Nat.Primes) (m : ℕ) :
    ((Real.exp (-((p : ℕ) : ℝ) / N) : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * α * (p : ℕ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I)) *
    ((Real.exp (-((2 ^ (m + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) / N) : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * α * (2 ^ (m + 1) : ℕ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I)) =
    (Real.exp (-(((p : ℕ) + 2 ^ (m + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) / N) : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * α * ((p : ℕ) + 2 ^ (m + 1) : ℕ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I)
doc:
/-- P0093 page 154 damping and page 162 equation 7.4. The product term
for one prime and one positive power depends only on their natural sum. -/

name: product_grouped_proved357
header:
theorem product_grouped_proved357 (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (α : ℝ) :
    primeFourier111 N α * powerFourier111 N α =
      ∑' u : ℕ, (((primePowerCount111 u : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(u : ℝ) / N) : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * α * u) : ℝ) * Complex.I))
doc:
/-- P0093 page 162 equation 7.4. Exact product_grouped280 statement,
proved by absolute convergence and the finite fiber equivalence. -/

name: coefficient_integral357
header:
theorem coefficient_integral357 (f : ℝ → ℂ) (i : ℤ) :
    fourierCoeffOn (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1) f i =
      ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, LeanLab.Perelli1996.Kernel.e (-(i : ℝ) * α) * f α
doc:
/-- P0093 page 162 equation 7.4. The Fourier coefficient functional is
integration against the negative integer phase on the unit interval. -/

name: negative_phase_coefficient357
header:
theorem negative_phase_coefficient357 (u : ℕ) (i : ℤ) :
    fourierCoeffOn (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
      (fun α => Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * α * u) : ℝ) * Complex.I)) i =
      if i = -(u : ℤ) then 1 else 0
doc:
/-- P0093 page 162 equation 7.4. Integer phase orthogonality for one
negative natural frequency, reusing the proved lab phase integral. -/

name: coefficient_tsum357
header:
theorem coefficient_tsum357 (a : ℕ → ℂ) (ha : Summable a) (i : ℤ) :
    fourierCoeffOn (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
      (fun α => ∑' u : ℕ, a u *
        Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * α * u) : ℝ) * Complex.I)) i =
      ∑' u : ℕ, a u * (if i = -(u : ℤ) then 1 else 0)
doc:
/-- P0093 page 162 equation 7.4. Absolute summability permits termwise
integration against any fixed Fourier phase. -/

name: negative_series_coefficient_proved357
header:
theorem negative_series_coefficient_proved357 (a : ℕ → ℂ) (ha : Summable a) (i : ℤ) :
    fourierCoeffOn (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
      (fun α => ∑' u : ℕ, a u *
        Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * α * u) : ℝ) * Complex.I)) i =
      if i ≤ 0 then a i.natAbs else 0
doc:
/-- P0093 page 162 equation 7.4. Exact negative_series_coefficient280
statement, with no prime or representation count assumption. -/

name: fourier_coefficient_proved357
header:
theorem fourier_coefficient_proved357 (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (i : ℤ) :
    fourierCoeffOn (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
      (fun α => primeFourier111 N α * powerFourier111 N α) i =
        if i ≤ 0 then
          ((primePowerCount111 i.natAbs : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(i.natAbs : ℝ) / N) : ℂ)
        else 0
doc:
/-- P0093 page 162 equation 7.4. Exact fourier_coefficient111 statement,
now using only the three clean convergence, grouping and integration proofs. -/

name: parseval_second_moment_proved357
header:
theorem parseval_second_moment_proved357 (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    (∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖primeFourier111 N α * powerFourier111 N α‖ ^ 2) =
      ∑' u : ℕ, (primePowerCount111 u : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (-2 * u / N)
doc: /-- P0093 page 162 equation 7.4. Parseval with the proved finite coefficient identity. -/

name: lemma_three_proved357
header: theorem lemma_three_proved357 : LemmaThree111
doc: /-- P0093 page 162 Lemma 3. The proved Romanov moment and clean Parseval give the bound. -/

name: power_abs_le_log357
header:
theorem power_abs_le_log357 (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (α : ℝ) :
    ‖powerFourier111 N α‖ ≤ Real.log N / Real.log 2 + 2
doc:
/-- P0093 page 161 equation 7.1. Split at the integer base two logarithm.
The initial terms are at most one and the dyadic tail has sum at most two. -/

name: power_uniform_log_proved357
header:
theorem power_uniform_log_proved357 :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ α : ℝ, ‖powerFourier111 N α‖ ≤ A * Real.log N
doc:
/-- P0093 page 161 equation 7.1. Exact power_uniform_log357 statement,
with explicit A equal to one over log 2 plus two and log N at least one. -/

name: arc_abs_le_mixed_mass357
header:
theorem arc_abs_le_mixed_mass357 (k N : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (s : Set ℝ) (hs : s ⊆ Set.Icc 0 1) (hms : MeasurableSet s)
    (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hT : ∀ α ∈ s, ‖powerFourier111 N α‖ ≤ B) :
    |arcContribution280 k N s| ≤ Real.exp 1 * B ^ (k - 2) *
      (∫ α in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖primeFourier111 N α * powerFourier111 N α‖ ^ 2)
doc:
/-- P0093 page 167 equation 10.1. Factor k minus two powers of T from
the arc norm and compare its remaining square integral with the full circle. -/

name: additive_power_le_twice357
header:
theorem additive_power_le_twice357 (r : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hlarge : 2 * (r : ℝ) ≤ t * Real.log 2) : (t + 2) ^ r ≤ 2 * t ^ r
doc:
/-- P0093 page 167 equation 10.1. A fixed power of a bounded additive
logarithmic error costs at most two once the logarithm is sufficiently large. -/

name: minor_error_proved357
header:
theorem minor_error_proved357 (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (hη1 : η < 1)
    (hT : ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ α : ℝ, α ∈ goodMinorArcs280 N η →
      ‖powerFourier111 N α‖ ≤ (1 - η) * ‖powerFourier111 N 0‖) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, 3 ≤ k → ∃ N0 : ℕ,
      ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N0 < N →
        |arcContribution280 k N (goodMinorArcs280 N η)| ≤
          C * scale111 k N * (1 - η) ^ (k - 2)
doc:
/-- P0093 page 167 equation 10.1. Exact minor_error280 statement.
The pointwise complementary bound, clean Lemma 3 and dyadic growth suffice. -/

name: character_prime_reflect357
header:
theorem character_prime_reflect357 {q : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q)
    (N : ℕ) (α : ℝ) :
    characterPrime280 (star χ) N α = conj (characterPrime280 χ N (-α))
doc:
/-- P0093 page 158 final sentence and page 159 character sum definition.
Reflection of the phase conjugates the character weighted prime series. -/

name: character_norm_reflect357
header:
theorem character_norm_reflect357 {q : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q)
    (N : ℕ) (α : ℝ) :
    ‖characterPrime280 χ N (-α)‖ = ‖characterPrime280 (star χ) N α‖
doc:
/-- P0093 page 158 final sentence. The reflected square norm equals the
square norm for the conjugate character on the positive side. -/

name: residualTuples357
header: noncomputable def residualTuples357 (k N : ℕ) : Finset (Fin k → Fin (N + 1))
doc:
/-- P0093 page 168 after equation 10.7. Positive exponent tuples with
positive even residual, exactly as in the existing main term. -/

name: residual_exponent_le357
header:
theorem residual_exponent_le357 (k N : ℕ) (ν : Fin k → Fin (N + 1))
    (hν : ν ∈ residualTuples357 k N) (i : Fin k) : (ν i).val ≤ Nat.log 2 N
doc:
/-- P0093 page 166 before equation 8.2. Every exponent of a contributing
tuple is at most the integer base two logarithm of N. -/

name: residual_card_bound357
header:
theorem residual_card_bound357 (k N : ℕ) :
    (residualTuples357 k N).card ≤ (Nat.log 2 N + 1) ^ k
doc:
/-- P0093 page 166 before equation 8.2. The bounded exponent tuples
inject into the full logarithmic box. -/

name: residual_weight_upper357
header:
theorem residual_weight_upper357 (n N : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hnN : n ≤ N) :
    (n : ℝ) / Real.log n ^ 2 ≤ (N : ℝ) / Real.log 2 ^ 2
doc:
/-- P0093 page 168 equation 10.6. A residual weight is bounded by the
common upper weight N over log squared 2. -/

name: singular_tail357
header:
theorem singular_tail357 :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → n ≤ N → Even n →
        |truncatedSingular357 N n - singularSeries111 n| ≤
          C * (N : ℝ) ^ (-(1 / 100 : ℝ))
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 168 equations 10.5 and 10.6. The finite Ramanujan
series differs from the Euler product by a uniform negative power of N for
positive even residuals at most N. Saving one hundredth weakens the printed
two hundredths. This leaf has no tuple or circle method integral. -/

name: truncated_error_card357
header:
theorem truncated_error_card357 (k N : ℕ) (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hTail : ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → n ≤ N → Even n →
      |truncatedSingular357 N n - singularSeries111 n| ≤ D) :
    |truncatedMain357 k N - mainTerm111 k N| ≤
      ((Nat.log 2 N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k * D * ((N : ℝ) / Real.log 2 ^ 2)
doc:
/-- P0093 page 168 equations 10.5 and 10.6. A pointwise coefficient tail
bounds the total error by its constant bound times the logarithmic box size. -/

name: truncated_to_main_from_tail357
header:
theorem truncated_to_main_from_tail357 (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N0 < N →
      |truncatedMain357 k N - mainTerm111 k N| ≤ ε * scale111 k N
doc:
/-- P0093 page 168 equation 10.6. Exact truncated_to_main357 statement,
CONDITIONAL only on the pointwise arithmetic singular tail leaf. -/

name: error_bound_refined357
header:
theorem error_bound_refined357 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ C η : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < η ∧ η < 1 ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, 3 ≤ k → ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N0 < N →
        |(representationCount111 k N : ℝ) - mainTerm111 k N| ≤
          5 * C * scale111 k N * (1 - η) ^ (k - 2)
doc:
/-- P0093 page 168 after equation 10.7. Exact error_bound111 statement.
CONDITIONAL on six independent analytic and counting supply leaves. -/

name: linnik1951_refined357
header: theorem linnik1951_refined357 : GRH → ∃ K, AllLargeEven (LinnikAtMost K)
doc:
/-- P0093 pages 168 and 169. Exact original GRH existence conclusion.
CONDITIONAL on the six supply leaves in error_bound_refined357. -/

name: divisor_dependent_tail376
header:
theorem divisor_dependent_tail376 :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → n ≤ N → Even n →
        |truncatedSingular357 N n - singularSeries111 n| ≤
          C * (n.divisors.card : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (-(1 / 20 : ℝ))
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 168 first inequality in equation 10.5, followed by
identification of the complete series in equation 10.6. The cutoff is
Q equal to N to the one tenth. This retains the divisor count loss and
does not assert any uniform decay as the residual varies. -/

name: singular_tail_decomposed376
header:
theorem singular_tail_decomposed376 :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → n ≤ N → Even n →
        |truncatedSingular357 N n - singularSeries111 n| ≤
          C * (N : ℝ) ^ (-(1 / 100 : ℝ))
doc:
/-- P0093 page 168 equations 10.5 and 10.6. Exact singular_tail357
statement. Both arithmetic inputs now have clean proofs. The proof
retains the residual bound n at most N and the positive even hypotheses. -/

name: central_pointwise376
header:
theorem central_pointwise376 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) →
        ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, χ ≠ 1 → ∀ α : ℝ,
          |α| ≤ 4 / (N : ℝ) →
            ‖characterPrime280 χ N α‖ ^ 2 ≤
              B * (N : ℝ) ^ 2 / ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) * Real.log N ^ 6
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 158 pointwise estimate immediately before equation
4.8, transferred to the nonprincipal character sum by page 159 equation
5.1. This is the squared bound on the central interval only. It has no
integration or outer interval conclusion. -/

name: mellin_near_decomposed376
header:
theorem mellin_near_decomposed376 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) →
        ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, χ ≠ 1 →
          (∫ α in -(4 / (N : ℝ))..(4 / (N : ℝ)),
            ‖characterPrime280 χ N α‖ ^ 2) ≤
              B * (N : ℝ) / ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) * Real.log N ^ 6
doc:
/-- P0093 page 158 equation 4.8. Exact mellin_near357 statement from the
central pointwise estimate. The interval has length eight over N.
CONDITIONAL only on central_pointwise376. -/

name: exceptional_system_cover376
header:
theorem exceptional_system_cover376 :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 ∧ ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ,
      ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N → ∃ S : Finset ℕ,
        (S.card : ℝ) ≤ A * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) ∧
        (∀ q ∈ S, (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) ∧
          (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) ∧
        exceptionalArcs280 N η ⊆
          ⋃ q ∈ S, arcSystem111 q ((N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) ∩ Set.Icc 0 1
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 165 Lemma 5 and page 166 Lemma 6. Choose eta so
that the large T minor set is covered by at most A N to one hundredth
systems of doubled rational arcs. This is a geometric statement without
GRH and without an integral of the prime series. -/

name: doubled_system_mass376
header:
theorem doubled_system_mass376 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ q : ℕ, (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) →
        (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) →
          (∫ α in arcSystem111 q ((N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) ∩ Set.Icc 0 1,
            ‖primeFourier111 N α‖ ^ 2) ≤ C * (N : ℝ) ^ (98 / 100 : ℝ)
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 166 equation 9.1 and its use in equation 9.3.
For one doubled system with denominator between Q and tau, the prime
square integral has a fixed power saving. Exponent ninety eight
hundredths weakens the displayed local estimates after logarithmic
absorption. This leaf has no exceptional set or covering count. -/

name: finite_cover_integral376
header:
theorem finite_cover_integral376 (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    (s : Set ℝ) (S : Finset ℕ) (t : ℕ → Set ℝ)
    (hi : ∀ q ∈ S, IntegrableOn f (t q))
    (hcover : s ⊆ ⋃ q ∈ S, t q) :
    (∫ x in s, f x) ≤ ∑ q ∈ S, ∫ x in t q, f x
doc:
/-- P0093 page 166 proof of Lemma 7. A finite cover bounds the integral
of a nonnegative function by the sum of its integrals on the covering
sets. The sets need not be disjoint. -/

name: exceptional_prime_mass_decomposed376
header:
theorem exceptional_prime_mass_decomposed376 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ,
      ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
        (∫ α in exceptionalArcs280 N η, ‖primeFourier111 N α‖ ^ 2) ≤
          C * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 - (1 / 100 : ℝ))
doc:
/-- P0093 page 166 equation 9.3 before the T bound. Exact
exceptional_prime_mass357 statement. CONDITIONAL on the geometric cover
and the local doubled system prime mass estimate. -/

name: majorRelative376
header: noncomputable def majorRelative376 (k N : ℕ) : ℝ
doc:
/-- P0093 page 168 left side of equation 10.7 without its implicit
constant. This is the nonnegative logarithmic relative correction,
retaining the finite singular coefficient at each residual. -/

name: major_expansion_remainder376
header:
theorem major_expansion_remainder376 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) (hM : MellinBound280)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N0 < N →
      |arcContribution280 k N (majorArcs280 N) - truncatedMain357 k N| ≤
        A * majorRelative376 k N +
          A * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 - (1 / 1000 : ℝ)) * Real.log N ^ (k + 13)
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 165 equation 8.1 and page 166 equation 8.2.
The local major arc expansion leaves its logarithmic relative correction
explicit. The other term weakens the power saving in equation 8.2.
No estimate for the relative correction is included here. -/

name: major_relative_negligible376
header:
theorem major_relative_negligible376 (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N0 < N →
      majorRelative376 k N ≤ ε * scale111 k N
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 168 equation 10.7. The logarithmic relative
correction is negligible compared with scale for fixed k. This arithmetic
summation has no GRH or Mellin hypothesis and contains no arc integral. -/

name: major_to_truncated_decomposed376
header:
theorem major_to_truncated_decomposed376 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) (hM : MellinBound280)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N0 < N →
      |arcContribution280 k N (majorArcs280 N) - truncatedMain357 k N| ≤
        ε * scale111 k N
doc:
/-- P0093 page 168 equation 10.7. Exact major_to_truncated357 statement.
CONDITIONAL on the local expansion and arithmetic relative correction
leaves. Fixed logarithmic powers are absorbed using the proved bound. -/

name: large_value_intervals376
header:
theorem large_value_intervals376 :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 ∧ ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ,
      ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N → ∃ I : Finset (ℝ × ℝ),
        (I.card : ℝ) ≤ A * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) ∧
        (∀ p ∈ I, p.2 - p.1 ≤ 1 / ((N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) ^ 2) ∧
        {α : ℝ | α ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 ∧
          (1 - η) * ‖powerFourier111 N 0‖ < ‖powerFourier111 N α‖} ⊆
          ⋃ p ∈ I, Set.Icc p.1 p.2
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 165 Lemma 5 and the fixed eta choice at the start
of Section 8. The large T set has a finite interval cover with at most
A N to one hundredth intervals. Their lengths are at most one over tau
squared for tau equal to N to one seventh and sufficiently large N.
This leaf has no rational approximation or prime square integral. -/

name: interval_system_bounded376
header:
theorem interval_system_bounded376 (Q τ l u : ℝ) (hτ : 1 ≤ τ)
    (hlen : u - l ≤ 1 / τ ^ 2)
    (hmeet : (Set.Icc l u ∩ minorArcs111 Q τ).Nonempty) :
    ∃ q : ℕ, Q ≤ (q : ℝ) ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ τ ∧
      Set.Icc l u ∩ minorArcs111 Q τ ⊆ arcSystem111 q τ
doc:
/-- P0093 page 166 proof of Lemma 6. Retain the upper denominator
bound supplied by Dirichlet approximation, as well as the lower bound
from exclusion of the major arcs. -/

name: exceptional_subset_minor376
header:
theorem exceptional_subset_minor376 (N : ℕ) (η : ℝ) :
    exceptionalArcs280 N η ⊆
      minorArcs111 ((N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ)) ((N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ))
doc:
/-- P0093 pages 166 and 167. Membership in the actual exceptional set
implies the rational minor arc condition used by Lemma 6. -/

name: exceptional_system_cover_proved376
header:
theorem exceptional_system_cover_proved376 :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 ∧ ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ,
      ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N → ∃ S : Finset ℕ,
        (S.card : ℝ) ≤ A * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) ∧
        (∀ q ∈ S, (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) ∧
          (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) ∧
        exceptionalArcs280 N η ⊆
          ⋃ q ∈ S, arcSystem111 q ((N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) ∩ Set.Icc 0 1
doc:
/-- P0093 page 166 Lemma 6 applied to the interval cover from Lemma 5.
Exact exceptional_system_cover376 statement, CONDITIONAL only on the
entropy interval cover. The finite image cannot increase the cover count. -/

name: differenceKernel376
header: noncomputable def differenceKernel376 (T : ℝ) : ℝ
doc:
/-- P0093 page 158 after equation 4.6. The reciprocal difference kernel
integrated over the square frequency box of radius T. -/

name: sumKernel376
header: noncomputable def sumKernel376 (T : ℝ) : ℝ
doc:
/-- P0093 page 158 negative frequency sum case before equation 4.7.
The exponentially decreasing sum kernel on the same square box. -/

name: difference_kernel_le376
header:
theorem difference_kernel_le376 (T : ℝ) (hT : 1 ≤ T) :
    differenceKernel376 T ≤ 8 * T * Real.log (2 * T + 1)
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 158 positive frequency sum case after equation
4.6. Integrating the reciprocal difference kernel costs a factor
T log of 2T plus 1. The constant eight enlarges the elementary bound. -/

name: sum_kernel_le376
header:
theorem sum_kernel_le376 (T : ℝ) (hT : 1 ≤ T) :
    sumKernel376 T ≤ 16 * T
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 158 negative frequency sum case before equation
4.7. Integrating the decaying sum kernel costs a factor T. The constant
sixteen enlarges the full line exponential integral estimate. -/

name: outer_to_kernels376
header:
theorem outer_to_kernels376 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) →
        ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, χ ≠ 1 →
          (∫ α in (4 / (N : ℝ))..(1 / ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ))),
            ‖characterPrime280 χ N α‖ ^ 2) ≤
              B * Real.log N ^ 6 * differenceKernel376
                ((N : ℝ) / ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) * Real.log N ^ 3) +
              B * Real.log N ^ 7 * sumKernel376
                ((N : ℝ) / ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) * Real.log N ^ 3) + B
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 pages 157 and 158 equation 4.4 through the two estimates after
4.6, transferred by page 159 equation 5.1. Retain the two real frequency
kernels rather than estimating them. The final constant term absorbs
the exponentially small contour truncation remainder. -/

name: frequency_window_log376
header:
theorem frequency_window_log376 (x R : ℝ) (hx : 3 ≤ x) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hRx : R ≤ x) :
    Real.log (2 * (R * Real.log x ^ 3) + 1) ≤ 5 * Real.log x
doc:
/-- P0093 page 158 substitution before equation 4.7. When the frequency
radius is at most N log cubed N, its logarithm is at most 5 log N. -/

name: mellin_positive_far_decomposed376
header:
theorem mellin_positive_far_decomposed376 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) →
        ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, χ ≠ 1 →
          (∫ α in (4 / (N : ℝ))..(1 / ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ))),
            ‖characterPrime280 χ N α‖ ^ 2) ≤
              B * (N : ℝ) / ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) * Real.log N ^ 10
doc:
/-- P0093 page 158 equation 4.7 with its frequency radius substitution.
Exact mellin_positive_far357 statement. CONDITIONAL only on the contour
comparison. Both explicit real kernel bounds are proved. -/

name: large_value_measure412
header:
theorem large_value_measure412 :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 / 2 ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ,
      ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
        volume.real {α : ℝ | α ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 2 ∧
          (1 - 2 * η) * ‖powerFourier111 N 0‖ < ‖powerFourier111 N α‖} ≤
            C * (N : ℝ) ^ ((1 / 200 : ℝ) - 1)
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 162 Lemma 4 equation 7.6 and page 165 after
7.19. Choose eta small enough for exponent one two hundredth at level
two eta. Periodicity extends the unit interval bound to minus one through
two. This is only a measure estimate and contains no covering statement. -/

name: large_value_stability412
header:
theorem large_value_stability412 (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N → ∀ α ξ : ℝ,
      |ξ| ≤ 1 / ((N : ℝ) * Real.log N) →
      (1 - η) * ‖powerFourier111 N 0‖ < ‖powerFourier111 N α‖ →
      (1 - 2 * η) * ‖powerFourier111 N 0‖ < ‖powerFourier111 N (α + ξ)‖
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 165 proof of Lemma 5, the two displays involving
xi and Delta. For a fixed positive eta, a shift of at most one over
N log N sends the eta large value set into the two eta large value set.
This is local stability only, without measure or cardinality estimates. -/

name: log_le_small_power412
header:
theorem log_le_small_power412 :
    ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      Real.log N ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ)
doc:
/-- P0093 page 165 proof of Lemma 5. A positive power absorbs log N.
This is the special case needed after dividing the measure by Delta. -/

name: large_value_intervals_decomposed412
header:
theorem large_value_intervals_decomposed412 :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 ∧ ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ,
      ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N → ∃ I : Finset (ℝ × ℝ),
        (I.card : ℝ) ≤ A * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) ∧
        (∀ p ∈ I, p.2 - p.1 ≤ 1 / ((N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) ^ 2) ∧
        {α : ℝ | α ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 ∧
          (1 - η) * ‖powerFourier111 N 0‖ < ‖powerFourier111 N α‖} ⊆
          ⋃ p ∈ I, Set.Icc p.1 p.2
doc:
/-- P0093 page 165 Lemma 5 followed by the fixed eta choice in Section
8. Exact large_value_intervals376 statement, assembled from the smaller
measure and stability leaves and the finite grid packing theorem.
CONDITIONAL on large_value_measure412 and large_value_stability412. -/

name: finite_large_value_measure412
header:
theorem finite_large_value_measure412 :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 / 2 ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ,
      ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
        volume.real {α : ℝ | α ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 2 ∧
          (1 - η) * ‖powerTrunc412 N 0‖ < ‖powerTrunc412 N α‖} ≤
            C * (N : ℝ) ^ ((1 / 200 : ℝ) - 1)
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 162 equation 7.7 through page 165 equation 7.19.
The alignment, binary run count and entropy estimate bound the large
value set of the finite polynomial. The damping tail and passage back
to the infinite series are excluded from this leaf. The printed exponent
tends to zero, so choose the fixed saving one two hundredth here. -/

name: large_value_measure_proved412
header:
theorem large_value_measure_proved412 :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 / 2 ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ,
      ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
        volume.real {α : ℝ | α ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 2 ∧
          (1 - 2 * η) * ‖powerFourier111 N 0‖ < ‖powerFourier111 N α‖} ≤
            C * (N : ℝ) ^ ((1 / 200 : ℝ) - 1)
doc:
/-- P0093 page 162 equation 7.7 and page 165 conclusion of Lemma 4.
Exact large_value_measure412 statement. The infinite series truncation
has a proved bounded error. CONDITIONAL only on the finite binary
entropy estimate, not on an additional analytic tail assertion. -/

name: finite_phase_concentration412
header:
theorem finite_phase_concentration412 (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεhalf : ε < 1 / 2)
    (r : ℕ) :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 / 2 ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ α : ℝ, α ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 2 →
        (1 - η) * ‖powerTrunc412 N 0‖ < ‖powerTrunc412 N α‖ →
          (1 - ε) * (Nat.log 2 N : ℝ) ≤
            (nearIntegerIndices412 (Nat.log 2 N) r α).card
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 162 equations 7.8 and 7.9 and page 163 through
7.11. Choosing a small large value margin forces any prescribed fraction
of the dyadic phases within any prescribed fixed binary radius of an
