integer. This is only phase concentration. It has no measure estimate
and no binary word count. Parameters replace the printed intermediate
constants, since the proof lets eta tend to zero. -/

name: binary_entropy_measure412
header:
theorem binary_entropy_measure412 (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 / 2 ∧ ∃ r : ℕ, 4 ≤ r ∧
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ M0 : ℕ, ∀ M : ℕ, M0 < M →
        volume.real {α : ℝ | α ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 2 ∧
          (1 - ε) * (M : ℝ) ≤ (nearIntegerIndices412 M r α).card} ≤
            C * (2 : ℝ) ^ ((M : ℝ) * (δ - 1))
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 163 binary expansion 7.12 through page 165
7.19. For any positive entropy exponent choose a small exceptional
fraction and a long binary run radius so that the corresponding set
of phases has measure at most C times two to M times delta minus one.
This contains only the binary dynamics and their measure, without any
Fourier sum or damping parameter N. -/

name: dyadic_measure_scale412
header:
theorem dyadic_measure_scale412 (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (a : ℝ)
    (ha : -1 ≤ a) (ha0 : a ≤ 0) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ ((Nat.log 2 N : ℝ) * a) ≤ 2 * (N : ℝ) ^ a
doc:
/-- P0093 page 165 conversion from binary length to N after 7.19.
For a negative exponent a between negative one and zero, using the
integer logarithm costs at most a factor two. -/

name: finite_large_value_measure_decomposed412
header:
theorem finite_large_value_measure_decomposed412 :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 / 2 ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ,
      ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
        volume.real {α : ℝ | α ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 2 ∧
          (1 - η) * ‖powerTrunc412 N 0‖ < ‖powerTrunc412 N α‖} ≤
            C * (N : ℝ) ^ ((1 / 200 : ℝ) - 1)
doc:
/-- P0093 pages 162 to 165 proof of Lemma 4 after truncation.
Exact finite_large_value_measure412 statement, assembled from the
strictly smaller phase concentration and binary entropy leaves.
CONDITIONAL only on those two inputs. -/

name: weighted_phase_alignment435
header:
theorem weighted_phase_alignment435 (ε ρ : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 / 2 ∧ ∀ M : ℕ,
      ∀ w θ : ℕ → ℝ,
        (∀ m ∈ range M, Real.exp (-1) ≤ w m ∧ w m ≤ 1) →
        (1 - η) * (∑ m ∈ range M, w m) <
          ‖∑ m ∈ range M, (w m : ℂ) *
            Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * θ m) : ℝ) * Complex.I)‖ →
        ∃ φ : ℝ, ∃ S : Finset ℕ, S ⊆ range M ∧
          (1 - ε) * (M : ℝ) ≤ S.card ∧
          ∀ m ∈ S, ∃ z : ℤ, |θ m - φ - z| ≤ ρ
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 162 equations 7.8 and 7.9 through page 163
7.10. A nearly maximal weighted sum of unit phases forces almost all
phases close to one common rotation. The weights lie between exp of
negative one and one. This parameter version keeps only the weighted
cosine deficit argument. There is no dyadic recurrence, near integer
conclusion or measure estimate. -/

name: finite_phase_concentration_decomposed435
header:
theorem finite_phase_concentration_decomposed435 (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεhalf : ε < 1 / 2)
    (r : ℕ) :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 1 / 2 ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ α : ℝ, α ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 2 →
        (1 - η) * ‖powerTrunc412 N 0‖ < ‖powerTrunc412 N α‖ →
          (1 - ε) * (Nat.log 2 N : ℝ) ≤
            (nearIntegerIndices412 (Nat.log 2 N) r α).card
doc:
/-- P0093 page 163 equation 7.11. Exact finite_phase_concentration412
statement, assembled from weighted alignment and the proved adjacent
pair rotation removal. Both components now have clean proofs. -/

name: doubled_system_expansion435
header:
theorem doubled_system_expansion435 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) →
        (∫ α in arcSystem111 q ((N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) ∩ Set.Icc 0 1,
          ‖primeFourier111 N α‖ ^ 2) ≤
          C * ((N : ℝ) / q.totient / Real.log N +
            (N : ℝ) * Real.log N ^ 13 *
              (1 / (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) +
                2 / Real.sqrt ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ))))
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 166 equation 9.1. Retain the principal totient
term and both explicit error denominators from the displayed formula.
The Mobius square is at most one. The fixed positive constant absorbs
its coefficient and the error constant. The derivation is the stated
modification of page 156 equation 3.4 through page 161 equation 6.4.
There is no uniform power saving in this leaf. -/

name: doubled_system_mass_decomposed435
header:
theorem doubled_system_mass_decomposed435 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ q : ℕ, (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) →
        (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) →
          (∫ α in arcSystem111 q ((N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) ∩ Set.Icc 0 1,
            ‖primeFourier111 N α‖ ^ 2) ≤ C * (N : ℝ) ^ (98 / 100 : ℝ)
doc:
/-- P0093 page 166 equation 9.1 used in 9.3. Exact
 doubled_system_mass376 statement. CONDITIONAL only on the explicit
local expansion. Totient saving and logarithmic absorption are proved. -/

name: prime_product_series_tail_proved439
header:
theorem prime_product_series_tail_proved439 :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → n ≤ N → Even n →
        |(∏ p ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 ⌊(N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ)⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime,
            (if p ∣ n then 1 + 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1) else 1 - 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2)) -
          (∑' q : ℕ, ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (q.totient : ℝ) ^ 2) *
            (LeanLab.Perelli1996.Ramanujan103.ramanujanSum q n).re)| ≤
          C * (N : ℝ) ^ (-(1 / 100 : ℝ))
doc:
/-- P0093 page 168 equations 10.5 and 10.6. Exact sealed
prime_product_series_tail357 statement. Smooth Euler sums and the absolute
coefficient tail give the uniform rate without any uniform bound on the full product. -/

name: truncated_sum_euler_error_proved439
header:
theorem truncated_sum_euler_error_proved439 :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → n ≤ N → Even n →
        |truncatedSingular357 N n -
          (∏ p ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 ⌊(N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ)⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime,
            (if p ∣ n then 1 + 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1) else 1 - 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2))| ≤
          C * (N : ℝ) ^ (-(1 / 100 : ℝ))
doc:
/-- P0093 page 168 equations 10.5 and 10.6. Exact sealed
truncated_sum_euler_error357 statement. Insert the complete series between
the modulus cutoff and the prime cutoff. Both error estimates are proved. -/

name: central_kernel_mass442
header:
theorem central_kernel_mass442 :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ α : ℝ, |α| ≤ 4 / (N : ℝ) →
        Integrable (fun t : ℝ => ‖mellinKernel442 N α t‖ *
          Real.log ((N : ℝ) * (|t| + 2)) ^ 3) ∧
        (∫ t : ℝ, ‖mellinKernel442 N α t‖ *
          Real.log ((N : ℝ) * (|t| + 2)) ^ 3) ≤
            C * Real.sqrt N * Real.log N ^ 3
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 156 equation 4.1 and page 158 central estimate
before equation 4.8. On the central interval absolute Gamma decay gives
an integrable logarithm weighted kernel with mass at most a constant
times square root N times log cubed N. This retains only the absolute
kernel calculation. There is no coefficient M, character, GRH or radius R. -/

name: lemma2_central_decomposed442
header:
theorem lemma2_central_decomposed442 (B0 : ℝ) (hB0 : 0 < B0) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N → ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R →
      R ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (2 / 7 : ℝ) → ∀ M : ℝ → ℂ, LineBound1622 N B0 M →
        ∀ α : ℝ, |α| ≤ 4 / (N : ℝ) →
          ‖mellinU1622 N M α‖ ≤ B * (N : ℝ) / Real.sqrt R * Real.log N ^ 3
doc:
/-- P0093 page 158 central estimate before equation 4.8. Exact
lemma2_central1622 statement. The absolute kernel mass now has a clean proof.
The coefficient domination and the radius scaling have clean proofs. -/

name: lineBound_one442
header: theorem lineBound_one442 : LineBound1622 4 1 (fun _ => 1)
doc:
/-- P0093 page 156 equation 4.1. A nonzero concrete coefficient on
the line at N equal to four and B0 equal to one. -/

name: central_pointwise_decomposed442
header:
theorem central_pointwise_decomposed442 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) →
        ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, χ ≠ 1 → ∀ α : ℝ,
          |α| ≤ 4 / (N : ℝ) →
            ‖characterPrime280 χ N α‖ ^ 2 ≤
              B * (N : ℝ) ^ 2 / ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) * Real.log N ^ 6
doc:
/-- P0093 page 158 central estimate and page 159 equation 5.1.
Exact central_pointwise376 statement. CONDITIONAL on the absolute
kernel mass and the existing corrected Mellin transfer. -/

name: abstract_outer_kernels442
header:
theorem abstract_outer_kernels442 (B0 : ℝ) (hB0 : 0 < B0) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R → R ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (2 / 7 : ℝ) →
        ∀ M : ℝ → ℂ, LineBound1622 N B0 M →
          IntervalIntegrable (fun α : ℝ => ‖mellinU1622 N M α‖ ^ 2) volume
            (4 / (N : ℝ)) (1 / R) ∧
          (∫ α in (4 / (N : ℝ))..(1 / R), ‖mellinU1622 N M α‖ ^ 2) ≤
            A * Real.log N ^ 6 * differenceKernel376 ((N : ℝ) / R * Real.log N ^ 3) +
            A * Real.log N ^ 7 * sumKernel376 ((N : ℝ) / R * Real.log N ^ 3) + A
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 158 equations 4.4 through 4.6. After truncating
the contour, the two frequency sign regions give the difference and
sum kernels. This retains only the abstract Mellin integral U.
There is no character, prime series or GRH. The constant term absorbs
the exponentially small contour remainder on page 157 equation 4.3. -/

name: difference_kernel_lower442
header:
theorem difference_kernel_lower442 (T : ℝ) (hT : 1 ≤ T) :
    T ≤ differenceKernel376 T
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 158 reciprocal difference kernel after equation
4.6. Its integral on the square box is at least T when T is at least
one. This lower bound absorbs the prime power transfer error only. -/

name: outer_to_kernels_decomposed442
header:
theorem outer_to_kernels_decomposed442 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) →
        ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, χ ≠ 1 →
          (∫ α in (4 / (N : ℝ))..(1 / ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ))),
            ‖characterPrime280 χ N α‖ ^ 2) ≤
              B * Real.log N ^ 6 * differenceKernel376
                ((N : ℝ) / ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) * Real.log N ^ 3) +
              B * Real.log N ^ 7 * sumKernel376
                ((N : ℝ) / ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) * Real.log N ^ 3) + B
doc:
/-- P0093 pages 158 and 159 equations 4.4 through 5.1. Exact
outer_to_kernels376 statement. CONDITIONAL on abstract_outer_kernels442
and the existing Mellin transfer. The transfer error is absorbed by
the proved lower bound for the nonnegative difference kernel. -/

name: lemma2_outer_decomposed442
header:
theorem lemma2_outer_decomposed442 (B0 : ℝ) (hB0 : 0 < B0) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N → ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R →
      R ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (2 / 7 : ℝ) → ∀ M : ℝ → ℂ, LineBound1622 N B0 M →
        IntervalIntegrable (fun α : ℝ => ‖mellinU1622 N M α‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume
          (4 / (N : ℝ)) (1 / R) ∧
        (∫ α in (4 / (N : ℝ))..(1 / R), ‖mellinU1622 N M α‖ ^ 2) ≤
          B * ((N : ℝ) / R * Real.log N ^ 3) * Real.log N ^ 7
doc:
/-- P0093 page 158 equation 4.7. Exact lemma2_outer1622 statement
from the abstract contour leaf and the two proved real kernel bounds.
CONDITIONAL only on abstract_outer_kernels442. No prime transfer is used. -/

name: rational_pointwise_characters442
header:
theorem rational_pointwise_characters442 :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∀ (N q : ℕ) [NeZero q], 1 ≤ N → 2 ≤ q → ∀ z : ℝ,
      (∑ a ∈ (range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q),
        ‖primeFourier111 N ((a : ℝ) / q + z)‖ ^ 2) ≤
      B / (q.totient : ℝ) *
        (‖characterPrime280 (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) N z‖ ^ 2 +
          (q : ℝ) * ∑ χ ∈ univ.filter (fun χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q => χ ≠ 1),
            ‖characterPrime280 χ N z‖ ^ 2) +
        B * (q.totient : ℝ) * Real.log q ^ 2
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 155 equation 2.3 and page 160 orthogonality
before equation 5.4, applied to a square norm. Character expansion
and finite unit orthogonality bound the sum of shifted prime squares.
The principal Gauss square is at most one. The other Gauss squares
are at most q. There is no integration, tau or GRH. -/

name: rational_system_integral442
header:
theorem rational_system_integral442 (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (τ : ℝ)
    (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hτ : 4 ≤ τ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f)
    (hn : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ f x) :
    (∫ α in arcSystem111 q τ ∩ Set.Icc 0 1, f α) ≤
      ∫ z in -(2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ))..(2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ)),
        ∑ a ∈ (range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q), f ((a : ℝ) / q + z)
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 166 definition of F_q as phi q doubled
intervals. For q at least two and tau at least four, integrate a
nonnegative continuous function on that system clipped to the unit
interval by shifting its finitely many reduced residue intervals.
This is rational geometry and integral translation only. -/

name: doubled_system_characters_decomposed442
header:
theorem doubled_system_characters_decomposed442 :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∀ (N q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (τ : ℝ), 1 ≤ N → 2 ≤ q → 4 ≤ τ →
      (∫ α in arcSystem111 q τ ∩ Set.Icc 0 1, ‖primeFourier111 N α‖ ^ 2) ≤
        B / (q.totient : ℝ) *
          ((∫ z in -(2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ))..(2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ)),
              ‖characterPrime280 (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) N z‖ ^ 2) +
            (q : ℝ) * ∑ χ ∈ univ.filter (fun χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q => χ ≠ 1),
              ∫ z in -(2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ))..(2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ)),
                ‖characterPrime280 χ N z‖ ^ 2) +
        B * (q.totient : ℝ) * (2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ)) * Real.log q ^ 2
doc:
/-- P0093 pages 155, 160 and 166. Exact doubled_system_characters1622
statement from the pointwise finite character bound and the rational
interval integration step. Both smaller inputs now have clean proofs. -/

name: outer_angular_gap_tendsto_zero452
header:
theorem outer_angular_gap_tendsto_zero452 :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => Real.pi / 2 -
      Complex.arg (((1 / (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) +
        ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) atTop (𝓝 0)
doc: /-- The page 157 angular gap at frequency one tends to zero as N tends to infinity. -/

name: outer_angular_gap_not_uniform452
header:
theorem outer_angular_gap_not_uniform452 :
    ¬ ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      δ ≤ Real.pi / 2 - Complex.arg (((1 / (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) +
        ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
doc: /-- No fixed positive angular gap holds for every sufficiently large N at frequency one. -/

name: outer_frequency_one_admissible452
header:
theorem outer_frequency_one_admissible452 (N : ℕ) (hN : 4 ≤ N) :
    1 ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (2 / 7 : ℝ) ∧
      (1 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (4 / (N : ℝ)) (1 / (1 : ℝ))
doc: /-- Frequency one lies in the outer interval for R one at every N at least four. -/

name: angular_gap_le_ratio452
header:
theorem angular_gap_le_ratio452 (z : ℂ) (hr : 0 < z.re) (hi : 0 < z.im) :
    Real.pi / 2 - z.arg ≤ z.re / z.im
doc: /-- Page 157 angular identity with an explicit upper bound for its gap. -/

name: norm_sin_le_exp_im452
header:
theorem norm_sin_le_exp_im452 (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 ≤ z.im) :
    ‖Complex.sin z‖ ≤ Real.exp z.im
doc: /-- The sine factor in the reflection formula grows at most exponentially. -/

name: reflected_gamma_upper452
header:
theorem reflected_gamma_upper452 (s : ℂ) (hlo : 1 / 2 ≤ s.re) (hhi : s.re ≤ 1)
    (ht : 1 ≤ s.im) :
    ‖Complex.Gamma (1 - s)‖ ≤
      3 * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (-(Real.pi * s.im / 2))
doc: /-- On the reflected strip, shifting Gamma once removes the polynomial loss. -/

name: gamma_lower452
header:
theorem gamma_lower452 (s : ℂ) (hlo : 1 / 2 ≤ s.re) (hhi : s.re ≤ 1)
    (ht : 1 ≤ s.im) :
    Real.pi / (3 * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.exp (-(Real.pi * s.im / 2)) ≤
      ‖Complex.Gamma s‖
doc: /-- A lower Gamma estimate on the Mellin strip for positive frequencies. -/

name: kernel_lower_of_gap452
header:
theorem kernel_lower_of_gap452 (s z : ℂ) (K : ℝ)
    (hlo : 1 / 2 ≤ s.re) (hhi : s.re ≤ 1) (ht : 1 ≤ s.im)
    (hz1 : 1 ≤ ‖z‖) (hzK : ‖z‖ ≤ K)
    (hgap : (Real.pi / 2 - z.arg) * s.im ≤ 1) :
    Real.pi / (3 * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)) / K * Real.exp (-1) ≤
      ‖z ^ (-s) * Complex.Gamma s‖
doc: /-- A small angular gap prevents the absolute Mellin kernel from decaying. -/

name: mellin_kernel_lower452
header:
theorem mellin_kernel_lower452 (N : ℕ) (hN : 9 ≤ N) (α t : ℝ)
    (ha : α ∈ Set.Icc (1 / 2 : ℝ) 1) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 1 (N : ℝ)) :
    Real.pi / (3 * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)) / (1 + 2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (-1) ≤
      ‖((((1 / (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((2 * Real.pi * α : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^
          (-(mellinLine1622 N t))) * Complex.Gamma (mellinLine1622 N t)‖
doc:
/-- On a fixed outer frequency interval, the absolute kernel stays uniformly positive
up to Mellin frequency N. This retains the N dependent angular gap. -/

name: outer_mass_lower452
header:
theorem outer_mass_lower452 (N : ℕ) (hN : 9 ≤ N) (α : ℝ)
    (ha : α ∈ Set.Icc (1 / 2 : ℝ) 1) :
    (Real.pi / (3 * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)) / (1 + 2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (-1)) *
      ((N : ℝ) - 1) * Real.log N ^ 3 ≤
    ∫ t : ℝ,
      ‖((((1 / (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((2 * Real.pi * α : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^
          (-(mellinLine1622 N t))) * Complex.Gamma (mellinLine1622 N t)‖ *
        Real.log ((N : ℝ) * (|t| + 2)) ^ 3
doc: /-- The absolute kernel mass has a linear lower bound on a fixed outer interval. -/

name: outer_mass_square_lower452
header:
theorem outer_mass_square_lower452 (N : ℕ) (hN : 9 ≤ N) :
    ((Real.pi / (3 * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)) / (1 + 2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (-1)) *
      ((N : ℝ) - 1) * Real.log N ^ 3) ^ 2 / 2 ≤
    ∫ α in (4 / (N : ℝ))..(1 : ℝ),
      (∫ t : ℝ,
        ‖((((1 / (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((2 * Real.pi * α : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^
            (-(mellinLine1622 N t))) * Complex.Gamma (mellinLine1622 N t)‖ *
          Real.log ((N : ℝ) * (|t| + 2)) ^ 3) ^ 2
doc: /-- Squaring the absolute mass loses a full power of N on a fixed outer interval. -/

name: outer_kernel_rhs_le452
header:
theorem outer_kernel_rhs_le452 (N : ℕ) (hN : 3 ≤ N) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    C * Real.log N ^ 6 * differenceKernel376 ((N : ℝ) * Real.log N ^ 3) +
      C * Real.log N ^ 7 * sumKernel376 ((N : ℝ) * Real.log N ^ 3) + C ≤
        57 * C * (N : ℝ) * Real.log N ^ 10
doc: /-- The stated kernel right side has only linear N growth times a fixed log power. -/

name: not_outer_kernel_mass_bound452
header:
theorem not_outer_kernel_mass_bound452 :
    ¬ (∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N → ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R →
      R ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (2 / 7 : ℝ) →
        (∫ α in (4 / (N : ℝ))..(1 / R),
          (∫ t : ℝ,
            ‖(((1 / (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((2 * Real.pi * α : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^
                (-(mellinLine1622 N t)) * Complex.Gamma (mellinLine1622 N t)‖ *
              Real.log ((N : ℝ) * (|t| + 2)) ^ 3) ^ 2) ≤
          C * Real.log N ^ 6 * differenceKernel376 ((N : ℝ) / R * Real.log N ^ 3) +
            C * Real.log N ^ 7 * sumKernel376 ((N : ℝ) / R * Real.log N ^ 3) + C)
doc:
/-- The absolute kernel mass bound in the split is false.
This is a QUESTION about the formal split, not a paper error. -/

name: mellin_signed_square452
header:
theorem mellin_signed_square452 (N : ℕ) (M : ℝ → ℂ) (α : ℝ) :
    ‖mellinU1622 N M α‖ ^ 2 = (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) ^ 2 *
      (∫ t : ℝ, ∫ u : ℝ,
        (mellinKernel442 N α t * M t) *
          conj (mellinKernel442 N α u * M u)).re
doc: /-- The signed double kernel expands the square of the Mellin integral exactly. -/

name: mellin_signed_square_integral452
header:
theorem mellin_signed_square_integral452 (N : ℕ) (M : ℝ → ℂ) (a b : ℝ) :
    (∫ α in a..b, ‖mellinU1622 N M α‖ ^ 2) =
      (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) ^ 2 * ∫ α in a..b,
        (∫ t : ℝ, ∫ u : ℝ,
          (mellinKernel442 N α t * M t) *
            conj (mellinKernel442 N α u * M u)).re
doc:
/-- The outer square integral equals the integrated signed double kernel.
No absolute value is inserted inside the Mellin integral. -/

name: radial_cpow_integral_bound452
header:
theorem radial_cpow_integral_bound452 (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (r : ℂ) (hr : r.re < -1) :
    ‖∫ u : ℝ in a..b, (u : ℂ) ^ r‖ ≤
      (a ^ (r.re + 1) + b ^ (r.re + 1)) / ‖r + 1‖
doc: /-- The radial primitive bound retains the real part of its denominator. -/

name: radial_mellin_integral_bound452
header:
theorem radial_mellin_integral_bound452 (a b ε d : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ‖∫ u : ℝ in a..b, (u : ℂ) ^ (-((1 + ε : ℝ) : ℂ) - (d : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤
      (a ^ (-ε) + b ^ (-ε)) / Real.sqrt (ε ^ 2 + d ^ 2)
doc: /-- The Mellin radial exponent gives the Euclidean denominator of epsilon and frequency difference. -/

name: radial_mellin_off_diagonal452
header:
theorem radial_mellin_off_diagonal452 (a b ε d : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    ‖∫ u : ℝ in a..b, (u : ℂ) ^ (-((1 + ε : ℝ) : ℂ) - (d : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤
      2 * a ^ (-ε) / |d|
doc: /-- Away from the diagonal, the frequency difference alone bounds the radial denominator. -/

name: radial_mellin_log_bound452
header:
theorem radial_mellin_log_bound452 (a b ε d : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ‖∫ u : ℝ in a..b, (u : ℂ) ^ (-((1 + ε : ℝ) : ℂ) - (d : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤
      a ^ (-ε) * Real.log (b / a)
doc: /-- A diagonal bound for the radial integral follows from the integral of one over u. -/

name: radial_mellin_uniform_bound452
header:
theorem radial_mellin_uniform_bound452 (a b ε d : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ‖∫ u : ℝ in a..b, (u : ℂ) ^ (-((1 + ε : ℝ) : ℂ) - (d : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤
      4 * a ^ (-ε) * (1 + Real.log (b / a)) / (1 + |d|)
doc: /-- A uniform radial estimate includes a logarithmic factor near equal Mellin frequencies. -/

name: radialJacobian452
header: noncomputable def radialJacobian452 (N u : ℝ) : ℝ
doc: /-- The radial substitution Jacobian in page 158 equation 4.6. -/

name: radial_jacobian_bounds452
header:
theorem radial_jacobian_bounds452 (N u : ℝ) (hN : 0 < N) (hu : 0 < u)
    (hNu : 2 ≤ N * u) :
    0 < radialJacobian452 N u ∧ radialJacobian452 N u ≤ 2
doc: /-- The radial Jacobian is positive and at most two once N u is at least two. -/

name: radial_jacobian_antitone452
header:
theorem radial_jacobian_antitone452 (N : ℝ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    AntitoneOn (radialJacobian452 N) (Set.Ici (2 / N))
doc: /-- The radial Jacobian is antitone on the positive interval starting at two over N. -/

name: radial_jacobian_integral_bound452
header:
theorem radial_jacobian_integral_bound452 (N a b ε d : ℝ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (ha : 2 / N ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ‖∫ u : ℝ in a..b, radialJacobian452 N u •
        (u : ℂ) ^ (-((1 + ε : ℝ) : ℂ) - (d : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤
      8 * a ^ (-ε) * (1 + Real.log (b / a)) / (1 + |d|)
doc: /-- The weighted radial integral obeys a signed primitive bound with a logarithmic diagonal factor. -/

name: radial_substitution452
header:
theorem radial_substitution452 (c a b : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (h : ℝ → ℂ) (_hh : ContinuousOn h (Set.Ioi 0)) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in a..b, h (Real.sqrt (c ^ 2 + x ^ 2))) =
      ∫ u : ℝ in (Real.sqrt (c ^ 2 + a ^ 2))..(Real.sqrt (c ^ 2 + b ^ 2)),
        (u / Real.sqrt (u ^ 2 - c ^ 2)) • h u
doc: /-- The radial change of variables keeps its inverse Jacobian inside the signed integral. -/

name: radial_inverse_jacobian452
header:
theorem radial_inverse_jacobian452 (N u : ℝ) (hN : 0 < N) (hu : 1 / N < u) :
    u / Real.sqrt (u ^ 2 - (1 / N) ^ 2) = radialJacobian452 N u
doc: /-- The inverse derivative equals the Jacobian used in the paper. -/

name: mellin_radial_substitution452
header:
theorem mellin_radial_substitution452 (N a b : ℝ) (hN : 0 < N) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hab : a ≤ b) (h : ℝ → ℂ) (hh : ContinuousOn h (Set.Ioi 0)) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in a..b, h (Real.sqrt ((1 / N) ^ 2 + x ^ 2))) =
      ∫ u : ℝ in (Real.sqrt ((1 / N) ^ 2 + a ^ 2))..(Real.sqrt ((1 / N) ^ 2 + b ^ 2)),
        radialJacobian452 N u • h u
doc: /-- The radial substitution after setting the real part of the base to one over N. -/

name: half_arc_mass_lower453
header:
theorem half_arc_mass_lower453 (N : ℕ)
    (hl1 : 1 ≤ Real.log N) (hl240 : 240 * Real.log N ≤ (N : ℝ))
    (hlogs : Real.log ((N : ℝ) + 1) ≤ ((N : ℝ) + 1) / 10) :
    (N : ℝ) / (13824 * Real.log N ^ 3) ≤
      ∫ α in Set.Icc ((1 : ℝ) / 2 - 1 / (2 * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)))
          (1 / 2 + 1 / (2 * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ))),
        ‖primeFourier111 N α‖ ^ 2
doc:
/-- Audit of P0093 page 166 equation 9.1 against the fresh single arc leaf.
The arc about one half has mass at least N over 13824 log cubed N under
three explicit size conditions. This uses the existing half phase lower
bound and Mathlib Chebyshev, with no GRH input. -/

name: eventual_half_arc_violation453
header:
theorem eventual_half_arc_violation453 (B : ℝ) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      (2 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) ∧
      B * (N : ℝ) / (2 * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) * Real.log N ^ 13 <
        ∫ α in Set.Icc ((1 : ℝ) / 2 - 1 / (2 * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)))
            (1 / 2 + 1 / (2 * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ))),
          ‖primeFourier111 N α‖ ^ 2
doc:
/-- Audit of P0093 page 166 equation 9.1. For every real coefficient B,
all sufficiently large N violate the dead single arc bound at q two and
a one. The denominator is admissible for those N. No GRH is assumed. -/

name: half_arc_counterexample453
header:
theorem half_arc_counterexample453 (B : ℝ) (N0 : ℕ) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, N0 < N ∧
      (2 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) ∧
      B * (N : ℝ) / (2 * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) * Real.log N ^ 13 <
        ∫ α in Set.Icc ((1 : ℝ) / 2 - 1 / (2 * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)))
            (1 / 2 + 1 / (2 * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ))),
          ‖primeFourier111 N α‖ ^ 2
doc:
/-- Audit of P0093 page 166 equation 9.1. The fixed reduced rational
one half violates the proposed single arc error bound beyond every
natural threshold. This records the counterexample with its witness. -/

name: not_local_prime_mass_conclusion453
header: theorem not_local_prime_mass_conclusion453 : ¬ Audit1622.LeafLocalMass
doc:
/-- Audit of P0093 page 166 equation 9.1. Named negation of the
single arc leaf conclusion, from the explicit denominator two witness.
This refutes the fresh split conclusion and does not refute the paper. -/

name: local_mass_iff_not_grh453
header:
theorem local_mass_iff_not_grh453 :
    (LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH → Audit1622.LeafLocalMass) ↔ ¬ LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH
doc:
/-- Audit of P0093 page 166 equation 9.1. The original conditional
single arc leaf is equivalent to the negation of its GRH hypothesis.
No truth value of GRH is established. -/

name: half_arc_size_instance453
header:
theorem half_arc_size_instance453 :
    1 ≤ Real.log (4096 : ℝ) ∧
      240 * Real.log (4096 : ℝ) ≤ 4096 ∧
      Real.log (4096 + 1 : ℝ) ≤ (4096 + 1 : ℝ) / 10
doc:
/-- Concrete nonvacuity for the size conditions of half_arc_mass_lower453.
This checks the numerical audit conditions at N equal to 4096. -/

name: lemma2_central_proved487
header:
theorem lemma2_central_proved487 (B0 : ℝ) (hB0 : 0 < B0) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N → ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R →
      R ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (2 / 7 : ℝ) → ∀ M : ℝ → ℂ, LineBound1622 N B0 M →
        ∀ α : ℝ, |α| ≤ 4 / (N : ℝ) →
          ‖mellinU1622 N M α‖ ≤ B * (N : ℝ) / Real.sqrt R * Real.log N ^ 3
doc: /-- P0093 page 158 before equation 4.8. The abstract central estimate uses the proved absolute kernel mass. No character transfer or GRH is used. -/

name: central_pointwise487
header:
theorem central_pointwise487 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) →
        ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, χ ≠ 1 → ∀ α : ℝ,
          |α| ≤ 4 / (N : ℝ) →
            ‖characterPrime280 χ N α‖ ^ 2 ≤

    Function.Periodic (fun α : ℝ => primeFourier111 N α ^ 2 *
      Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * (n : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) 1
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 165 equation 8.1. Every signed integer residual prime
square integrand has period one. Negative residuals satisfy the same identity. -/

name: major_arc_partition491
header:
theorem major_arc_partition491 :
    ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N → ∀ f : ℝ → ℂ,
      Continuous f → Function.Periodic f 1 →
      (∫ α in majorArcs280 N, f α) =
        ∑ q ∈ Icc 1 ⌊(N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ)⌋₊,
          ∑ a ∈ (range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q),
            ∫ z in -(1 / ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)))..
                (1 / ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ))),
              f ((a : ℝ) / q + z)
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 pages 165 and 166 equation 8.1. A continuous period one
function has the exact rational arc partition integral when Q is N to one tenth
and tau is N to one seventh. The clipped endpoint arcs are joined by periodicity.
This statement has no primes, no character series and no exponent tuples. -/

name: major_tuple_identity491
header:
theorem major_tuple_identity491 (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      HasSum (fun ν : Fin k → ℕ =>
        (tupleWeight491 k N ν : ℂ) *
          ∑ q ∈ Icc 1 ⌊(N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ)⌋₊,
            localArc1622 N q (tupleResidual491 k N ν))
        (∫ α in majorArcs280 N,
          primeFourier111 N α ^ 2 * powerFourier111 N α ^ k *
            Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * N : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I))
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 165 equation 8.1. Expand the infinite damped T
series, exchange its sum and the integral, and join the disjoint rational
arcs. The two clipped endpoint pieces are joined by period one. Every signed
residual is retained. This is an exact identity with no local expansion input. -/

name: tuple_convolution_identity491
header:
theorem tuple_convolution_identity491 (k N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hev : Even N) :
    HasSum (fun ν : Fin k → ℕ =>
      (tupleWeight491 k N ν : ℂ) *
        ∑ q ∈ Icc 1 ⌊(N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ)⌋₊,
          localMain491 N q (tupleResidual491 k N ν))
      ((Real.exp (-1) * convolutionMain491 k N : ℝ) : ℂ)
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 165 equation 8.1. The convolution main term has
finite support in the positive residual tuples. The damping factors multiply
to exp of minus one. No estimate and no local arc integral occurs here. -/

name: convolution_main_error491
header:
theorem convolution_main_error491 (k N : ℕ) (B : ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n →
      |logConvolution1622 n - (n : ℝ) / Real.log n ^ 2| ≤
        B * ((n : ℝ) / Real.log n ^ 2) * (1 / Real.sqrt (Real.log n))) :
    |convolutionMain491 k N - truncatedMain357 k N| ≤ B * majorRelative376 k N
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 165 equation 8.1. The explicit relative correction controls
the replacement of the exact convolution by n over log squared n. -/

name: modulus_error_saving491
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 166 equation 8.2. The summed modulus error has a saving
stronger than the one thousandth used by the sealed target. -/

name: weighted_error_sum491
header:
theorem weighted_error_sum491 {ι : Type*} (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : Summable w)
    (hw0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (f g : ι → ℂ) (F G : ℂ)
    (hf : HasSum (fun i => (w i : ℂ) * f i) F)
    (hg : HasSum (fun i => (w i : ℂ) * g i) G)
    (D : ℝ) (hD : ∀ i, ‖f i - g i‖ ≤ D) :
    ‖F - G‖ ≤ (∑' i, w i) * D
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 165 equation 8.1. A uniform signed residual error can be
summed against every damped tuple. This does not delete any negative residual. -/

name: local_error_sum491
header:
theorem local_error_sum491 (B : ℝ) (N0 N : ℕ) (hL : LocalExpansion1622 B N0)
    (hN : N0 < N) (n : ℤ) (hn : n ≤ N) :
    ‖(∑ q ∈ Icc 1 ⌊(N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ)⌋₊, localArc1622 N q n) -
      ∑ q ∈ Icc 1 ⌊(N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ)⌋₊, localMain491 N q n‖ ≤
      B * (N : ℝ) * Real.log N ^ 13 *
        ∑ q ∈ Icc 1 ⌊(N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ)⌋₊,
          (1 / (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) +
            1 / Real.sqrt ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)))
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 165 equation 8.1. Sum the supplied local error over all
moduli at one signed residual. Only LocalExpansion1622 is used. -/

name: local_to_major_convolution491
header:
theorem local_to_major_convolution491 (k : ℕ) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B) (N0 : ℕ)
    (hL : LocalExpansion1622 B N0) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∃ N1 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N1 < N →
      |arcContribution280 k N (majorArcs280 N) - convolutionMain491 k N| ≤
        A * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 - (1 / 1000 : ℝ)) * Real.log N ^ (k + 13)
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 pages 165 and 166 equations 8.1 and 8.2. The local expansion
and the two exact tuple identities give the power saving before any
convolution asymptotic. CONDITIONAL on the supplied local expansion. Both tuple identities are proved. -/

name: major_bookkeeping_assembled491
header:
theorem major_bookkeeping_assembled491 (k : ℕ) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B) (N0 : ℕ)
    (hL : LocalExpansion1622 B N0) (B' : ℝ) (hB' : 0 < B')
    (hC : ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n →
      |logConvolution1622 n - (n : ℝ) / Real.log n ^ 2| ≤
        B' * ((n : ℝ) / Real.log n ^ 2) * (1 / Real.sqrt (Real.log n))) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∃ N1 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N1 < N →
      |arcContribution280 k N (majorArcs280 N) - truncatedMain357 k N| ≤
        A * majorRelative376 k N +
          A * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 - (1 / 1000 : ℝ)) * Real.log N ^ (k + 13)
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 pages 165 and 166 equations 8.1 and 8.2. Elementary final
assembly with the convolution estimate supplied as a hypothesis.
CONDITIONAL on the supplied local expansion and convolution estimate. -/

header:
theorem nonprincipal_bound491 (hM : MellinBound280) :

name: mixed_bound491
header:
theorem mixed_bound491 (hM : MellinBound280) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ q : ℕ, ∀ hq : 1 ≤ q, (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) →

doc:

It has no principal square integral and no convolution main term. -/

name: principal_convolution491
header:
theorem principal_convolution491 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) (hM : MellinBound280) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) → ∀ n : ℤ, n ≤ N →
        ‖principalIntegral491 N q n -
          ((Real.exp (-(n.toNat : ℝ) / N) * logConvolution1622 n.toNat : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤
          C * (N : ℝ) * Real.log N ^ 13 *
            (1 / ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) +
              1 / Real.sqrt ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)))
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 pages 160 and 161 equations 6.1 through 6.3.
The principal square integral is replaced by the exact damped logarithmic
convolution through a full period, retaining both displayed errors.
The damping is exp of minus n over N before multiplication by tuple weights. -/

name: principal_coefficient_norm491
header:
theorem principal_coefficient_norm491 (q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (n : ℤ) :
    ‖(((ArithmeticFunction.moebius q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (q.totient : ℝ) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      signedRamanujan491 q n‖ ≤ 1
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 156 equation 3.4. The principal arithmetic coefficient
has norm at most one for every positive modulus and every signed frequency. -/

name: signedRamanujan_toNat491
header:
theorem signedRamanujan_toNat491 (q : ℕ) (n : ℤ) (hn : 0 ≤ n) :
    signedRamanujan491 q n = LeanLab.Perelli1996.Ramanujan103.ramanujanSum q n.toNat
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 161 equation 6.4. For nonnegative residuals the signed
reduced residue phase is the existing natural Ramanujan sum. -/

name: principal_main_eq491
header:
theorem principal_main_eq491 (N q : ℕ) (n : ℤ) :
    ((((ArithmeticFunction.moebius q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (q.totient : ℝ) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      signedRamanujan491 q n) *
        ((Real.exp (-(n.toNat : ℝ) / N) * logConvolution1622 n.toNat : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      localMain491 N q n
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 161 equation 6.4. The coefficient times the exact
convolution agrees with the sealed main term, also at negative residuals. -/

name: mixed_unit491

doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 156 equation 3.4. At modulus one every character is

name: principal_unit_series491
header:
theorem principal_unit_series491 (N : ℕ) (z : ℝ) :

doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 155 equation 2.3. At modulus one the principal character
prime series is the full prime Fourier series. -/

name: character_decomposition_unit491
header:
theorem character_decomposition_unit491 (N : ℕ) (n : ℤ) :
    localArc1622 N 1 n =
      principalTerm491 N 1 n + mixedTerm491 N 1 n + nonprincipalTerm491 N 1 n
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 156 equation 3.4. At modulus one the character
decomposition is exact with no omitted prime divisor error. -/

name: local_expansion_assembled491

theorem local_expansion_assembled491 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) (hM : MellinBound280) :

doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 161 equation 6.4. Elementary assembly of the four written
estimates. CONDITIONAL on character_decomposition491, nonprincipal_bound491,
mixed_bound491 and principal_convolution491. -/

name: continuous_mellinKernel487
header:
private theorem continuous_mellinKernel487 (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :

doc: /-- The Mellin kernel is continuous in the pair (alpha, t). -/

name: continuous_alphaKernel_integral487
doc: /-- The alpha integral of the kernel product is continuous in the frequency pair. -/

name: iterated_eq_box487
header:
private theorem iterated_eq_box487 {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] (F : ℝ → ℝ → E) (a b : ℝ)
    (hF : IntegrableOn (Function.uncurry F) (Set.uIoc a b ×ˢ Set.uIoc a b)) :

doc: /-- An iterated interval integral over a square is the set integral over the product box. -/

name: region_split_aux487

    (hG : Continuous (Function.uncurry G)) :
    (∫ t in -T..T, ∫ u in -T..T, G t u) =

    ‖z ^ (-(mellinLine1622 N t))‖ =

doc: /-- Sharp modulus of one power factor of the Mellin kernel. -/

name: norm_cpow_pair487
header:

name: sumKernel_lower487
header:
private theorem sumKernel_lower487 (T : ℝ) (hT : 2 ≤ T) :
    Real.exp (-(Real.pi / 4)) * (T / 2) ≤ sumKernel376 T
doc:
/-- On the frequency square of radius `T` the exponentially decreasing sum kernel is at least
a constant times `T`: the strip `0 ≤ t ≤ T - 1`, `-t ≤ u ≤ -t + 1` has measure `T - 1` and
there `|t + u| ≤ 1`, so the integrand is bounded below by `exp (-(π/4))`. -/

name: exp_weight_le487
header:
private theorem exp_weight_le487 (s : ℝ) :
    (3 + |s|) * Real.exp (-(Real.pi / 2) * |s|) ≤ 4 * Real.exp (-(Real.pi / 4) * |s|)
doc: /-- The linear weight is absorbed by the exponential decay: `3 + |s| ≤ 4 exp ((π/4)|s|)`. -/

name: kernel_pair_pointwise487
header:
private theorem kernel_pair_pointwise487 (N : ℕ) (hN : 3 ≤ N) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (t u : ℝ) (htu : t + u ≤ 0) :
    ‖mellinKernel442 N α t * (starRingEnd ℂ) (mellinKernel442 N α u)‖ ≤
      (Real.exp 2 * (N : ℝ)) *
        ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * (3 + |t|) * Real.exp (-(Real.pi * |t| / 2))) *
         (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * (3 + |u|) * Real.exp (-(Real.pi * |u| / 2))))
doc:
/-- Pointwise in `alpha`: on the negative region `t + u ≤ 0` the kernel pair is bounded by
`exp 2 · N` times the two Gamma weights. The angular factor is `≤ 1` because `arg z ≥ 0`. -/

name: kernel_pair_integral487
header:
private theorem kernel_pair_integral487 (N : ℕ) (hN : 3 ≤ N) (R : ℝ) (hR : 1 ≤ R)

        ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * (3 + |t|) * Real.exp (-(Real.pi * |t| / 2))) *
         (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * (3 + |u|) * Real.exp (-(Real.pi * |u| / 2)))))
doc: /-- The `alpha` integral of the kernel pair on the outer range, on the negative region. -/

name: mellin_weight_le487
doc:
/-- The line bound with the logarithm of the frequency replaced by a polynomial weight:
`‖M t‖ ≤ B0 (8 log³N + 8 (3 + |t|)³)` for `N ≥ 2`. This is what lets the exponential decay of the
Gamma factor absorb the coefficient weight on the negative region. -/

name: poly_le_exp487
doc: /-- A polynomial weight of degree four is dominated by half of the exponential decay. -/

name: poly_exp_moment487

doc:
/-- The degree four polynomial-exponential weight has an absolutely bounded integral on any
symmetric interval. This is the constant that absorbs the coefficient weight in leaf 5. -/

name: linear_exp_moment487
header:

doc: /-- The linear-exponential weight integrates to at most sixteen. -/

name: coeff_weight_moment487
header:
private theorem coeff_weight_moment487 (N : ℕ) (hN : 16384 ≤ N) (B0 : ℝ) (hB0 : 0 ≤ B0)
    (M : ℝ → ℂ) (hM : LineBound1622 N B0 M) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    (∫ s in -T..T, ‖M s‖ * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * (3 + |s|) *
        Real.exp (-(Real.pi * |s| / 2))))
      ≤ 8 * B0 * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * (16 * Real.log N ^ 3 + 8388608)
doc:
/-- The coefficient times the Gamma weight integrates to an explicit constant, uniformly in the
frequency radius. This is the single-variable factor of the negative-region square. -/

name: sum_region_core487
header:
private theorem sum_region_core487 (N : ℕ) (hN : 16384 ≤ N) (R : ℝ) (hR1 : 1 ≤ R)
    (hRN : R ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (2 / 7 : ℝ)) (B0 : ℝ) (hB0 : 0 < B0)
    (M : ℝ → ℂ) (hM : LineBound1622 N B0 M) :
    (∫ t in -((N : ℝ) / R * Real.log N ^ 3)..((N : ℝ) / R * Real.log N ^ 3),
        ∫ u in -((N : ℝ) / R * Real.log N ^ 3)..((N : ℝ) / R * Real.log N ^ 3),
          if 0 ≤ t + u then 0
          else ‖M t‖ * ‖M u‖ *
            ‖∫ α in (4 / (N : ℝ))..(1 / R),
              mellinKernel442 N α t * (starRingEnd ℂ) (mellinKernel442 N α u)‖)
      ≤ (N : ℝ) / R * B0 ^ 2 * Real.log N ^ 6 * 36893488147419103232
doc:
/-- The coefficient times the Gamma weight integrates to an explicit constant, uniformly in the
frequency radius. This is the single-variable factor of the negative-region square. -/
private theorem coeff_weight_moment487 (N : ℕ) (hN : 16384 ≤ N) (B0 : ℝ) (hB0 : 0 ≤ B0)
    (M : ℝ → ℂ) (hM : LineBound1622 N B0 M) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    (∫ s in -T..T, ‖M s‖ * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * (3 + |s|) *
        Real.exp (-(Real.pi * |s| / 2))))
      ≤ 8 * B0 * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * (16 * Real.log N ^ 3 + 8388608) := by
  set W : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * (3 + |s|) *
    Real.exp (-(Real.pi * |s| / 2)) with hW
  set L : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => (3 + |s|) * Real.exp (-(Real.pi / 2) * |s|) with hL
  set P : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => (3 + |s|) ^ 4 * Real.exp (-(Real.pi / 2) * |s|) with hP
  have hconv : ∀ s : ℝ, Real.exp (-(Real.pi * |s| / 2)) = Real.exp (-(Real.pi / 2) * |s|) := by
    intro s
    congr 1
    ring
  have hTT : (-T : ℝ) ≤ T := by linarith
  have hWcont : Continuous W := by rw [hW]; fun_prop
  have hLcont : Continuous L := by rw [hL]; fun_prop
  have hPcont : Continuous P := by rw [hP]; fun_prop
  -- the pointwise comparison
  have hpt : ∀ s : ℝ, ‖M s‖ * W s ≤
      8 * B0 * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * (Real.log N ^ 3 * L s + P s) := by
    intro s
    have h1 := mellin_weight_le487 N (by omega) B0 hB0 M hM s
    have hWnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ W s := by rw [hW]; positivity
    have hstep : ‖M s‖ * W s ≤
        B0 * (8 * Real.log N ^ 3 + 8 * (3 + |s|) ^ 3) * W s :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hWnn
    have he' : B0 * (8 * Real.log N ^ 3 + 8 * (3 + |s|) ^ 3) *
          (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * (3 + |s|) * Real.exp (-(Real.pi * |s| / 2))) =
        8 * B0 * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) *
          (Real.log N ^ 3 * ((3 + |s|) * Real.exp (-(Real.pi / 2) * |s|)) +
            (3 + |s|) ^ 4 * Real.exp (-(Real.pi / 2) * |s|)) := by
      rw [hconv s]
      ring
    have he : B0 * (8 * Real.log N ^ 3 + 8 * (3 + |s|) ^ 3) * W s =
        8 * B0 * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * (Real.log N ^ 3 * L s + P s) := by
      simpa only [hW, hL, hP] using he'
    linarith [hstep, he ▸ hstep]
  -- the majorant is continuous
  have hmajcont : Continuous fun s : ℝ =>
      8 * B0 * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * (Real.log N ^ 3 * L s + P s) :=
    continuous_const.mul ((continuous_const.mul hLcont).add hPcont)
  have hmono : (∫ s in -T..T, ‖M s‖ * W s) ≤
      ∫ s in -T..T, 8 * B0 * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * (Real.log N ^ 3 * L s + P s) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hTT
    · exact (hM.1.norm.mul hWcont).intervalIntegrable _ _
    · exact hmajcont.intervalIntegrable _ _
    · intro s _
      exact hpt s
  -- evaluate the majorant integral
  have hsplit : (∫ s in -T..T, 8 * B0 * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) *
        (Real.log N ^ 3 * L s + P s)) =
      8 * B0 * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) *
        (Real.log N ^ 3 * (∫ s in -T..T, L s) + (∫ s in -T..T, P s)) := by
    have hIL : IntervalIntegrable (fun s : ℝ => Real.log N ^ 3 * L s) volume (-T) T :=
      (continuous_const.mul hLcont).intervalIntegrable _ _
    have hIP : IntervalIntegrable P volume (-T) T := hPcont.intervalIntegrable _ _
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    congr 1
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hIL hIP, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  have hLb : (∫ s in -T..T, L s) ≤ 16 := by
    rw [hL]
    exact linear_exp_moment487 T hT
  have hPb : (∫ s in -T..T, P s) ≤ 8388608 := by
    rw [hP]
    exact poly_exp_moment487 T hT
  have hLnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ∫ s in -T..T, L s :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hTT (fun s _ => by rw [hL]; positivity)
  have hlog3 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log N ^ 3 := by positivity
  have hB : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 8 * B0 * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) := by positivity
  rw [hsplit] at hmono
  refine hmono.trans ?_
  have hinner : Real.log N ^ 3 * (∫ s in -T..T, L s) + (∫ s in -T..T, P s) ≤
      16 * Real.log N ^ 3 + 8388608 := by
    nlinarith [hLb, hPb, hLnn, hlog3]
  calc 8 * B0 * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) *
        (Real.log N ^ 3 * (∫ s in -T..T, L s) + (∫ s in -T..T, P s))
      ≤ 8 * B0 * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * (16 * Real.log N ^ 3 + 8388608) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinner hB

-- END LEAF 5 COEFFMOMENT

name: rational_cover_integral519
header:
theorem rational_cover_integral519 (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (τ : ℝ) (hτ : 0 < τ) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : Continuous f) (hn : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ f x)
    (hcover : arcSystem519 q τ ∩ Set.Icc 0 1 ⊆
      ⋃ a ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q),
        Set.Icc ((a : ℝ) / q - 2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ)) ((a : ℝ) / q + 2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ))) :
    (∫ α in arcSystem519 q τ ∩ Set.Icc 0 1, f α) ≤
      ∫ z in -(2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ))..(2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ)),
        ∑ a ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q), f ((a : ℝ) / q + z)
doc:
/-- LEAF. The integral step of the geometry. For a nonnegative continuous function and a
cover of the clipped arc system by the doubled intervals of the reduced residues, the
integral over the clipped system is at most the integral over the radius interval of the
sum of the shifted values at the reduced residues. This is subadditivity of the integral
over a finite union together with translation of the interval, so it uses no property of
the function beyond nonnegativity and continuity, and none of the characters. -/

name: exp_phase_nat
doc: /-- The phase of the residue `m` modulo `q`, as an `n`-th power. -/

name: full_sum_nat
header:
private theorem full_sum_nat (q m : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    (∑ a ∈ Finset.range q,
      Complex.exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (a : ℂ) / (q : ℂ))) =
      if q ∣ m then (q : ℂ) else 0
doc: /-- Complete residue sums vanish off the divisibility condition. -/

name: multiples_sum_nat
header:
private theorem multiples_sum_nat (q d m : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hd : d ∣ q) :
    (∑ a ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => d ∣ a),
        Complex.exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (a : ℂ) / (q : ℂ))) =
      if q / d ∣ m then ((q / d : ℕ) : ℂ) else 0
doc: /-- The sum over the multiples of a divisor reduces to the quotient modulus. -/

name: coprime_indicator_nat
doc: /-- Möbius inversion gives the coprimality indicator at every positive modulus. -/

name: ramanujan_sum_one_nat
header:
private theorem ramanujan_sum_one_nat (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    (∑ a ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q),
        Complex.exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * ((1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (a : ℂ) / (q : ℂ))) =
      ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius q : ℤ) : ℂ)
doc: /-- The Ramanujan sum at argument one is the Möbius function of the modulus. -/

name: unit_sum_addChar_le_one
header:
private theorem unit_sum_addChar_le_one (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] :
    ‖∑ c ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun c => IsUnit c), ZMod.stdAddChar c‖ ≤ 1
doc: /-- The unit sum of the additive character has modulus at most one. -/

name: unit_gauss_principal_le
doc:
/-- The Gauss vector of the principal character at the unit shift one has modulus at most
one: it is the conjugate of the unit sum of the additive character. -/

name: two_pow_primeFactors_card_le
header:
private theorem two_pow_primeFactors_card_le (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    2 ^ q.primeFactors.card ≤ q
doc: /-- The number of distinct prime divisors of a positive integer obeys `2 ^ ω ≤ q`. -/

name: primeFactors_card_le_log
header:
private theorem primeFactors_card_le_log (q : ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    (q.primeFactors.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.log q
doc: /-- The count of distinct prime divisors is at most twice the logarithm. -/

name: corr_bound
header:
private theorem corr_bound (N q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (hq : 2 ≤ q) (z : ℝ) (a : ZMod q) :
    ‖∑' p : Nat.Primes, (if IsUnit (((p : ℕ)) : ZMod q) then 0
        else (Real.exp (-((p : ℕ) : ℝ) / N) : ℂ) *
          Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * (((a.val : ℝ) / q + z)) * ((p : ℕ) : ℝ)) : ℝ) *
            Complex.I))‖ ≤ 2 * Real.log q
doc:
/-- The tail of the prime series at a unit residue is supported on the primes dividing `q`,
and each of its terms has modulus at most one. -/

name: sum_Gunit_mul_char
doc: /-- Character-table expansion of the additive character on the units. -/

name: Gunit_eq_mul
header:
private theorem Gunit_eq_mul (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) {a : ZMod q} (ha : IsUnit a) :
    (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) = χ a * (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG))
doc: /-- `G` is multiplicative in the additive shift: on units it is `χ a` times `G χ 1`. -/

name: sum_unit_char_of_ne_one
header:
private theorem sum_unit_char_of_ne_one {ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q} (hψ : ψ ≠ 1) :
    ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a), ψ a = 0
doc: /-- A nontrivial Dirichlet character has vanishing sum over the units. -/

name: sum_unit_char_mul_inv
doc: /-- `χ·conj χ'` summed over the units: the totient at `χ = χ'`, zero otherwise. -/

name: sum_Gunit_orth
header:
private theorem sum_Gunit_orth (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) :
    ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
        (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ' cG)))
      = if χ = χ' then (q.totient : ℂ) * ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)))) else 0
doc: /-- The Gauss vectors of two characters are orthogonal over the units. -/

name: Gunit_one_principal_le
header: private theorem Gunit_one_principal_le (hq : 0 < q) : ‖(∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) cG))‖ ≤ 1
doc:
/-- The principal Gauss vector: the additive character of the units is the conjugate of
the Ramanujan sum, so its norm is `|μ(q)|`. -/

name: Gunit_one_norm_sq_le
header: private theorem Gunit_one_norm_sq_le (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) : ‖(∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG))‖ ^ 2 ≤ (q : ℝ)
doc: /-- `G χ 1` is the Gauss sum of `χ⁻¹`, so its square norm is at most the modulus. -/

name: char_expansion_pointwise
header:
private theorem char_expansion_pointwise (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (a : ZMod q) (p : Nat.Primes)
    (hp : IsUnit ((p : ℕ) : ZMod q)) :
    ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * ((p : ℕ) : ZMod q)))
      = (1 / (q.totient : ℂ)) *
          ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * χ ((p : ℕ) : ZMod q)
doc:
/-- Per-prime character expansion: on a prime whose residue is a unit, the additive character
of the shifted fraction is `1/φ` times the Gauss-weighted character sum. -/

name: exp_split_phase
header:
private theorem exp_split_phase (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (z : ℝ) (a : ZMod q) (p : Nat.Primes) :
    ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * ((p : ℕ) : ZMod q))) *
        Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * z * ((p : ℕ) : ℝ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I)
      = Complex.exp
          ((-(2 * Real.pi * (((a.val : ℝ) / q + z)) * ((p : ℕ) : ℝ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I)
doc: /-- Splitting the exponential of the shifted fraction into the residue phase and the shift. -/

name: prime_fourier_expansion
header:
private theorem prime_fourier_expansion (N q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (hN : 1 ≤ N) (z : ℝ) (a : ZMod q) :
    primeFourier111_up111 N ((a.val : ℝ) / q + z) =
      (1 / (q.totient : ℂ)) *
          ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z +
        ∑' p : Nat.Primes, (if IsUnit ((p : ℕ) : ZMod q) then 0
          else (Real.exp (-((p : ℕ) : ℝ) / N) : ℂ) *
            Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * ((a.val : ℝ) / q + z) * ((p : ℕ) : ℝ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I))
doc: /-- Pointwise expansion of the prime series at a shifted unit fraction. -/

name: sum_normSq_chi_combo
header:
private theorem sum_normSq_chi_combo (N q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (hN : 1 ≤ N) (z : ℝ) :
    ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
        ‖∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z‖ ^ 2
      = (q.totient : ℝ) *
          ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, ‖characterPrime519 χ N z‖ ^ 2 * ‖(∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG))‖ ^ 2
doc:
/-- The squared character combination summed over the reduced residues. The Gauss vectors of
distinct characters are orthogonal, so only the diagonal survives: the sum is the totient times
the character squares weighted by the squared Gauss norms at `1`. -/

name: card_reduced_aux1622
header:
private theorem card_reduced_aux1622 (q : ℕ) :
    ((Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q)).card = q.totient
doc:
/-- The squared character combination summed over the reduced residues. The Gauss vectors of
distinct characters are orthogonal, so only the diagonal survives: the sum is the totient times
the character squares weighted by the squared Gauss norms at `1`. -/
private theorem sum_normSq_chi_combo (N q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (hN : 1 ≤ N) (z : ℝ) :
    ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
        ‖∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z‖ ^ 2
      = (q.totient : ℝ) *
          ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, ‖characterPrime519 χ N z‖ ^ 2 * ‖(∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG))‖ ^ 2 := by
  classical
  have hreal : ∀ w : ℂ, ‖w‖ ^ 2 = (w * (starRingEnd ℂ) w).re := by
    intro w
    rw [Complex.mul_conj, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  have hresumA : ∀ f : ZMod q → ℂ,
      (∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a), (f a).re)
        = (∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a), f a).re := by
    intro f
    have h := map_sum Complex.reCLM f
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a))
    simpa only [Complex.reCLM_apply] using h.symm
  have hresumC : ∀ f : DirichletCharacter ℂ q → ℂ,
      (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (f χ).re) = (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, f χ).re := by
    intro f
    have h := map_sum Complex.reCLM f (Finset.univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ q))
    simpa only [Complex.reCLM_apply] using h.symm
  have hre : ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q,
      ((characterPrime519 χ N z * (starRingEnd ℂ) (characterPrime519 χ N z)) *
          ((q.totient : ℂ) * ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)))))).re
        = (q.totient : ℝ) * (‖characterPrime519 χ N z‖ ^ 2 * ‖(∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG))‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro χ
    rw [Complex.mul_conj, Complex.mul_conj]
    rw [show ((q.totient : ℂ)) = (((q.totient : ℝ)) : ℂ) by simp]
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    ring
  have hcomplex :
      ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
          (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z) *
            (starRingEnd ℂ) (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z)
        = ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q,
            (characterPrime519 χ N z * (starRingEnd ℂ) (characterPrime519 χ N z)) *
              ((q.totient : ℂ) * ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG))))) := by
    have hexp : ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
          (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z) *
            (starRingEnd ℂ) (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z)
        = ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
            ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, ∑ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ q,
              ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z) *
                (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ' cG)) * characterPrime519 χ' N z) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
      rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    rw [hexp, Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun χ _ => ?_)
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have hfac : ∀ a : ZMod q,
        ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z) *
            (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z)
        = (characterPrime519 χ N z * (starRingEnd ℂ) (characterPrime519 χ N z)) *
            ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)))) := by
      intro a
      rw [map_mul]
      ring
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single χ]
    · have hstep : ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
            ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z) *
              (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z)
          = (characterPrime519 χ N z * (starRingEnd ℂ) (characterPrime519 χ N z)) *
              ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
                ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)))) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hfac a)
      rw [hstep, sum_Gunit_orth χ χ, if_pos rfl]
    · intro χ' _ hne
      have hfac' : ∀ a : ZMod q,
          ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z) *
              (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ' cG)) * characterPrime519 χ' N z)
          = (characterPrime519 χ N z * (starRingEnd ℂ) (characterPrime519 χ' N z)) *
              ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ' cG)))) := by
        intro a
        rw [map_mul]
        ring
      have hstep : ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
            ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z) *
              (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ' cG)) * characterPrime519 χ' N z)
          = (characterPrime519 χ N z * (starRingEnd ℂ) (characterPrime519 χ' N z)) *
              ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
                ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ' cG)))) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hfac' a)
      rw [hstep, sum_Gunit_orth χ χ', if_neg (fun h => hne h.symm), mul_zero]
    · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ χ) h
  calc ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
        ‖∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z‖ ^ 2
      = ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
          ((∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z) *
            (starRingEnd ℂ) (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z)).re := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
        exact hreal _
    _ = (∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
          (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z) *
            (starRingEnd ℂ) (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z)).re := by
        exact hresumA _
    _ = (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q,
          (characterPrime519 χ N z * (starRingEnd ℂ) (characterPrime519 χ N z)) *
            ((q.totient : ℂ) * ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)))))).re := by
        rw [hcomplex]
    _ = ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q,
          (q.totient : ℝ) * (‖characterPrime519 χ N z‖ ^ 2 * ‖(∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG))‖ ^ 2) := by
        rw [← hresumC]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun χ _ => hre χ)
    _ = (q.totient : ℝ) *
          ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, ‖characterPrime519 χ N z‖ ^ 2 * ‖(∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG))‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]

end

name: pointwise_assembly
header:
private theorem pointwise_assembly (N q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hq : 2 ≤ q) (z : ℝ) :
    (∑ a ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q),
        ‖primeFourier111_up111 N ((a : ℝ) / q + z)‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (8 / (q.totient : ℝ)) *
        (‖characterPrime519 (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) N z‖ ^ 2 +
          (q : ℝ) * ∑ χ ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q => χ ≠ 1),
            ‖characterPrime519 χ N z‖ ^ 2) +
        8 * (q.totient : ℝ) * Real.log q ^ 2
doc:
/-- The squared character combination summed over the reduced residues. The Gauss vectors of
distinct characters are orthogonal, so only the diagonal survives: the sum is the totient times
the character squares weighted by the squared Gauss norms at `1`. -/
private theorem sum_normSq_chi_combo (N q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (hN : 1 ≤ N) (z : ℝ) :
    ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
        ‖∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z‖ ^ 2
      = (q.totient : ℝ) *
          ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, ‖characterPrime519 χ N z‖ ^ 2 * ‖(∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG))‖ ^ 2 := by
  classical
  have hreal : ∀ w : ℂ, ‖w‖ ^ 2 = (w * (starRingEnd ℂ) w).re := by
    intro w
    rw [Complex.mul_conj, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  have hresumA : ∀ f : ZMod q → ℂ,
      (∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a), (f a).re)
        = (∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a), f a).re := by
    intro f
    have h := map_sum Complex.reCLM f
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a))
    simpa only [Complex.reCLM_apply] using h.symm
  have hresumC : ∀ f : DirichletCharacter ℂ q → ℂ,
      (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (f χ).re) = (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, f χ).re := by
    intro f
    have h := map_sum Complex.reCLM f (Finset.univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ q))
    simpa only [Complex.reCLM_apply] using h.symm
  have hre : ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q,
      ((characterPrime519 χ N z * (starRingEnd ℂ) (characterPrime519 χ N z)) *
          ((q.totient : ℂ) * ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)))))).re
        = (q.totient : ℝ) * (‖characterPrime519 χ N z‖ ^ 2 * ‖(∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG))‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro χ
    rw [Complex.mul_conj, Complex.mul_conj]
    rw [show ((q.totient : ℂ)) = (((q.totient : ℝ)) : ℂ) by simp]
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    ring
  have hcomplex :
      ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
          (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z) *
            (starRingEnd ℂ) (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z)
        = ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q,
            (characterPrime519 χ N z * (starRingEnd ℂ) (characterPrime519 χ N z)) *
              ((q.totient : ℂ) * ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG))))) := by
    have hexp : ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
          (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z) *
            (starRingEnd ℂ) (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z)
        = ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
            ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, ∑ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ q,
              ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z) *
                (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ' cG)) * characterPrime519 χ' N z) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
      rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    rw [hexp, Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun χ _ => ?_)
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have hfac : ∀ a : ZMod q,
        ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z) *
            (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z)
        = (characterPrime519 χ N z * (starRingEnd ℂ) (characterPrime519 χ N z)) *
            ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)))) := by
      intro a
      rw [map_mul]
      ring
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single χ]
    · have hstep : ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
            ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z) *
              (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z)
          = (characterPrime519 χ N z * (starRingEnd ℂ) (characterPrime519 χ N z)) *
              ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
                ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)))) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hfac a)
      rw [hstep, sum_Gunit_orth χ χ, if_pos rfl]
    · intro χ' _ hne
      have hfac' : ∀ a : ZMod q,
          ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z) *
              (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ' cG)) * characterPrime519 χ' N z)
          = (characterPrime519 χ N z * (starRingEnd ℂ) (characterPrime519 χ' N z)) *
              ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ' cG)))) := by
        intro a
        rw [map_mul]
        ring
      have hstep : ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
            ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z) *
              (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ' cG)) * characterPrime519 χ' N z)
          = (characterPrime519 χ N z * (starRingEnd ℂ) (characterPrime519 χ' N z)) *
              ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
                ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ' cG)))) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hfac' a)
      rw [hstep, sum_Gunit_orth χ χ', if_neg (fun h => hne h.symm), mul_zero]
    · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ χ) h
  calc ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
        ‖∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z‖ ^ 2
      = ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
          ((∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z) *
            (starRingEnd ℂ) (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z)).re := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
        exact hreal _
    _ = (∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
          (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z) *
            (starRingEnd ℂ) (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime519 χ N z)).re := by
        exact hresumA _
    _ = (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q,
          (characterPrime519 χ N z * (starRingEnd ℂ) (characterPrime519 χ N z)) *
            ((q.totient : ℂ) * ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)))))).re := by
        rw [hcomplex]
    _ = ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q,
          (q.totient : ℝ) * (‖characterPrime519 χ N z‖ ^ 2 * ‖(∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG))‖ ^ 2) := by
        rw [← hresumC]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun χ _ => hre χ)
    _ = (q.totient : ℝ) *
          ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, ‖characterPrime519 χ N z‖ ^ 2 * ‖(∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG))‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]

end

name: rational_pointwise_characters519
header:
theorem rational_pointwise_characters519 :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∀ (N q : ℕ) [NeZero q], 1 ≤ N → 2 ≤ q → ∀ z : ℝ,
      (∑ a ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q),
        ‖primeFourier111_up111 N ((a : ℝ) / q + z)‖ ^ 2) ≤
      B / (q.totient : ℝ) *
        (‖characterPrime519 (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) N z‖ ^ 2 +
          (q : ℝ) * ∑ χ ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q => χ ≠ 1),
            ‖characterPrime519 χ N z‖ ^ 2) +
        B * (q.totient : ℝ) * Real.log q ^ 2
doc:
/-- LEAF. The finite unit character step, pointwise in z. At any z the sum of the squares
of the prime system shifted to the reduced residues below q is at most a constant over the
totient of q times the principal square plus q times the sum of the nonprincipal squares,
plus a constant times the totient of q times the square of the logarithm of q. The
orthogonality of the unit group gives the coefficient one over the totient, the Gauss
squares are bounded by q, and the primes dividing q are absorbed in the logarithmic term.
No tau, no integration and no growth hypothesis occurs. -/

name: doubled_system_characters1622_split
header:
theorem doubled_system_characters1622_split :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∀ (N q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (τ : ℝ), 1 ≤ N → 2 ≤ q → 4 ≤ τ →
      (∫ α in arcSystem519 q τ ∩ Set.Icc 0 1, ‖primeFourier111_up111 N α‖ ^ 2) ≤
        B / (q.totient : ℝ) *
          ((∫ z in -(2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ))..(2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ)),
              ‖characterPrime519 (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) N z‖ ^ 2) +
            (q : ℝ) * ∑ χ ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q => χ ≠ 1),
              ∫ z in -(2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ))..(2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ)),
                ‖characterPrime519 χ N z‖ ^ 2) +
        B * (q.totient : ℝ) * (2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ)) * Real.log q ^ 2
doc:
/-- The doubled system mass, from the two geometry steps and the pointwise finite
character bound. The target statement is unchanged. -/

name: mellin_kernel_domination519
header:
theorem mellin_kernel_domination519 (N : ℕ) (α B0 : ℝ) (hB0 : 0 ≤ B0)
    (M : ℝ → ℂ) (hM : (Continuous M ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, ‖M t‖ ≤ B0 * Real.log ((N : ℝ) * (|t| + 2)) ^ 3))
    (hI : Integrable (fun t : ℝ => ‖mellinKernel519 N α t‖ *

        Real.log ((N : ℝ) * (|t| + 2)) ^ 3)
doc:

Mellin integral by B0 over two pi times its absolute weighted kernel
mass. This is the norm integral inequality alone. -/

Gamma factor is bounded by square root of two pi times three plus
