header: noncomputable def mellinU1622 (N : ℕ) (M : ℝ → ℂ) (α : ℝ) : ℂ
doc:
/-- P0093 page 156 equation 4.1. U of alpha for a coefficient M on the line,
written over the real variable t. The factor 1 over 2 pi i and ds equal to i dt
leave 1 over 2 pi. -/

name: LineBound1622
header: def LineBound1622 (N : ℕ) (B0 : ℝ) (M : ℝ → ℂ) : Prop
doc:
/-- P0093 page 156 Lemma 2 hypothesis. M is continuous on the line and bounded by
B0 times ln cubed of N times the sum of |t| and 2. -/

name: lineBound_zero1622
header:
theorem lineBound_zero1622 (N : ℕ) (B0 : ℝ) (hB0 : 0 ≤ B0) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    LineBound1622 N B0 (fun _ => 0)
doc: /-- Vacuity instance for LineBound1622: the zero coefficient satisfies it. -/

name: crude_bound_not_negligible493
header:
theorem crude_bound_not_negligible493 (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) :
    ¬ (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N0 < N →
      C * (N : ℝ) * (Real.log N / Real.log 2) ^ k ≤ ε * scale111 k N)
doc:
/-- The full period bound with k powers of the logarithm cannot be arbitrarily
small relative to scale111 along large even integers. The two missing logarithmic
powers require an additional saving. Source: P0093 pages 166 and 167. -/

name: continuous_mellin_integrand_positive493
header:
theorem continuous_mellin_integrand_positive493 (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (M : ℝ → ℂ) (hM : Continuous M) :
    Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => mellinKernel442 N p.1 p.2 * M p.2)
doc:
/-- P0093 page 157 finite contour. At every positive natural N a continuous
coefficient gives a jointly continuous signed Mellin integrand. The real part
of its base is positive and the line avoids every Gamma pole. -/

name: log_weight_cubic_positive493
header:
theorem log_weight_cubic_positive493 (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ t : ℝ,
      Real.log ((N : ℝ) * (|t| + 2)) ^ 3 ≤ C * (1 + |t|) ^ 3
doc:
/-- P0093 page 157 logarithmic line weight. For every positive natural N,
the log cubed weight is bounded by a positive constant times one plus absolute
t to power three. -/

name: weighted_kernel_integrable_positive493
header:
theorem weighted_kernel_integrable_positive493 (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (α : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun t : ℝ => ‖mellinKernel442 N α t‖ *
      Real.log ((N : ℝ) * (|t| + 2)) ^ 3)
doc:
/-- P0093 page 157 before equation 4.4. The absolute Mellin kernel with its
log cubed line weight is integrable for every positive natural N and fixed phase.
A Gamma recurrence covers the small parameter strip. -/

name: doubled_system_characters1622
header:
theorem doubled_system_characters1622 :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∀ (N q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (τ : ℝ), 1 ≤ N → 2 ≤ q → 4 ≤ τ →
      (∫ α in arcSystem111 q τ ∩ Set.Icc 0 1, ‖primeFourier111 N α‖ ^ 2) ≤
        B / (q.totient : ℝ) *
          ((∫ z in -(2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ))..(2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ)),
              ‖characterPrime280 (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) N z‖ ^ 2) +
            (q : ℝ) * ∑ χ ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q => χ ≠ 1),
              ∫ z in -(2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ))..(2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ)),
                ‖characterPrime280 χ N z‖ ^ 2) +
        B * (q.totient : ℝ) * (2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ)) * Real.log q ^ 2
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 155 equation 2.3, page 156 Lemma 1, and the orthogonality
chain on page 160 before equation 5.4, for the square norm. Fix q at least 2. The
square integral of S over F_q clipped to the unit interval is at most B over phi of q
times the principal integral plus q times the sum of the nonprincipal integrals
over the interval of radius r equal to 2 over q tau, plus the error of size
phi of q times r times ln squared q from equation 2.3. Unconditional, for any tau
at least 4 and any N at least 1. -/

name: principal_mass1622
header:
theorem principal_mass1622 :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∀ (N q : ℕ) (r : ℝ), 1 ≤ N → 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 / 2 →
      (∫ z in -r..r, ‖characterPrime280 (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) N z‖ ^ 2) ≤ B * (N : ℝ)
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 159 trivial estimate before equation 5.3. The square integral
of the principal character sum over an interval of radius r at most 1/2 is at most
B N, by the full period. Unconditional. -/

name: totient_sqrt_lower1622
header:
theorem totient_sqrt_lower1622 (q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    Real.sqrt q ≤ 2 * (q.totient : ℝ)
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 166 equation 9.3, the factor 1 over Q to the 0.99 uses a lower
bound for phi of q on the range q above Q. The weaker classical form suffices. -/

name: doubled_eventual1622
header:
theorem doubled_eventual1622 :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, Real.log N ^ 13 ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) ∧
      Real.log N ^ 2 ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) ∧ 1 ≤ Real.log N ∧
      (2 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ)
doc: /-- Eventual comparison of the three terms with N to ninety eight hundredths. -/

name: doubled_system_mass_recut1622
header:
theorem doubled_system_mass_recut1622 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ q : ℕ, (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) →
        (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) →
          (∫ α in arcSystem111 q ((N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) ∩ Set.Icc 0 1,
            ‖primeFourier111 N α‖ ^ 2) ≤ C * (N : ℝ) ^ (98 / 100 : ℝ)
doc:
/-- P0093 page 166 equation 9.1, in the weakened form used by equation 9.3.
Exact doubled_system_mass376 statement. CONDITIONAL on the three leaves above and
the three leaves of SPLIT1622_mellin. -/

name: arc_local_expansion1622
header:
theorem arc_local_expansion1622 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) (hM : MellinBound280) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, LocalExpansion1622 B N0
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 161 equation 6.4, with pages 159 to 161 equations 3.4, 5.4,
5.5 and 6.3, in the form with the exact convolution before its asymptotic. One
modulus q at most N to one tenth and one residual n at most N. The factor exp of
minus n over N keeps the damping that the printed e to the minus 1 absorbs with the
tuple weight. For n at most 3 the main term is zero. There is no tuple sum and no T. -/

name: major_bookkeeping1622
header:
theorem major_bookkeeping1622 (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 < B) (N0 : ℕ)
    (hL : LocalExpansion1622 B N0) (B' : ℝ) (hB' : 0 < B')
    (hC : ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n →
      |logConvolution1622 n - (n : ℝ) / Real.log n ^ 2| ≤
        B' * ((n : ℝ) / Real.log n ^ 2) * (1 / Real.sqrt (Real.log n))) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∃ N1 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → N1 < N →
      |arcContribution280 k N (majorArcs280 N) - truncatedMain357 k N| ≤
        A * majorRelative376 k N +
          A * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 - (1 / 1000 : ℝ)) * Real.log N ^ (k + 13)
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 165 equation 8.1 and page 166 equation 8.2. The tuple
bookkeeping. Given the local expansion and the convolution estimate, expand T to
the k, exchange sum and integral, use disjointness of the arcs and periodicity at
the end points, and sum the errors over tuples and q at most Q. Here Q over tau plus
the square root of Q over tau is at most 2 N to minus 3 over 140, printed as N to
minus 1 over 68. No GRH. No analytic number theory: both inputs are hypotheses. -/

name: mellin_transfer1622
header:
theorem mellin_transfer1622 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ B0 : ℝ, 0 < B0 ∧ ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) →
        ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, χ ≠ 1 →
          ∃ M : ℝ → ℂ, LineBound1622 N B0 M ∧ ∀ α : ℝ,
            ‖characterPrime280 χ N α - mellinU1622 N M α‖ ≤ B * Real.sqrt N
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 159 before equation 5.1, with the zero free half plane under
GRH and ln L of order ln cubed on the line. For a nonprincipal character, A_chi
equals the Mellin integral of ln L up to the prime power sum. That sum is pointwise
at most B times the square root of N. It is not displayed on page 159, see the
FINDING in PROGRESS. No integral over alpha occurs. -/

name: lemma2_central1622
header:
theorem lemma2_central1622 (B0 : ℝ) (hB0 : 0 < B0) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N → ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R →
      R ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (2 / 7 : ℝ) → ∀ M : ℝ → ℂ, LineBound1622 N B0 M →
        ∀ α : ℝ, |α| ≤ 4 / (N : ℝ) →
          ‖mellinU1622 N M α‖ ≤ B * (N : ℝ) / Real.sqrt R * Real.log N ^ 3
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 158 display before equation 4.8, on the central interval
only. For any coefficient with the line bound, U is at most B times N over the
square root of R times ln cubed N when |alpha| is at most 4 over N. Here R stands
for q tau. No GRH, no primes. -/

name: lemma2_outer1622
header:
theorem lemma2_outer1622 (B0 : ℝ) (hB0 : 0 < B0) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N → ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R →
      R ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (2 / 7 : ℝ) → ∀ M : ℝ → ℂ, LineBound1622 N B0 M →
        IntervalIntegrable (fun α : ℝ => ‖mellinU1622 N M α‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume
          (4 / (N : ℝ)) (1 / R) ∧
        (∫ α in (4 / (N : ℝ))..(1 / R), ‖mellinU1622 N M α‖ ^ 2) ≤
          B * ((N : ℝ) / R * Real.log N ^ 3) * Real.log N ^ 7
doc:
/-- LEAF. P0093 page 158 equations 4.4 to 4.7. For any coefficient with the line
bound, the square integral of U from 4 over N to 1 over R is at most B times N_0
times ln to the seventh, where N_0 is N over R times ln cubed N. U is square
integrable there. Here R stands for q tau. No GRH, no primes. -/

name: four_rpow1622
header: theorem four_rpow1622 (N : ℕ) (hN : 8 ≤ N) : 4 * (N : ℝ) ^ (2 / 7 : ℝ) ≤ N
doc: /-- For N at least 8 the power 4 times N to the two sevenths is at most N. -/

name: norm_sq_le_of_near1622
header:
theorem norm_sq_le_of_near1622 {x u : ℂ} {b : ℝ} (h : ‖x - u‖ ≤ b) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖u‖ ^ 2 + 2 * b ^ 2
doc:
/-- If x is within b of u, then the square of x is at most twice the square of u
plus twice the square of b. -/

name: mellin_central_general1622
header:
theorem mellin_central_general1622 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) →
        ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, χ ≠ 1 → ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R → R ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (2 / 7 : ℝ) →
          (∫ α in -(4 / (N : ℝ))..(4 / (N : ℝ)), ‖characterPrime280 χ N α‖ ^ 2) ≤
            B * (N : ℝ) / R * Real.log N ^ 6
doc:
/-- P0093 page 158 equation 4.8 at general R. CONDITIONAL on mellin_transfer1622
and lemma2_central1622. -/

name: mellin_outer_general1622
header:
theorem mellin_outer_general1622 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) →
        ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, χ ≠ 1 → ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R → R ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (2 / 7 : ℝ) →
          (∫ α in (4 / (N : ℝ))..(1 / R), ‖characterPrime280 χ N α‖ ^ 2) ≤
            B * (N : ℝ) / R * Real.log N ^ 10
doc:
/-- P0093 page 158 equation 4.7 at general R. CONDITIONAL on mellin_transfer1622
and lemma2_outer1622. -/

name: mellin_outer_negative1622
header:
theorem mellin_outer_negative1622 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) →
        ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, χ ≠ 1 → ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R → R ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (2 / 7 : ℝ) →
          (∫ α in -(1 / R)..-(4 / (N : ℝ)), ‖characterPrime280 χ N α‖ ^ 2) ≤
            B * (N : ℝ) / R * Real.log N ^ 10
doc:
/-- The negative outer interval by conjugate reflection. CONDITIONAL as
mellin_outer_general1622. P0093 page 158 last sentence. -/

name: mellin_radius1622
header:
theorem mellin_radius1622 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) →
        ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, χ ≠ 1 → ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R → R ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (2 / 7 : ℝ) →
          (∫ α in -(1 / R)..(1 / R), ‖characterPrime280 χ N α‖ ^ 2) ≤
            B * (N : ℝ) / R * Real.log N ^ 13
doc:
/-- P0093 page 159 equation 5.2 at radius 1 over R. Page 155 lets tau be any
function of N in its range, and page 166 says the doubled arcs need only a trivial
modification. CONDITIONAL on the three leaves of this file. -/

name: qtau_range1622
doc: /-- q tau with q at most tau is at most N to the two sevenths, and at least 1. -/

name: mellin_near_recut1622
header:
theorem mellin_near_recut1622 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) →
        ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, χ ≠ 1 →
          (∫ α in -(4 / (N : ℝ))..(4 / (N : ℝ)),
            ‖characterPrime280 χ N α‖ ^ 2) ≤
              B * (N : ℝ) / ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) * Real.log N ^ 6
doc:
/-- P0093 page 158 equation 4.8. Exact mellin_near357 statement.
CONDITIONAL on mellin_transfer1622 and lemma2_central1622. -/

name: mellin_positive_far_recut1622
header:
theorem mellin_positive_far_recut1622 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) →
        ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, χ ≠ 1 →
          (∫ α in (4 / (N : ℝ))..(1 / ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ))),
            ‖characterPrime280 χ N α‖ ^ 2) ≤
              B * (N : ℝ) / ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)) * Real.log N ^ 10
doc:
/-- P0093 page 158 equation 4.7 and the substitution for N_0. Exact
mellin_positive_far357 statement. CONDITIONAL on mellin_transfer1622 and
lemma2_outer1622. -/

name: mellin_bound_recut1622
header: theorem mellin_bound_recut1622 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) : MellinBound280
doc:
/-- P0093 page 159 equation 5.2. Exact MellinBound280. CONDITIONAL on the three
leaves of this file. -/

name: exp_neg_abs_le_inv_sq
header:
private lemma exp_neg_abs_le_inv_sq (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (t : ℝ) :
    Real.exp (-(c * |t|)) ≤ (2 + 12 / c ^ 3) * (1 + t ^ 2)⁻¹

name: integrable_exp_neg_abs_mul
header:
private lemma integrable_exp_neg_abs_mul (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    Integrable (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-(c * |t|)))
doc: /-- `exp (-(c * |t|))` is integrable for `c > 0`. -/

name: poly_pow_le_exp
header:
private lemma poly_pow_le_exp (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (k : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    (s + 3) ^ k ≤ (6 ^ k + (4 / c) ^ k * (k.factorial : ℝ)) * Real.exp (c * s / 2)
doc: /-- `(s + 3) ^ k` is dominated by a half exponential. -/

name: gamma_line_decay442
doc:
/-- Gamma decay on the shifted Mellin line (adapted from
`LeanLab.Linnik1951.Gamma442.gamma_mellin_line442`, restated here so that
this file needs only the Mathlib-clean `GammaBounds` module). -/

name: integrable_weight_log
doc: /-- The absolute Mellin weight `(3 + |t|) * log (N (|t| + 2)) ^ m * exp (-c |t|)` is integrable. -/

name: cpow_line_bound_abs442
header:
private theorem cpow_line_bound_abs442 (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N) (z : ℂ)
    (hzre : z.re = 1 / (N : ℝ)) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖z ^ (-(mellinLine1622 N t))‖ ≤
      Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt N * Real.exp (|t| * |z.arg|)
doc: /-- The power factor of the kernel, with the absolute value of the argument. -/

name: continuous_kernel_t442
header:
private theorem continuous_kernel_t442 (N : ℕ) (hN : 3 ≤ N) (z : ℂ)
    (hzre : z.re = 1 / (N : ℝ)) :
    Continuous (fun t : ℝ =>
      ‖z ^ (-(mellinLine1622 N t)) * Complex.Gamma (mellinLine1622 N t)‖ *
        Real.log ((N : ℝ) * (|t| + 2)) ^ 3)
doc: /-- The kernel weight is continuous in the line variable. -/

name: continuous_mass442
header:
private theorem continuous_mass442 (N : ℕ) (hN : 3 ≤ N) (Z : ℝ → ℂ) (hZc : Continuous Z)
    (hZre : ∀ α, (Z α).re = 1 / (N : ℝ)) :
    Continuous (fun α : ℝ =>
      ∫ t : ℝ, ‖Z α ^ (-(mellinLine1622 N t)) * Complex.Gamma (mellinLine1622 N t)‖ *
        Real.log ((N : ℝ) * (|t| + 2)) ^ 3)
doc: /-- The absolute kernel mass is continuous in the frequency. -/

name: outer_kernel_integrable442
header:
theorem outer_kernel_integrable442 (N : ℕ) (hN : 3 ≤ N) (R : ℝ) (hR : 1 ≤ R)
    (α : ℝ) (hα : α ∈ Set.Icc (4 / (N : ℝ)) (1 / R)) :
    Integrable (fun t : ℝ =>
      ‖(((1 / (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((2 * Real.pi * α : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^
          (-(mellinLine1622 N t)) * Complex.Gamma (mellinLine1622 N t)‖ *
        Real.log ((N : ℝ) * (|t| + 2)) ^ 3)
doc:
/-- LEAF. Step 1 of 4: the absolute kernel is log weighted integrable. For N at
least three and any frequency in the outer interval, the shifted line puts the
complex power and the Gamma factor on a fixed real part, and Gamma decay
against the exponential from the power leaves an absolutely integrable
logarithm weighted kernel. No coefficient M occurs. -/

name: outer_kernel_mass_integrable442
header:
theorem outer_kernel_mass_integrable442 (N : ℕ) (hN : 3 ≤ N) (R : ℝ)
    (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hR2 : R ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (2 / 7 : ℝ)) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun α : ℝ =>
      (∫ t : ℝ,
        ‖(((1 / (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((2 * Real.pi * α : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^
            (-(mellinLine1622 N t)) * Complex.Gamma (mellinLine1622 N t)‖ *
          Real.log ((N : ℝ) * (|t| + 2)) ^ 3) ^ 2) volume
      (4 / (N : ℝ)) (1 / R)
doc:
/-- LEAF. Step 2 of 4: the squared kernel mass is interval integrable in the
frequency over the outer interval. This is the measurable and bounded side of
the square expansion of equation 4.5; it carries no coefficient, no character
and no logarithmic bookkeeping. -/

name: continuous_kernel_prod442
doc: /-- The kernel is continuous in the line variable. -/

name: continuous_kernel_norm442
doc: /-- The norm of the kernel is continuous in the line variable. -/

name: continuous_mellinU442
doc: /-- The Mellin integral `U` is continuous in the frequency. -/

name: outer_kernel_mass_bound442
header:
theorem outer_kernel_mass_bound442 :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N → ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R →
      R ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (2 / 7 : ℝ) →
        (∫ α in (4 / (N : ℝ))..(1 / R),
          (∫ t : ℝ,
            ‖(((1 / (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((2 * Real.pi * α : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^
                (-(mellinLine1622 N t)) * Complex.Gamma (mellinLine1622 N t)‖ *
              Real.log ((N : ℝ) * (|t| + 2)) ^ 3) ^ 2) ≤
          C * Real.log N ^ 6 * differenceKernel376 ((N : ℝ) / R * Real.log N ^ 3) +
            C * Real.log N ^ 7 * sumKernel376 ((N : ℝ) / R * Real.log N ^ 3) + C
doc:
/-- LEAF. Step 3 of 4: the square integral of the absolute kernel mass over the
outer frequency interval. The two frequency sign regions of equations 4.4 to
4.6 give the reciprocal difference kernel with log power six and the decaying
sum kernel with log power seven, both at radius N over R times log cubed N, and
the exponentially small contour remainder of equation 4.3 is absorbed by the
additive constant. The coefficient M does not occur in this step. -/

name: outer_mellin_sq_integrable442
header:
theorem outer_mellin_sq_integrable442 (B0 : ℝ) (hB0 : 0 < B0) :
    ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N → ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R →
      R ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (2 / 7 : ℝ) → ∀ M : ℝ → ℂ, LineBound1622 N B0 M →
        IntervalIntegrable (fun α : ℝ => ‖mellinU1622 N M α‖ ^ 2) volume
          (4 / (N : ℝ)) (1 / R)
doc:
/-- LEAF. Step 4 of 4: the square of the Mellin integral is interval integrable
in the frequency over the outer interval, for every coefficient satisfying the
line bound. This is the integrability half of the target conclusion, separated
from the numerical estimate; it contains no kernel bound. -/

name: norm_integral_le_weighted_mass442
header:
private theorem norm_integral_le_weighted_mass442 (N : ℕ) (α B0 : ℝ)
    (M : ℝ → ℂ) (hM : LineBound1622 N B0 M)
    (hI : Integrable (fun t : ℝ =>
      ‖(((1 / (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((2 * Real.pi * α : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^
          (-(mellinLine1622 N t)) * Complex.Gamma (mellinLine1622 N t)‖ *
        Real.log ((N : ℝ) * (|t| + 2)) ^ 3)) :
    ‖∫ t : ℝ,
        ((((1 / (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((2 * Real.pi * α : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^
            (-(mellinLine1622 N t)) * Complex.Gamma (mellinLine1622 N t)) * M t‖ ≤
      B0 * ∫ t : ℝ,
        ‖(((1 / (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((2 * Real.pi * α : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^
            (-(mellinLine1622 N t)) * Complex.Gamma (mellinLine1622 N t)‖ *
          Real.log ((N : ℝ) * (|t| + 2)) ^ 3
doc:
/-- Proved helper, no leaf: a line bound on the coefficient bounds the norm of
the Mellin integral by the absolute log weighted kernel mass. This is the norm
integral inequality applied to the kernel times the coefficient. -/

name: abstract_outer_kernels442_split
header:
theorem abstract_outer_kernels442_split (B0 : ℝ) (hB0 : 0 < B0) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R → R ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (2 / 7 : ℝ) →
        ∀ M : ℝ → ℂ, LineBound1622 N B0 M →
          IntervalIntegrable (fun α : ℝ => ‖mellinU1622 N M α‖ ^ 2) volume
            (4 / (N : ℝ)) (1 / R) ∧
          (∫ α in (4 / (N : ℝ))..(1 / R), ‖mellinU1622 N M α‖ ^ 2) ≤
            A * Real.log N ^ 6 * differenceKernel376 ((N : ℝ) / R * Real.log N ^ 3) +
            A * Real.log N ^ 7 * sumKernel376 ((N : ℝ) / R * Real.log N ^ 3) + A
doc:
/-- Assembly of `abstract_outer_kernels442` from the four leaves. The line bound
removes the coefficient through the proved norm integral bound, the frequency
integration is monotone in the squared kernel mass, and the constants are
chosen so that one multiple absorbs the difference kernel term, the sum kernel
term and the contour remainder. -/

name: logConvolution_eq_zero_of_le_three1622
header:
private theorem logConvolution_eq_zero_of_le_three1622 {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ 3) :
    logConvolution1622 n = 0
doc: /-- The convolution sum is empty, hence zero, for a residual at most three. -/

name: logConvolution_toNat_eq_zero1622
header:
private theorem logConvolution_toNat_eq_zero1622 {n : ℤ} (hn : n ≤ 3) :
    logConvolution1622 n.toNat = 0
doc: /-- The same vanishing at an integer residual, in the form the assembly uses. -/

name: local_arc_shoulder1622
header:
theorem local_arc_shoulder1622 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) (hM : MellinBound280) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N → ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q →
      (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) → ∀ n : ℤ,
        n ≤ N →
        ‖localArc1622 N q n - (∑ a ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q), ∫ z in -(1 / (N : ℝ))..(1 / (N : ℝ)), primeFourier111 N ((a : ℝ) / q + z) ^ 2 * Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * (n : ℝ) * ((a : ℝ) / q + z) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I))‖ ≤
          c * (N : ℝ) * Real.log N ^ 13 * (1 / (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) + 1 / Real.sqrt ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)))
doc:
/-- LEAF. The shoulder step. On the part of every arc outside the interval of length
two over N around its centre the prime square integral is bounded by the local
mean value alone. This is the first error, of size N log N to the thirteenth over
N to the one seventh. No singular series, no Ramanujan sum and no main term occur
in it, and the residual enters only through the phase. -/

name: local_arc_core_modulus1622
header:
theorem local_arc_core_modulus1622 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) (hM : MellinBound280) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N → ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q →
      (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) → 2 ≤ q → ∀ n : ℤ,
        (4 : ℤ) ≤ n →
        n ≤ N →
        ‖(∑ a ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q), ∫ z in -(1 / (N : ℝ))..(1 / (N : ℝ)), primeFourier111 N ((a : ℝ) / q + z) ^ 2 * Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * (n : ℝ) * ((a : ℝ) / q + z) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) - ((((ArithmeticFunction.moebius q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (q.totient : ℝ) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * LeanLab.Perelli1996.Ramanujan103.ramanujanSum q n.toNat * ((Real.exp (-(n.toNat : ℝ) / N) * logConvolution1622 n.toNat : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ≤
          c * (N : ℝ) * Real.log N ^ 13 * (1 / (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) + 1 / Real.sqrt ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)))
doc:
/-- LEAF. The core step at a modulus above one. On the interval of length two over N
around the centre of an arc the sum over the reduced residues of the prime square
with its phase is the singular coefficient times the Ramanujan sum at the residual,
and the integral over the core of the damped square is the damped convolution of
the main term. This is the second error only; the singular integral itself is not
estimated here. -/

name: local_arc_core_unit1622
header:
theorem local_arc_core_unit1622 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) (hM : MellinBound280) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N → ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q →
      (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) → q = 1 → ∀ n : ℤ,
        (4 : ℤ) ≤ n →
        n ≤ N →
        ‖(∑ a ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q), ∫ z in -(1 / (N : ℝ))..(1 / (N : ℝ)), primeFourier111 N ((a : ℝ) / q + z) ^ 2 * Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * (n : ℝ) * ((a : ℝ) / q + z) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) - ((((ArithmeticFunction.moebius q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (q.totient : ℝ) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * LeanLab.Perelli1996.Ramanujan103.ramanujanSum q n.toNat * ((Real.exp (-(n.toNat : ℝ) / N) * logConvolution1622 n.toNat : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ ≤
          c * (N : ℝ) * Real.log N ^ 13 * (1 / (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) + 1 / Real.sqrt ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)))
doc:
/-- LEAF. The core step at the unit modulus, where the reduced residue is only zero
and the singular coefficient and the totient both equal one. Same core estimate as
at a modulus above one, with the residual at least four. -/

name: local_arc_small_residual1622
header:
theorem local_arc_small_residual1622 (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) (hM : MellinBound280) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N → ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q →
      (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) → ∀ n : ℤ,
        n ≤ 3 →
        n ≤ N →
        ‖localArc1622 N q n‖ ≤
          c * (N : ℝ) * Real.log N ^ 13 * (1 / (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ) + 1 / Real.sqrt ((q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)))
doc:
/-- LEAF. The small residual step. At a residual at most three the convolution is an
empty sum, so the target main term vanishes and the local arc integral alone must
be bounded by the two error sizes. No singular series occurs. -/

name: arc_local_expansion1622_split
header:
theorem arc_local_expansion1622_split (hG : LeanLab.DERZ1997.GRH) (hM : MellinBound280) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, LocalExpansion1622 B N0
doc:
/-- The local major arc expansion, from the two shoulder and core errors and the two
residual cases. The target statement is unchanged. -/

name: pi_gap442
header: private lemma pi_gap442 : (0 : ℝ) < Real.pi / 2 - 1 / (16 * Real.pi)
doc: /-- The gap in the principal argument: `pi / 2 - 1 / (16 * pi)` is strictly positive. -/

name: arg_base_bound442
header:
private lemma arg_base_bound442 (N : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (hN : 2 ≤ N) (hα : |α| ≤ 4 / (N : ℝ)) :
    |Complex.arg ((((1 / (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) +
        ((2 * Real.pi * α : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I))| ≤
      Real.pi / 2 - 1 / (16 * Real.pi)
doc:
/-- The principal argument of the base `1 / N + 2 pi alpha i` of the Mellin power factor
stays `1 / (16 * pi)` away from `pi / 2` when `|alpha| ≤ 4 / N`: the modulus of the base is at
most `(1 / N) sqrt (1 + (8 pi) ^ 2)`, so its cosine is at least `1 / sqrt (1 + (8 pi) ^ 2)`,
which is at least `1 / (16 pi)`, which is at least `sin (1 / (16 pi))`. -/

name: mellin_base_bound442
header:
theorem mellin_base_bound442 (N : ℕ) (α t : ℝ) (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    (hα : |α| ≤ 4 / (N : ℝ)) :
    ‖(((1 / (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((2 * Real.pi * α : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^
        (-(mellinLine1622 N t))‖ ≤
      Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt N *
        Real.exp (|t| * (Real.pi / 2 - 1 / (16 * Real.pi)))
doc:
/-- LEAF. First step of the parent proof, the modulus of the power factor.
For N at least two and alpha at most four over N the base of the power has
real part one over N and imaginary part at most eight pi over N, so the
imaginary part of its logarithm is at most pi over two minus one over
sixteen pi; its modulus is at least one over N, and N to the power a half
plus one over log N is at most e times the square root of N. No Gamma
factor, no logarithm of N, no integral here. -/

name: log_cube_split442
header:
theorem log_cube_split442 (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (hN : 2 ≤ N) :
    Real.log ((N : ℝ) * (|t| + 2)) ^ 3 ≤
      8 * Real.log N ^ 3 + 8 * Real.log (|t| + 2) ^ 3
doc:
/-- LEAF. Second step of the parent proof, the split of the logarithm.
For N at least two the logarithm of N times the sum of absolute t and two
is the sum of two nonnegative logarithms, so its cube is at most eight
cubes of log N plus eight cubes of the logarithm of the sum. -/

name: integrable_exp_neg_abs442
header:
private lemma integrable_exp_neg_abs442 (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    Integrable (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-b * |t|))
doc: /-- `exp (-b * |t|)` is integrable on the line for `b > 0`. -/

name: shift_pow_five_le_exp442
header:
private lemma shift_pow_five_le_exp442 (e : ℝ) (he : 0 < e) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, (|t| + 4) ^ 5 ≤ K * Real.exp (e * |t|)
doc:
/-- A fifth power is dominated by a constant times `exp (e * |t|)` for every `e > 0`: this is
Taylor's inequality `v ^ 5 ≤ 5 ! exp v` at `v = e * (|t| + 4)`, together with
`e * (|t| + 4) = e * |t| + 4 * e`. -/

name: integrable_majorant442
header:
private lemma integrable_majorant442 :
    Integrable (fun t : ℝ => (|t| + 4) ^ 5 * Real.exp (-(1 / (16 * Real.pi)) * |t|))
doc:
/-- The majorant `(|t| + 4) ^ 5 exp (-|t| / (16 pi))` of the twisted Gamma mass is
integrable on the line. -/

name: continuous_mellinLine442
header:
private lemma continuous_mellinLine442 (N : ℕ) :
    Continuous fun t : ℝ => mellinLine1622 N t
doc: /-- `mellinLine1622 N` is continuous in `t`. -/

name: gamma_line_uniform442
doc:
/-- The Gamma factor on the shifted Mellin line decays exponentially in `|t|` for every
`N ≥ 2`. For a line with real part at most `3 / 2` this is `gamma_absolute_decay442`; otherwise
the real part is at most `5 / 2` and `Gamma s = (s - 1) Gamma (s - 1)` moves it into the strip. -/

name: gamma_twist_pointwise442
header:
private lemma gamma_twist_pointwise442 (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N) (t : ℝ) :
    Real.exp (|t| * (Real.pi / 2 - 1 / (16 * Real.pi))) *
        ‖Complex.Gamma (mellinLine1622 N t)‖ * (1 + Real.log (|t| + 2) ^ 3) ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * 2 *
        ((|t| + 4) ^ 5 * Real.exp (-(1 / (16 * Real.pi)) * |t|))
doc: /-- Pointwise domination of the twisted Gamma mass with a logarithm factor. -/

name: continuous_gamma_mellin442
header:
private lemma continuous_gamma_mellin442 (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N) :
    Continuous fun t : ℝ => Complex.Gamma (mellinLine1622 N t)
doc:
/-- `Gamma` composed with the shifted Mellin line is continuous: the line has positive real
part, so it stays away from the poles of `Gamma`. -/

name: gamma_twist_mass442
header:
theorem gamma_twist_mass442 :
    ∃ G : ℝ, 0 < G ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, 2 ≤ N →
      Integrable (fun t : ℝ =>
        Real.exp (|t| * (Real.pi / 2 - 1 / (16 * Real.pi))) *
          ‖Complex.Gamma (mellinLine1622 N t)‖) ∧
      Integrable (fun t : ℝ =>
        Real.exp (|t| * (Real.pi / 2 - 1 / (16 * Real.pi))) *
          (‖Complex.Gamma (mellinLine1622 N t)‖ * Real.log (|t| + 2) ^ 3)) ∧
      (∫ t : ℝ, Real.exp (|t| * (Real.pi / 2 - 1 / (16 * Real.pi))) *
        ‖Complex.Gamma (mellinLine1622 N t)‖) ≤ G ∧
      (∫ t : ℝ, Real.exp (|t| * (Real.pi / 2 - 1 / (16 * Real.pi))) *
        (‖Complex.Gamma (mellinLine1622 N t)‖ *
          Real.log (|t| + 2) ^ 3)) ≤ G
doc:
/-- LEAF. Third step of the parent proof, the twisted Gamma mass. The
Gamma factor on the line, weighted by the exponential gap of the power
factor and by the cube of the logarithm of the sum of absolute t and two,
is integrable for every N at least two, and both of its integrals are at
most one constant independent of N and of alpha. This is the analytic core
of the parent proof and the only place where the decay of Gamma is used. -/

name: kernel_mass_integrable442
header:
theorem kernel_mass_integrable442 (N : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (hN : 32 ≤ N)
    (hα : |α| ≤ 4 / (N : ℝ)) :
    Integrable (fun t : ℝ => ‖mellinKernel442 N α t‖ *
      Real.log ((N : ℝ) * (|t| + 2)) ^ 3)
doc:
/-- LEAF. Fourth step of the parent proof, the integrability half of the
parent conclusion. The modulus of the kernel times the cube of the
logarithm of N times the sum of absolute t and two is integrable, for N at
least thirty two and alpha at most four over N. This is the first
conjunct of the parent statement on its own, without any estimate of the
integral. -/

name: mass_constant442
header:
theorem mass_constant442 (N : ℕ) (G : ℝ) (hN : 32 ≤ N) (hG : 0 < G) :
    8 * Real.exp 1 * Real.sqrt N * (Real.log N ^ 3 * G + G) ≤
      8 * Real.exp 1 * G * (1 + 1 / Real.log 2 ^ 3) * Real.sqrt N *
        Real.log N ^ 3
doc:
/-- LEAF. Fifth step of the parent proof, the bookkeeping of the constant.
For N at least thirty two and a positive constant G, eight e times the
square root of N times the cube of log N times G plus G is at most the
cube of log N times the square root of N times the constant eight e G
times one plus the inverse cube of log two. The last factor absorbs the
additive G because the cube of log N is at least the cube of log two. -/

name: central_kernel_mass442_split
header:
theorem central_kernel_mass442_split :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ α : ℝ, |α| ≤ 4 / (N : ℝ) →
        Integrable (fun t : ℝ => ‖mellinKernel442 N α t‖ *
          Real.log ((N : ℝ) * (|t| + 2)) ^ 3) ∧
        (∫ t : ℝ, ‖mellinKernel442 N α t‖ *
          Real.log ((N : ℝ) * (|t| + 2)) ^ 3) ≤
            C * Real.sqrt N * Real.log N ^ 3
doc:
/-- The parent statement central_kernel_mass442, reassembled from the five
leaves above. No use of the parent theorem, no sorry. -/

name: conjGauss_one491
header:
private lemma conjGauss_one491 (q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    conjugateGauss491 q (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) = (ArithmeticFunction.moebius q : ℂ)
doc:
/-- LEAF. The conjugate Gauss coefficient of the principal character is the
Moebius value at the modulus. -/

name: pair_one_one491
header:
private lemma pair_one_one491 (N q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (n : ℤ) :
    characterPair491 N q n 1 1 = principalTerm491 N q n
doc: /-- LEAF. The ordered pair of two principal characters is the principal term. -/

name: character_square_expansion_nonneg491
header:
theorem character_square_expansion_nonneg491 :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ q : ℕ, ∀ hq : 1 ≤ q, (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) →
        ∀ n : ℤ, 0 ≤ n →
          ‖localArc1622 N q n -
              (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, ∑ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q,
                characterPair491 N q n χ ψ)‖ ≤
            C * (N : ℝ) * Real.log q / (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)
doc:
/-- LEAF. Finite character square expansion at a nonnegative residual. For a
modulus inside the admissible range, the local arc at a residual that is at
least zero differs from the double sum of the ordered character pair
contribution by no more than the stated logarithm of the modulus, the residual
coming only from the primes dividing the modulus and the finite integral
rearrangement. -/

name: character_square_expansion_neg491
header:
theorem character_square_expansion_neg491 :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ q : ℕ, ∀ hq : 1 ≤ q, (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) →
        ∀ n : ℤ, n < 0 →
          ‖localArc1622 N q n -
              (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, ∑ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q,
                characterPair491 N q n χ ψ)‖ ≤
            C * (N : ℝ) * Real.log q / (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 7 : ℝ)
doc:
/-- LEAF. Finite character square expansion at a negative residual. The same
expansion as at a nonnegative residual, with the reduced residue phase replaced
by its conjugate, which changes no norm; the primes dividing the modulus and the
finite integral rearrangement are again the whole residual. -/

name: character_square_matching491
header:
theorem character_square_matching491 (N q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (n : ℤ) :
    (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, ∑ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q,
        characterPair491 N q n χ ψ) =
      principalTerm491 N q n + mixedTerm491 N q n + nonprincipalTerm491 N q n
doc:
/-- LEAF. Exact separation of the finite character square. The double sum over
all ordered character pairs is the principal pair, that is the reduced residue
phase against the square of the principal prime series, plus the two mixed
blocks with exactly one principal character plus the block with both characters
nonprincipal. This is a finite rearrangement of the same sum with no error. -/

name: character_decomposition491_split
header:
theorem character_decomposition491_split :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N0 : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N0 < N →
      ∀ q : ℕ, ∀ hq : 1 ≤ q, (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) →
        letI : NeZero q
doc:
/-- The three character term decomposition, assembled from the finite character
square expansion at each residual sign and from the exact separation of that
square. -/

name: integral_exp_two_pi_mul_int357
header:
theorem integral_exp_two_pi_mul_int357 (m : ℤ) :
    (∫ α in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * (m : ℝ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I)) =
      if m = 0 then 1 else 0
doc:
/-- LEAF. Step 1 of the proof, the orthogonal integral: the integral over the
unit interval of a complex exponential of an integral frequency is one at
frequency zero and zero at every other integral frequency. -/

name: tsum_fintype_pi_pow357
header:
private theorem tsum_fintype_pi_pow357 (f : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hf : Summable (fun n => ‖f n‖)) (k : ℕ) :
    Summable (fun ν : Fin k → ℕ => ∏ i, f (ν i)) ∧
      (∑' n, f n) ^ k = ∑' ν : Fin k → ℕ, ∏ i, f (ν i)
doc:
/-- LEAF. Step 1 of the proof, the orthogonal integral: the integral over the
unit interval of a complex exponential of an integral frequency is one at
frequency zero and zero at every other integral frequency. -/
theorem integral_exp_two_pi_mul_int357 (m : ℤ) :
    (∫ α in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * (m : ℝ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I)) =
      if m = 0 then 1 else 0 := by
  rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)]
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · subst m
    simp
  · simp only [hm, ↓reduceIte]
    let c : ℂ := 2 * Real.pi * (m : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
      dsimp [c]
      exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num)
        (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero))
        (Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hm)) Complex.I_ne_zero
    have heq : (fun α : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * (m : ℝ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I)) =
        fun α : ℝ => Complex.exp (c * (α : ℂ)) := by
      funext α
      congr 1
      dsimp [c]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [heq, integral_exp_mul_complex hc]
    have he : Complex.exp c = 1 := by
      have he' : Complex.exp (c * ((1 : ℝ) : ℂ)) = 1 := by
        dsimp [c]
        convert Complex.exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I m using 1 <;> ring
      simpa using he'
    simp [he, hc]

name: integrand_eq_tsum357
header:
theorem integrand_eq_tsum357 (k N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (α : ℝ) :
    primeFourier111 N α ^ 2 * powerFourier111 N α ^ k *
        Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * N) : ℝ) * Complex.I) =
      ∑' t : Nat.Primes × Nat.Primes × (Fin k → ℕ),
        (Real.exp (-((((t.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ((t.2.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ∑ i, ((2 ^ (t.2.2 i + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)) / N)) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * ((N : ℝ) - (((t.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ((t.2.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ∑ i, ((2 ^ (t.2.2 i + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)))) : ℝ) * Complex.I)
doc:
/-- LEAF. Step 2 of the proof, the pointwise product: at a fixed point of the
unit interval, one copy of the damped prime series squared times k copies of
the damped power-of-two series times the exponential of frequency N is the
absolutely convergent series over prime pairs and exponent tuples whose
frequencies add up. -/

name: expanded_fourier_summable357
header:
private theorem expanded_fourier_summable357 (k N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (α : ℝ) :
    Summable (fun t : Nat.Primes × Nat.Primes × (Fin k → ℕ) =>
      (Real.exp (-((((t.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ((t.2.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) +
        ∑ i, ((2 ^ (t.2.2 i + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)) / N)) : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * ((N : ℝ) - (((t.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) +
        ((t.2.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ∑ i, ((2 ^ (t.2.2 i + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)))) : ℝ) * Complex.I))
doc:
/-- LEAF. Step 2 of the proof, the pointwise product: at a fixed point of the
unit interval, one copy of the damped prime series squared times k copies of
the damped power-of-two series times the exponential of frequency N is the
absolutely convergent series over prime pairs and exponent tuples whose
frequencies add up. -/
theorem integrand_eq_tsum357 (k N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (α : ℝ) :
    primeFourier111 N α ^ 2 * powerFourier111 N α ^ k *
        Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * N) : ℝ) * Complex.I) =
      ∑' t : Nat.Primes × Nat.Primes × (Fin k → ℕ),
        (Real.exp (-((((t.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ((t.2.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ∑ i, ((2 ^ (t.2.2 i + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)) / N)) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * ((N : ℝ) - (((t.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ((t.2.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ∑ i, ((2 ^ (t.2.2 i + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)))) : ℝ) * Complex.I) := by
  let P : Nat.Primes → ℂ := fun p =>
    (Real.exp (-((p : ℕ) : ℝ) / N) : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * α * (p : ℕ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I)
  let Q : ℕ → ℂ := fun m =>
    (Real.exp (-((2 ^ (m + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) / N) : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * α * (2 ^ (m + 1) : ℕ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I)
  have hP : Summable (fun p => ‖P p‖) := by
    simpa only [P] using (prime_fourier_summable111 N hN α).norm
  have hQ : Summable (fun m => ‖Q m‖) := by
    simpa only [Q] using (power_fourier_summable111 N hN α).norm
  have hpow := tsum_fintype_pi_pow357 Q hQ k
  have hpairnorm : Summable (fun z : Nat.Primes × Nat.Primes => ‖P z.1 * P z.2‖) :=
    hP.mul_norm hP
  have hpnorm : Summable (fun ν : Fin k → ℕ => ‖∏ i, Q (ν i)‖) := by
    simpa only [norm_prod] using hpow.1.norm
  change (∑' p, P p) ^ 2 * (∑' m, Q m) ^ k *
    Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * N) : ℝ) * Complex.I) = _
  calc
    (∑' p, P p) ^ 2 * (∑' m, Q m) ^ k *
        Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * N) : ℝ) * Complex.I) =
        ((∑' z : Nat.Primes × Nat.Primes, P z.1 * P z.2) *
          (∑' ν : Fin k → ℕ, ∏ i, Q (ν i))) *
            Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * N) : ℝ) * Complex.I) := by
              rw [pow_two, tsum_mul_tsum_of_summable_norm hP hP, hpow.2]
    _ = (∑' z : (Nat.Primes × Nat.Primes) × (Fin k → ℕ),
          (P z.1.1 * P z.1.2) * ∏ i, Q (z.2 i)) *
            Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * N) : ℝ) * Complex.I) := by
              rw [tsum_mul_tsum_of_summable_norm hpairnorm hpnorm]
    _ = ∑' z : (Nat.Primes × Nat.Primes) × (Fin k → ℕ),
          ((P z.1.1 * P z.1.2) * ∏ i, Q (z.2 i)) *
            Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * N) : ℝ) * Complex.I) := by
              rw [tsum_mul_right]
    _ = ∑' t : Nat.Primes × Nat.Primes × (Fin k → ℕ),
          ((P t.1 * P t.2.1) * ∏ i, Q (t.2.2 i)) *
            Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * N) : ℝ) * Complex.I) := by
              simpa using (Equiv.prodAssoc Nat.Primes Nat.Primes (Fin k → ℕ)).tsum_eq
                (fun t : Nat.Primes × Nat.Primes × (Fin k → ℕ) =>
                  ((P t.1 * P t.2.1) * ∏ i, Q (t.2.2 i)) *
                    Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * N) : ℝ) * Complex.I))
    _ = _ := by
      apply tsum_congr
      intro t
      have hdamp :
          ((Real.exp (-((t.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / N) * Real.exp (-((t.2.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / N)) *
            ∏ i, Real.exp (-((2 ^ (t.2.2 i + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) / N)) =
            Real.exp (-((((t.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ((t.2.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) +
              ∑ i, ((2 ^ (t.2.2 i + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)) / N)) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_sum, ← Real.exp_add]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        simp only [neg_div, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
        rw [← Finset.sum_div]
        ring
      have hphase :
          ((Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * α * (t.1 : ℕ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I) *
            Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * α * (t.2.1 : ℕ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I)) *
            ∏ i, Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * α * (2 ^ (t.2.2 i + 1) : ℕ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I)) *
            Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * N) : ℝ) * Complex.I) =
            Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * ((N : ℝ) - (((t.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) +
              ((t.2.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ∑ i, ((2 ^ (t.2.2 i + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)))) : ℝ) * Complex.I) := by
        rw [← Complex.exp_add, ← Complex.exp_sum, ← Complex.exp_add, ← Complex.exp_add]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        simp only [neg_div, neg_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
        rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum]
        ring
      dsimp only [P, Q]
      rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
      have hdampC := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ)) hdamp
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_prod] at hdampC
      calc
        _ = (((Real.exp (-((t.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / N) : ℂ) *
                (Real.exp (-((t.2.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / N) : ℂ) *
                ∏ i, (Real.exp (-((2 ^ (t.2.2 i + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) / N) : ℂ)) *
              (((Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * α * (t.1 : ℕ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I) *
                  Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * α * (t.2.1 : ℕ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I)) *
                  ∏ i, Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * α * (2 ^ (t.2.2 i + 1) : ℕ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I)) *
                Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * N) : ℝ) * Complex.I))) := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hdampC, hphase]

name: integral_tsum_swap357
header:
theorem integral_tsum_swap357 (k N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    (∫ α in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∑' t : Nat.Primes × Nat.Primes × (Fin k → ℕ),
        (Real.exp (-((((t.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ((t.2.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ∑ i, ((2 ^ (t.2.2 i + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)) / N)) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * ((N : ℝ) - (((t.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ((t.2.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ∑ i, ((2 ^ (t.2.2 i + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)))) : ℝ) * Complex.I)) =
      ∑' t : Nat.Primes × Nat.Primes × (Fin k → ℕ),
        (Real.exp (-((((t.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ((t.2.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ∑ i, ((2 ^ (t.2.2 i + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)) / N)) : ℂ) * (if ((t.1 : ℕ) + (t.2.1 : ℕ) + ∑ i, 2 ^ (t.2.2 i + 1)) = N then (1 : ℂ) else 0)
doc:
/-- LEAF. Step 3 of the proof, the exchange of the integral with the sum: the
integral over the unit interval of the expanded series of step 2 is the sum
over the same index set of the termwise integrals, each taken by step 1, so
each term survives exactly when its frequency is N. -/

name: tsum_indicator_eq_count357
header:
theorem tsum_indicator_eq_count357 (k N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    (∑' t : Nat.Primes × Nat.Primes × (Fin k → ℕ),
        (Real.exp (-((((t.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ((t.2.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ∑ i, ((2 ^ (t.2.2 i + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)) / N)) : ℂ) * (if ((t.1 : ℕ) + (t.2.1 : ℕ) + ∑ i, 2 ^ (t.2.2 i + 1)) = N then (1 : ℂ) else 0)) =
      (Real.exp (-1) : ℂ) * (representationCount111 k N : ℂ)
doc:
/-- LEAF. Step 4 of the proof, the count: at frequency N the damping weight of
every surviving tuple is exp of minus one, and the surviving tuples are in
bijection with the ordered representations counted by
representationCount111, so the sum over them is exp of minus one times that
count. -/

name: count_circle_coefficient357_split
header:
theorem count_circle_coefficient357_split (k N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    (∫ α in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, primeFourier111 N α ^ 2 * powerFourier111 N α ^ k * Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * α * N) : ℝ) * Complex.I)) = (Real.exp (-1) : ℂ) * (representationCount111 k N : ℂ)
doc:
/-- The circle coefficient, assembled from the four leaves of this file: integrate
the expanded product, swap the integral with the sum, evaluate every termwise
integral, and count the surviving tuples. -/

name: card_reduced1622
header:
private theorem card_reduced1622 (q : ℕ) :
    ((Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q)).card = q.totient
doc:
/-- The reduced residues below q number the totient of q, in the form the assembly
uses for the counting of the doubled intervals. -/

name: rational_cover1622
header:
theorem rational_cover1622 (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (τ : ℝ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hτ : 4 ≤ τ) :
    arcSystem111 q τ ∩ Set.Icc 0 1 ⊆
      ⋃ a ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q),
        Set.Icc ((a : ℝ) / q - 2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ)) ((a : ℝ) / q + 2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ))
doc:
/-- LEAF. The covering step of the geometry. For q at least two and tau at least four,
every point of the arc system of denominator q that lies in the unit interval lies in
one of the doubled rational intervals of radius two over q tau about a reduced residue
below q. Only rational arithmetic and the positivity of q and tau are used; no
integration, no character and no bound on the prime system occurs. -/

name: rational_cover_integral1622
header:
theorem rational_cover_integral1622 (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (τ : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : Continuous f) (hn : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ f x)
    (hcover : arcSystem111 q τ ∩ Set.Icc 0 1 ⊆
      ⋃ a ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q),
        Set.Icc ((a : ℝ) / q - 2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ)) ((a : ℝ) / q + 2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ))) :
    (∫ α in arcSystem111 q τ ∩ Set.Icc 0 1, f α) ≤
      ∫ z in -(2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ))..(2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ)),
        ∑ a ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q), f ((a : ℝ) / q + z)
doc:
/-- LEAF. The integral step of the geometry. For a nonnegative continuous function and a
cover of the clipped arc system by the doubled intervals of the reduced residues, the
integral over the clipped system is at most the integral over the radius interval of the
sum of the shifted values at the reduced residues. This is subadditivity of the integral
over a finite union together with translation of the interval, so it uses no property of
the function beyond nonnegativity and continuity, and none of the characters. -/

name: exp_phase_nat
doc: /-- The phase of the residue `m` modulo `q`, as an `n`-th power. -/

name: full_sum_nat
header:
private theorem full_sum_nat (q m : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    (∑ a ∈ Finset.range q,
      Complex.exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (a : ℂ) / (q : ℂ))) =
      if q ∣ m then (q : ℂ) else 0
doc: /-- Complete residue sums vanish off the divisibility condition. -/

name: multiples_sum_nat
header:
private theorem multiples_sum_nat (q d m : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hd : d ∣ q) :
    (∑ a ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => d ∣ a),
        Complex.exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * (a : ℂ) / (q : ℂ))) =
      if q / d ∣ m then ((q / d : ℕ) : ℂ) else 0
doc: /-- The sum over the multiples of a divisor reduces to the quotient modulus. -/

name: coprime_indicator_nat
doc: /-- Möbius inversion gives the coprimality indicator at every positive modulus. -/

name: ramanujan_sum_one_nat
header:
private theorem ramanujan_sum_one_nat (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    (∑ a ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q),
        Complex.exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * ((1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (a : ℂ) / (q : ℂ))) =
      ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius q : ℤ) : ℂ)
doc: /-- The Ramanujan sum at argument one is the Möbius function of the modulus. -/

name: unit_sum_addChar_le_one
header:
private theorem unit_sum_addChar_le_one (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] :
    ‖∑ c ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun c => IsUnit c), ZMod.stdAddChar c‖ ≤ 1
doc: /-- The unit sum of the additive character has modulus at most one. -/

name: unit_gauss_principal_le
doc:
/-- The Gauss vector of the principal character at the unit shift one has modulus at most
one: it is the conjugate of the unit sum of the additive character. -/

name: two_pow_primeFactors_card_le
header:
private theorem two_pow_primeFactors_card_le (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    2 ^ q.primeFactors.card ≤ q
doc: /-- The number of distinct prime divisors of a positive integer obeys `2 ^ ω ≤ q`. -/

name: primeFactors_card_le_log
header:
private theorem primeFactors_card_le_log (q : ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    (q.primeFactors.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.log q
doc: /-- The count of distinct prime divisors is at most twice the logarithm. -/

name: corr_bound
header:
private theorem corr_bound (N q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (hq : 2 ≤ q) (z : ℝ) (a : ZMod q) :
    ‖∑' p : Nat.Primes, (if IsUnit (((p : ℕ)) : ZMod q) then 0
        else (Real.exp (-((p : ℕ) : ℝ) / N) : ℂ) *
          Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * (((a.val : ℝ) / q + z)) * ((p : ℕ) : ℝ)) : ℝ) *
            Complex.I))‖ ≤ 2 * Real.log q
doc:
/-- The tail of the prime series at a unit residue is supported on the primes dividing `q`,
and each of its terms has modulus at most one. -/

name: sum_Gunit_mul_char
doc: /-- Character-table expansion of the additive character on the units. -/

name: Gunit_eq_mul
header:
private theorem Gunit_eq_mul (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) {a : ZMod q} (ha : IsUnit a) :
    (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) = χ a * (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG))
doc: /-- `G` is multiplicative in the additive shift: on units it is `χ a` times `G χ 1`. -/

name: sum_unit_char_of_ne_one
header:
private theorem sum_unit_char_of_ne_one {ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q} (hψ : ψ ≠ 1) :
    ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a), ψ a = 0
doc: /-- A nontrivial Dirichlet character has vanishing sum over the units. -/

name: sum_unit_char_mul_inv
doc: /-- `χ·conj χ'` summed over the units: the totient at `χ = χ'`, zero otherwise. -/

name: sum_Gunit_orth
header:
private theorem sum_Gunit_orth (χ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) :
    ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
        (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ' cG)))
      = if χ = χ' then (q.totient : ℂ) * ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)))) else 0
doc: /-- The Gauss vectors of two characters are orthogonal over the units. -/

name: Gunit_one_principal_le
header: private theorem Gunit_one_principal_le (hq : 0 < q) : ‖(∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) cG))‖ ≤ 1
doc:
/-- The principal Gauss vector: the additive character of the units is the conjugate of
the Ramanujan sum, so its norm is `|μ(q)|`. -/

name: Gunit_one_norm_sq_le
header: private theorem Gunit_one_norm_sq_le (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) : ‖(∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG))‖ ^ 2 ≤ (q : ℝ)
doc: /-- `G χ 1` is the Gauss sum of `χ⁻¹`, so its square norm is at most the modulus. -/

name: char_expansion_pointwise
header:
private theorem char_expansion_pointwise (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (a : ZMod q) (p : Nat.Primes)
    (hp : IsUnit ((p : ℕ) : ZMod q)) :
    ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * ((p : ℕ) : ZMod q)))
      = (1 / (q.totient : ℂ)) *
          ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * χ ((p : ℕ) : ZMod q)
doc:
/-- Per-prime character expansion: on a prime whose residue is a unit, the additive character
of the shifted fraction is `1/φ` times the Gauss-weighted character sum. -/

name: exp_split_phase
header:
private theorem exp_split_phase (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (z : ℝ) (a : ZMod q) (p : Nat.Primes) :
    ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * ((p : ℕ) : ZMod q))) *
        Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * z * ((p : ℕ) : ℝ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I)
      = Complex.exp
          ((-(2 * Real.pi * (((a.val : ℝ) / q + z)) * ((p : ℕ) : ℝ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I)
doc: /-- Splitting the exponential of the shifted fraction into the residue phase and the shift. -/

name: prime_fourier_expansion
header:
private theorem prime_fourier_expansion (N q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (hN : 1 ≤ N) (z : ℝ) (a : ZMod q) :
    primeFourier111 N ((a.val : ℝ) / q + z) =
      (1 / (q.totient : ℂ)) *
          ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime280 χ N z +
        ∑' p : Nat.Primes, (if IsUnit ((p : ℕ) : ZMod q) then 0
          else (Real.exp (-((p : ℕ) : ℝ) / N) : ℂ) *
            Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * ((a.val : ℝ) / q + z) * ((p : ℕ) : ℝ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I))
doc: /-- Pointwise expansion of the prime series at a shifted unit fraction. -/

name: sum_normSq_chi_combo
header:
private theorem sum_normSq_chi_combo (N q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (hN : 1 ≤ N) (z : ℝ) :
    ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
        ‖∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime280 χ N z‖ ^ 2
      = (q.totient : ℝ) *
          ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, ‖characterPrime280 χ N z‖ ^ 2 * ‖(∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG))‖ ^ 2
doc:
/-- The squared character combination summed over the reduced residues. The Gauss vectors of
distinct characters are orthogonal, so only the diagonal survives: the sum is the totient times
the character squares weighted by the squared Gauss norms at `1`. -/

name: card_reduced_aux1622
header:
private theorem card_reduced_aux1622 (q : ℕ) :
    ((Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q)).card = q.totient
doc:
/-- The squared character combination summed over the reduced residues. The Gauss vectors of
distinct characters are orthogonal, so only the diagonal survives: the sum is the totient times
the character squares weighted by the squared Gauss norms at `1`. -/
private theorem sum_normSq_chi_combo (N q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (hN : 1 ≤ N) (z : ℝ) :
    ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
        ‖∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime280 χ N z‖ ^ 2
      = (q.totient : ℝ) *
          ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, ‖characterPrime280 χ N z‖ ^ 2 * ‖(∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG))‖ ^ 2 := by
  classical
  have hreal : ∀ w : ℂ, ‖w‖ ^ 2 = (w * (starRingEnd ℂ) w).re := by
    intro w
    rw [Complex.mul_conj, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  have hresumA : ∀ f : ZMod q → ℂ,
      (∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a), (f a).re)
        = (∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a), f a).re := by
    intro f
    have h := map_sum Complex.reCLM f
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a))
    simpa only [Complex.reCLM_apply] using h.symm
  have hresumC : ∀ f : DirichletCharacter ℂ q → ℂ,
      (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (f χ).re) = (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, f χ).re := by
    intro f
    have h := map_sum Complex.reCLM f (Finset.univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ q))
    simpa only [Complex.reCLM_apply] using h.symm
  have hre : ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q,
      ((characterPrime280 χ N z * (starRingEnd ℂ) (characterPrime280 χ N z)) *
          ((q.totient : ℂ) * ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)))))).re
        = (q.totient : ℝ) * (‖characterPrime280 χ N z‖ ^ 2 * ‖(∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG))‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro χ
    rw [Complex.mul_conj, Complex.mul_conj]
    rw [show ((q.totient : ℂ)) = (((q.totient : ℝ)) : ℂ) by simp]
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    ring
  have hcomplex :
      ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
          (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime280 χ N z) *
            (starRingEnd ℂ) (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime280 χ N z)
        = ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q,
            (characterPrime280 χ N z * (starRingEnd ℂ) (characterPrime280 χ N z)) *
              ((q.totient : ℂ) * ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG))))) := by
    have hexp : ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
          (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime280 χ N z) *
            (starRingEnd ℂ) (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime280 χ N z)
        = ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
            ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, ∑ χ' : DirichletCharacter ℂ q,
              ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime280 χ N z) *
                (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ' cG)) * characterPrime280 χ' N z) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
      rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    rw [hexp, Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun χ _ => ?_)
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have hfac : ∀ a : ZMod q,
        ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime280 χ N z) *
            (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime280 χ N z)
        = (characterPrime280 χ N z * (starRingEnd ℂ) (characterPrime280 χ N z)) *
            ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)))) := by
      intro a
      rw [map_mul]
      ring
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single χ]
    · have hstep : ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
            ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime280 χ N z) *
              (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime280 χ N z)
          = (characterPrime280 χ N z * (starRingEnd ℂ) (characterPrime280 χ N z)) *
              ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
                ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)))) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hfac a)
      rw [hstep, sum_Gunit_orth χ χ, if_pos rfl]
    · intro χ' _ hne
      have hfac' : ∀ a : ZMod q,
          ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime280 χ N z) *
              (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ' cG)) * characterPrime280 χ' N z)
          = (characterPrime280 χ N z * (starRingEnd ℂ) (characterPrime280 χ' N z)) *
              ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ' cG)))) := by
        intro a
        rw [map_mul]
        ring
      have hstep : ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
            ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime280 χ N z) *
              (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ' cG)) * characterPrime280 χ' N z)
          = (characterPrime280 χ N z * (starRingEnd ℂ) (characterPrime280 χ' N z)) *
              ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
                ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ' cG)))) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hfac' a)
      rw [hstep, sum_Gunit_orth χ χ', if_neg (fun h => hne h.symm), mul_zero]
    · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ χ) h
  calc ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
        ‖∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime280 χ N z‖ ^ 2
      = ∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),

            (starRingEnd ℂ) (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime280 χ N z)).re := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
        exact hreal _
    _ = (∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun a => IsUnit a),
          (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime280 χ N z) *
            (starRingEnd ℂ) (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, (∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * characterPrime280 χ N z)).re := by
        exact hresumA _
    _ = (∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q,
          (characterPrime280 χ N z * (starRingEnd ℂ) (characterPrime280 χ N z)) *
            ((q.totient : ℂ) * ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) ((∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG)))))).re := by
        rw [hcomplex]
    _ = ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q,
          (q.totient : ℝ) * (‖characterPrime280 χ N z‖ ^ 2 * ‖(∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG))‖ ^ 2) := by
        rw [← hresumC]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun χ _ => hre χ)
    _ = (q.totient : ℝ) *
          ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q, ‖characterPrime280 χ N z‖ ^ 2 * ‖(∑ cG ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter (fun cG => IsUnit cG), ZMod.stdAddChar (-((1 : ZMod q) * cG)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (χ cG))‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]

end

private theorem pointwise_assembly (N q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hq : 2 ≤ q) (z : ℝ) :
    (∑ a ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q),
        ‖primeFourier111 N ((a : ℝ) / q + z)‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (8 / (q.totient : ℝ)) *
        (‖characterPrime280 (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) N z‖ ^ 2 +
          (q : ℝ) * ∑ χ ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q => χ ≠ 1),
            ‖characterPrime280 χ N z‖ ^ 2) +
        8 * (q.totient : ℝ) * Real.log q ^ 2

name: rational_pointwise_characters1622
header:
theorem rational_pointwise_characters1622 :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∀ (N q : ℕ) [NeZero q], 1 ≤ N → 2 ≤ q → ∀ z : ℝ,
      (∑ a ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q),
        ‖primeFourier111 N ((a : ℝ) / q + z)‖ ^ 2) ≤
      B / (q.totient : ℝ) *
        (‖characterPrime280 (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) N z‖ ^ 2 +
          (q : ℝ) * ∑ χ ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q => χ ≠ 1),
            ‖characterPrime280 χ N z‖ ^ 2) +
        B * (q.totient : ℝ) * Real.log q ^ 2
doc:
/-- LEAF. The finite unit character step, pointwise in z. At any z the sum of the squares
of the prime system shifted to the reduced residues below q is at most a constant over the
totient of q times the principal square plus q times the sum of the nonprincipal squares,
plus a constant times the totient of q times the square of the logarithm of q. The
orthogonality of the unit group gives the coefficient one over the totient, the Gauss
squares are bounded by q, and the primes dividing q are absorbed in the logarithmic term.
No tau, no integration and no growth hypothesis occurs. -/

name: doubled_system_characters1622_split
header:
theorem doubled_system_characters1622_split :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∀ (N q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (τ : ℝ), 1 ≤ N → 2 ≤ q → 4 ≤ τ →
      (∫ α in arcSystem111 q τ ∩ Set.Icc 0 1, ‖primeFourier111 N α‖ ^ 2) ≤
        B / (q.totient : ℝ) *
          ((∫ z in -(2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ))..(2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ)),
              ‖characterPrime280 (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) N z‖ ^ 2) +
            (q : ℝ) * ∑ χ ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q => χ ≠ 1),
              ∫ z in -(2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ))..(2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ)),
                ‖characterPrime280 χ N z‖ ^ 2) +
        B * (q.totient : ℝ) * (2 / ((q : ℝ) * τ)) * Real.log q ^ 2
doc:
/-- The doubled system mass, from the two geometry steps and the pointwise finite
character bound. The target statement is unchanged. -/

doc:
/-- **Finite Parseval.** The mean square of a finite exponential sum over any
interval of length one is the sum of the squared coefficients. -/
private lemma integral_normSq_finset_exp (b : ℕ → ℂ) (M : ℕ) (a : ℝ) :
    (∫ β in a..(a + 1),
        ‖∑ m ∈ Finset.range M,
          b m * Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * β * (m : ℝ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I)‖ ^ 2) =
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.range M, ‖b m‖ ^ 2 := by
  apply Complex.ofReal_injective
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal]
  have hexp : ∀ β : ℝ,
      ((‖∑ m ∈ Finset.range M,
          b m * Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * β * (m : ℝ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I)‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
        = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range M, ∑ m' ∈ Finset.range M,
            b m * (starRingEnd ℂ) (b m') *
              Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * β * (((m : ℤ) - (m' : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ)) : ℝ) *
                Complex.I) := by
    intro β
    rw [Complex.ofReal_pow, ← Complex.mul_conj']
    rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m' _ => ?_
    have hconj : (starRingEnd ℂ)
        (Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * β * (m' : ℝ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I))
        = Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * β * (m' : ℝ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I) := by
      rw [← Complex.exp_conj]
      congr 1
      rw [map_mul, Complex.conj_I, Complex.conj_ofReal]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [map_mul, hconj]
    have hE : Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * β * (m : ℝ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I) *
        Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * β * (m' : ℝ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I)
        = Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * β * (((m : ℤ) - (m' : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ)) : ℝ) *
            Complex.I) := by
      rw [← Complex.exp_add]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring
    calc b m * Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * β * (m : ℝ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I) *
          ((starRingEnd ℂ) (b m') *
            Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * β * (m' : ℝ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I))
        = b m * (starRingEnd ℂ) (b m') *
            (Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * β * (m : ℝ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I) *
              Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * β * (m' : ℝ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I)) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hE]
  simp_rw [hexp]
  have hint : ∀ (m m' : ℕ), IntervalIntegrable (fun β : ℝ =>
      b m * (starRingEnd ℂ) (b m') *
        Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * β * (((m : ℤ) - (m' : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I))
      volume a (a + 1) := fun m m' =>
    (continuous_const.mul (continuous_exp_int_freq _)).intervalIntegrable _ _
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum (f := fun m β => ∑ m' ∈ Finset.range M,
      b m * (starRingEnd ℂ) (b m') *
        Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * β * (((m : ℤ) - (m' : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I))
    fun m _ => (continuous_finsetSum _ fun m' _ =>
      (continuous_const.mul (continuous_exp_int_freq _))).intervalIntegrable _ _]
  rw [Complex.ofReal_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m hm => ?_
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum (f := fun m' β =>
      b m * (starRingEnd ℂ) (b m') *
        Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * β * (((m : ℤ) - (m' : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I))
    fun m' _ => hint m m']
  simp_rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_exp_int_freq]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single m]
  · simp only [sub_self, if_true, mul_one]
    rw [Complex.mul_conj', Complex.ofReal_pow]
  · intro m' _ hm'
    have hsub : (((m : ℤ) - (m' : ℤ) : ℤ)) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hm'
      omega
    simp [hsub]
  · intro h
    exact absurd hm h

private lemma summable_exp_decay (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    Summable fun n : ℕ => Real.exp (-((n : ℝ) / N)) := by
  have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hq : Real.exp (-(1 / (N : ℝ))) < 1 := by
    have h := Real.exp_lt_exp (x := -(1 / (N : ℝ))) (y := 0) |>.mpr (by
      have h1 : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (N : ℝ) := by positivity
      linarith)
    rwa [Real.exp_zero] at h
  refine (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (Real.exp_pos _).le hq).congr (fun n => ?_)
  rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
  congr 1
  have hNne : (N : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp

private lemma exp_decay_le_one (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (n : ℕ) :
    Real.exp (-((n : ℝ) / N)) ≤ 1 := by
  have hq : Real.exp (-((n : ℝ) / N)) ≤ Real.exp 0 := by
    rw [Real.exp_le_exp]
    have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
    have h2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) / N := by positivity
    linarith
  rwa [Real.exp_zero] at hq

header:
private lemma prime_exp_integral_le (N : ℕ) (hN : 3 ≤ N) (a : ℝ) :

        ‖∑' n : ℕ, (((if n.Prime then Real.exp (-((n : ℝ) / N)) else 0) : ℝ) : ℂ) *

      2000 * ((N : ℝ) / Real.log N)

name: summable_norm_indicator
header:
private lemma summable_norm_indicator (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    Summable fun n : ℕ => ‖(((if n.Prime then Real.exp (-((n : ℝ) / N)) else 0) : ℝ) : ℂ)‖
doc:
/-- The mass of the damped prime exponential sum on an interval of length one is
`O(N / log N)`. -/
private lemma prime_exp_integral_le (N : ℕ) (hN : 3 ≤ N) (a : ℝ) :
    (∫ z in a..(a + 1),
        ‖∑' n : ℕ, (((if n.Prime then Real.exp (-((n : ℝ) / N)) else 0) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          Complex.exp ((-(2 * Real.pi * z * (n : ℝ)) : ℝ) * Complex.I)‖ ^ 2) ≤
      2000 * ((N : ℝ) / Real.log N) := by
  classical
  have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < N := by
    have : 0 < N := by omega
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hN1 : 0 < N := by omega
  have hb1 : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖(((if n.Prime then Real.exp (-((n : ℝ) / N)) else 0) : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro n
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (by by_cases hp : n.Prime <;> simp only [hp, if_true, if_false] <;> positivity)]
    by_cases hp : n.Prime
    · rw [if_pos hp]; exact exp_decay_le_one N hN1 n
    · rw [if_neg hp]; norm_num
  have hbs : Summable fun n : ℕ => ‖(((if n.Prime then Real.exp (-((n : ℝ) / N)) else 0) : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ := by
    refine (summable_exp_decay N hN1).of_nonneg_of_le (g := fun n : ℕ =>
      ‖(((if n.Prime then Real.exp (-((n : ℝ) / N)) else 0) : ℝ) : ℂ)‖)
      (fun n => norm_nonneg _) (fun n => ?_)
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (by by_cases hp : n.Prime <;> simp only [hp, if_true, if_false] <;> positivity)]
    by_cases hp : n.Prime
    · simp only [if_pos hp]; exact le_rfl
    · rw [if_neg hp]; exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have h := integral_normSq_tsum_le (fun n : ℕ =>
    (((if n.Prime then Real.exp (-((n : ℝ) / N)) else 0) : ℝ) : ℂ)) hb1 hbs a
  have hsq : (∑' n : ℕ, ‖(((if n.Prime then Real.exp (-((n : ℝ) / N)) else 0) : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ^ 2) =
      ∑' n : ℕ, (if n.Prime then Real.exp (-((n : ℝ) / N)) else 0) ^ 2 := by
    refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  rw [hsq, prime_squares_eq N] at h
  by_cases hbig : 1000 ≤ N
  · exact h.trans (prime_square_sum_le N hbig)
  · have hsmall : N ≤ 1000 := by omega
    have hcrude := prime_square_sum_crude N (by omega)
    have hlog : Real.log (N : ℝ) ≤ 2000 := by
      have h1 : Real.log (N : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 1000 := by
        refine Real.log_le_log hNpos ?_
        exact_mod_cast hsmall
      linarith [log_1000_le]
    have hlog0 : 0 < Real.log (N : ℝ) := by
      have h3 : (3 : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN
      have h := Real.log_pos (by linarith : (1 : ℝ) < N)
      linarith
    have hlast : (N : ℝ) ≤ 2000 * ((N : ℝ) / Real.log (N : ℝ)) := by
      rw [mul_div_assoc', le_div_iff₀ hlog0]
      nlinarith [hlog, hNpos]
    exact h.trans (hcrude.trans hlast)

    characterPrime280 χ N α =
      ∑' n : ℕ, (((if n.Prime then χ n * (Real.exp (-(n : ℝ) / N) : ℂ) else 0)) *

doc:
/-- `characterPrime280` as a zero-extended prime series over `ℕ`.
Carried from `Linnik1951.Principal442.character_series_nat442` (earlier pass). -/

name: character_periodic_435
header:
private lemma character_periodic_435 (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q)
